creature.ankylosaurus.abilities.punishin: A creature struck by the ankylosaurus's tail must attempt a DC 24 Fortitude save. On a failure, it's [[condition.stunned|stunned 1]]; on a critical failure, it's stunned 3.
creature.ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
creature.ankylosaurus.strikes.foot.name: foot
creature.ankylosaurus.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.aolaz.abilities.flawless-hearin: An aolaz has an incredible sense of hearing. It can hear any sound made within 1,000 feet as though it were only 5 feet away from the source of the sound, and any sound within 1 mile as though it were only 30 feet away from the source of the sound. An aolaz's hearing is a precise sense.
creature.aolaz.abilities.roll.name: Roll
creature.aolaz.abilities.roll.text: The aolaz tucks its head down and rolls up into an armored sphere. While Rolling, an aolaz has AC 44, Fort +37, Ref +29, Will +33, and Speed 100 feet, but it can't use its trunk Strikes or its Ultrasonic Blast. It can make foot Strikes while rolling, but only as part of a Trample. The aolaz can use this action again to unroll and resume its standing form.
creature.aolaz.abilities.trample.name: Trample
creature.aolaz.abilities.ultrasonic-blas:
The aolaz releases a tremendous blast of sonic energy from its trunk in a 150-foot line, dealing 12d10 sonic damage. The frequency of this sound is such that it is completely imperceptible to humanoids, but the damage it wreaks is all too evident. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 40 Fortitude save. The aolaz can't use Ultrasonic Blast again for 1d4 rounds.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is [[condition.stunned|stunned 1]].

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is stunned 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and is stunned 3.
creature.aolaz.name: Aolaz
creature.aolaz.strikes.foot.name: foot
creature.aolaz.strikes.trunk.name: trunk
creature.arbiter.abilities.electrical-bu: The arbiter releases an electrical burst from its body that deals 3d6 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation, with a DC 17 basic Reflex save. The arbiter is then [[condition.stunned|stunned]] for 24 hours.
creature.arbiter.abilities.locate-aeon.t: An arbiter can always sense the direction of the nearest non-arbiter aeon on the plane, but it can't sense the range to the aeon.
creature.arbiter.name: Arbiter
creature.arbiter.strikes.shortsword.name: shortsword
creature.arboreal-regent.abilities.awake: The arboreal regent causes a tree within 180 feet to uproot itself and fight as a minion using the statistics for an [[creature.awakened-tree|awakened tree]]. The arboreal regent can control up to two awakened trees at a time, and they can issue commands to both trees as a single action, which has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] and [[trait.auditory|auditory]] traits.
creature.arboreal-regent.abilities.sunde: When an arboreal regent damages an item or structure, they deal an additional 2d10 damage to that item or structure.
creature.arboreal-regent.name: Arboreal Regent
creature.arboreal-warden.abilities.shiel: The arboreal warden Strides and then makes a shield bash Strike. If the attack hits, the target is pushed 10 feet.
creature.arboreal-warden.items.0.name: large bark shield
creature.arboreal-warden.items.1.name: stone longsword
creature.arboreal-warden.name: Arboreal Warden
The swarm takes 1d6 damage as ants cling to the creature and continue biting, dealing 3d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent piercing damage]]. High winds or immersion in water reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage to 5. Any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging ants.
A creature leaves the swarm's space
creature.army-ant-swarm.abilities.swarmi: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 piercing damage (DC 21 basic Fortitude save). If the creature attempts a [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] or [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]] action while affected, it must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or the action is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.
creature.army-ant-swarm.name: Army Ant Swarm
creature.astradaemon.abilities.bent-ligh: An astradaemon appears shifted from their true position, though still in the same space. Creatures targeting the astradaemon must succeed at a DC 11 flat check to do so, as if the astradaemon were [[condition.hidden|hidden]], even though the astradaemon remains [[condition.observed|observed]]. Abilities that apply to the flat check against hidden creatures also apply against bent light.
creature.astradaemon.abilities.devour-so: The astradaemon hasn't used an action with the [[trait.attack|attack]] trait yet this turn

The astradaemon draws out and consumes the soul of a living creature they have [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]]. The creature must succeed at a DC 35 Fortitude save or instantly die. If it dies, the astradaemon gains 10 temporary Hit Points and a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 minute, or for 1 day if the victim was 15th level or higher. A victim slain in this way can be returned to life normally. A creature that survives is temporarily immune for 1 minute.
creature.astradaemon.abilities.essence-d: When an astradaemon hits with their claw, jaws, or tail, they drain the target's spiritual and vital essences. The target takes 2d10 void damage and the astradaemon regains an equal number of Hit Points. The target must succeed at a DC 37 Fortitude save or become [[condition.doomed|doomed 1]] and [[condition.drained|drained 1]]. If the target was already drained or doomed, it instead increases both conditions' value by 1, to a maximum of 4.
creature.astradaemon.abilities.soul-siph: 30 feet. An astradaemon draws power from the souls of the recently slain. If a Small or larger living creature dies within their aura, the astradaemon gains 5 temporary Hit Points and a +1 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 round, unless the creature was slain by an astradaemon's Devour Soul ability. [[trait.incorporeal|Incorporeal]] [[trait.undead|undead]] and living spirits that are traveling outside a body take 1d8 spirit damage each round within the daemon's aura as the astradaemon pulls in fragments of their soul.
creature.astradaemon.name: Astradaemon
creature.astradaemon.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.astradaemon.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.astradaemon.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.athamaru-hunter.abilities.coope: After the hunter attempts a Strike at a Large or larger target (regardless of success or failure), the next Strike one of the hunter's allies makes against the same target gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.
creature.athamaru-hunter.abilities.fan-b: The hunter prepares their hooked crossbow bolts with carefully woven seaweed. On a successful crossbow Strike, the bolt embeds and the seaweed fan deploys. The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its swim Speed. A creature can Interact to attempt a DC [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check, removing the bolt on a success.
creature.athamaru-hunter.abilities.hunt-: The athamaru hunter designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're Tracking, as their prey. The hunter gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[action.seek|Seek]] the prey and to [[skill.survival|Survival]] checks to [[action.track|Track]] the prey. The first time the athamaru hits their designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 precision damage. These effects last until the hunter uses Hunt Prey again.
creature.athamaru-hunter.abilities.pack-: The hunter's Strikes deal an additional 1d8 damage to creatures within reach of at least two of the hunter's allies.
creature.athamaru-hunter.abilities.smoot: The athamaru hunter ignores difficult terrain caused by aquatic terrain features.
creature.athamaru-hunter.name: Athamaru Hunter
creature.augnagar.abilities.confusing-di:
The augnagar's writhing limbs and flesh seethe and squirm in a disorienting and unsettling manner. Creatures in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 34 Will save, after which they are temporarily immune to further Confusing Displays for 1 minute.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is stupefied 1 and [[condition.confused|confused]] for 1 minute.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature can't attempt a flat check to recover from confusion whenever it takes damage from an attack or spell.
creature.augnagar.abilities.inhale-vital: The augnagar inhales sharply, drawing life force out of creatures in a 50-foot cone. Creatures in the area take 14d6 void damage with a DC 34 basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its save is also [[condition.fatigued|fatigued]]. If any creatures take damage from this activity, the augnagar becomes [[condition.quickened|quickened]] for 1 round, and it can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.
creature.augnagar.abilities.rotting-curs: **Saving Throw** DC 32 Fortitude; **Stage 1** [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 day); **Stage 2** drained 2 and the creature displays hideous, festering wounds exuding a horrific stench. When the victim takes piercing or slashing damage, creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 32 Fortitude save or become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]]. The victim automatically fails this save (1 day).
creature.augnagar.name: Augnagar
creature.augnagar.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.augnagar.strikes.sting.name: sting

creature.awakened-tree.strikes.root.name: root
creature.axiomite.abilities.crystalline-: The axiomite shifts their form to a cloud of crystalline dust in which strange symbols and equations flash. They gain a fly Speed of 40 feet and can fit through even tiny apertures, similar to vapor form. They can cast spells but can't make melee or ranged attacks. The axiomite can Dismiss this form to return to humanoid form.
creature.axiomite.name: Axiomite
creature.axiomite.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.axiomite.strikes.warhammer.name: warhammer
creature.azarketi-crab-catcher.abilities: Azarketi must regularly submerge themselves in water to rehydrate their water-acclimated skin. After the first 24 hours outside of water, they gain a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves as their skin cracks and their gills become painful. After 48 hours, they begin to suffocate until returned to water.
The azarketi crab catcher is swimming
The azarketi crab catcher gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. After the attack, they Swim 5 feet.
The azarketi crab catcher is targeted with an attack and can see the attacker
creature.azarketi-crab-catcher.name: Azarketi Crab Catcher
creature.azarketi-tide-tamer.abilities.a: An azarketi deals 2d8 additional damage on a successful weapon Strike while they are underwater.
creature.azarketi-tide-tamer.abilities.h: Azarketi must regularly submerge themselves in water to rehydrate their water-acclimated skin. After the first 24 hours outside of water, they gain a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves as their skin cracks and their gills become painful. After 48 hours, they begin to suffocate until returned to water.
creature.azarketi-tide-tamer.abilities.s: An azarketi tide tamer can speak with [[trait.animal|animals]] that have the [[trait.aquatic|aquatic]] or [[trait.amphibious|amphibious]] trait.
creature.azarketi-tide-tamer.name: Azarketi Tide Tamer
creature.azuretzi.abilities.entropy-sens: A protean can anticipate the most likely presence of a creature through a supernatural insight into chaotic probabilities and chance. This grants them the ability to sense creatures within the listed range. [[spell.veil-of-privacy|Veil of privacy]] prevents a creature from being detected via entropy sense automatically (without a counteract check).
creature.azuretzi.abilities.mimic-form.t: As [[ability.change-shape|Change Shape]], but an azuretzi can assume the form of a Medium or smaller creature. They can mimic a specific creature they can see, but they must succeed at a DC 25 Perception check or the attempt is disrupted. The azuretzi can transform into the same creature again without a check but can retain the details of only one specific appearance at a time. The azuretzi can Dismiss the effect as a free action to return to their natural form.
creature.azuretzi.abilities.mocking-touc: The azuretzi is not currently using Mocking Touch on a spell

The azuretzi mocks a creature's magical ability with a touch. The azuretzi attempts a [[skill.thievery|Thievery]] check against the target's Will DC.

**Critical Success** The azuretzi learns all spells of 3rd rank or lower the target has available to cast and chooses one. The azuretzi gains that spell as a mock divine innate spell and can cast it once as an innate divine spell using their own DC and spell attack modifier. The spell is lost if unused after 24 hours. The creature can't cast the mock spell until the azuretzi casts it first or the 24 hour period passes, whichever comes first.

**Success** As critical success, but the mock spell is lost after 1 hour, and the creature touched can cast the spell normally.

**Failure** As critical success, but the mock spell is lost at the end of the azuretzi's next turn, and the creature touched can cast the spell normally.

**Critical Failure** Mocking Touch has no effect.
creature.azuretzi.abilities.protean-anat:
A protean's vital organs shift and change shape and position constantly. Immediately after the protean takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage, they gain the listed amount of resistance to that damage type. This lasts for 1 hour or until the next time the protean takes damage of one of the other types (in which case their resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first.

The protean is immune to [[trait.polymorph|polymorph]] effects unless they're a willing target. If [[condition.blinded|blinded]] or [[condition.deafened|deafened]], the protean automatically recovers at the end of their next turn as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.
creature.azuretzi.abilities.spell-pilfer: The azuretzi attempts a [[skill.thievery|Thievery]] check to counteract one spell affecting the target creature. On a success, the azuretzi transfers the spell effect to themself, keeping the same remaining duration. The target then becomes temporarily immune to Spell Pilfer for 24 hours.
A creature with an active spell effect within 30 feet of the azuretzi fails to resist another azuretzi's Mocking Touch
creature.azuretzi.name: Azuretzi
creature.azuretzi.saves.note: +1 status to all saves vs. magic
creature.azuretzi.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.azuretzi.strikes.jaws.name: jaws

creature.balisse.abilities.brand-of-the-:
The balisse marks a creature within their confessor's aura as irredeemable. They can do so only after a failed attempt to convince the creature to repent. The touched creature takes a –1 status penalty to AC and saves, reduces all its resistances by 2, and gains weakness 2 to [[trait.holy|holy]]. The duration depends on the target's DC 26 Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The duration is 1 round.

**Failure** The duration is 1 day.

**Critical Failure** The duration is unlimited.
creature.balisse.abilities.confessors-au: 20 feet. Creatures in the balisse's aura are subject to [[spell.ring-of-truth|ring of truth]] (DC 23). Additionally, if these creatures choose to honestly express their own conflicted feelings, the aura makes it easier for them to put words to those feelings.
creature.balisse.abilities.guiding-angel: The balisse spiritually attaches themself to an adjacent mortal who doesn't have the [[trait.unholy|unholy]] trait. They merge with the mortal's body and are unable to use any of their spells and abilities other than to interact with the mortal. They can Dismiss the effect to leave the mortal. While merged, the balisse can either communicate using a bodiless voice only the mortal can hear or can take a form of their choice that only the mortal can see, such as a small angel on the mortal's shoulder.
creature.balisse.name: Balisse
creature.balisse.strikes.scimitar.name: scimitar
creature.bandersnatch.abilities.confusin: 20 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must succeed at a DC 35 Will save or become [[condition.confused|confused]] for 1 round.
creature.bandersnatch.abilities.focus-ga: The bandersnatch fixes its gaze at a creature it can see within 20 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Will save against the bandersnatch's Confusing Gaze. After attempting the save, the creature is temporarily immune to a bandersnatch's Confusing Gaze until the start of the bandersnatch's next turn.
creature.bandersnatch.abilities.frumious: The bandersnatch Strides, ignoring difficult terrain, then makes two claw Strikes at the end of its movement.
creature.bandersnatch.abilities.pain.tex: A bandersnatch's quills create exceptionally painful wounds. The wounded creature must succeed at a DC 38 Fortitude save to resist becoming [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (drained 2 on a critical failure) by this pain. Further bandersnatch Strikes that cause pain increase the amount of drain by 1 for each failed save to a maximum of drained 4.
creature.bandersnatch.abilities.planar-a: The bandersnatch treats the plane it is on as its home plane.
creature.bandersnatch.abilities.quick-re: The bandersnatch recovers with frightening speed. At the end of its turn, it reduces the value of one debilitating condition it suffers (with the exception of [[condition.dying|dying]] by 1. If it's [[condition.blinded|blinded]], [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]], [[condition.deafened|deafened]], [[condition.fatigued|fatigued]], [[condition.fleeing|fleeing]], or [[condition.petrified|petrified]], it can instead succeed at a DC 16 flat check to end one of these conditions of its choice) it can't use quick recovery on other conditions that lack values.
creature.bandersnatch.abilities.relentle: The bandersnatch can [[action.track|Track]] while moving at its full speed.
creature.bandersnatch.name: Bandersnatch
creature.bandersnatch.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.bandersnatch.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.bandersnatch.strikes.quill.name: quill
creature.bandersnatch.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.banshee.abilities.hears-heartbe: The banshee can hear heartbeats within 60 feet of it as an imprecise sense.
creature.banshee.abilities.spectral-ripp: When a banshee Strides at least 10 feet, they're [[condition.concealed|concealed]] until the start of their next turn.
creature.banshee.abilities.sunlight-powe: A banshee in sunlight is [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 2]] and [[condition.stunned|stunned 2]].
creature.banshee.abilities.terrifying-to: A creature damaged by the banshee's touch that isn't already [[condition.frightened|frightened]] must attempt a DC 38 Will save (DC 43 if the attack was a critical hit). If the creature fails its save, it's frightened 2; on a critical failure, the creature also cowers with fear and is [[condition.stunned|stunned 4]]. If the creature is protected against fear by a spell or magic item, the banshee's touch first attempts to counteract the protection effect, with the effect of a 9th-rank [[spell.dispel-magic|dispel magic]] spell.
creature.banshee.abilities.vengeful-spit: The banshee lashes back at their tormentor, dealing 4d10+14 mental damage with a DC 38 basic Will save and applying the effects of terrifying touch based on the results of the same Will save.
A foe critically hits the banshee, or the banshee critically fails their save against a foe's damaging effect
creature.banshee.abilities.wail.name: Wail
creature.banshee.abilities.wail.text:
The banshee unleashes a soul-chilling [[spell.wails-of-the-damned|wails of the damned]] (DC 38). This Wail overcomes [[spell.silence|silence]] and similar effects of 5th rank or lower. The banshee can instead use Wail as a three-action activity to overcome such effects of up to 8th rank.

The banshee's Wail resonates for 1 round, and any creature that comes within the area during that time must attempt a save against the effect. A creature can't be affected more than once by the same Wail. The banshee can't Wail again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.banshee.name: Banshee
creature.banshee.strikes.hand.name: hand
creature.barghest.abilities.change-shape: The barghest takes on the shape of a [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]], a dog, or its true form. Their size changes to match the new form. When the barghest is a humanoid, their claw Strike deals bludgeoning damage and they lose their jaws Strike. When the barghest is a dog, their Speed changes to 35 feet. Each individual barghest has only one humanoid form and one dog form.
After the triggering action, the barghest can teleport up to 60 feet to a space adjacent to that creature.
A creature within the barghest's reach takes a [[trait.move|move]] or [[trait.teleportation|teleportation]] action
creature.barghest.abilities.unhealing-wo: A creature damaged by the barghest's claws must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save or be cursed. The cursed creature can't regain Hit Points except via magic until it returns to maximum Hit Points. The creature can attempt a new saving throw against the curse every 24 hours.
creature.barghest.name: Barghest
creature.barghest.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.barghest.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.basilisk.abilities.petrifying-g:
The basilisk stares at a creature it can see within 30 feet. That creature must attempt a DC 22 Fortitude save. If it fails and has not already been slowed by Petrifying Glance or this ability, it becomes [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]]. If the creature was already slowed by this ability or Petrifying Glance, a failed save causes the creature to be [[condition.petrified|petrified]] permanently.

A creature petrified in this manner that is coated (not just splashed) with fresh basilisk blood no more than 1 hour old is instantly restored to flesh. A single basilisk contains enough blood to coat 1d4 Medium creatures in this manner.
The target must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save. If it fails, it's [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for 1 minute as its body slowly stiffens.
A creature within 30 feet that the basilisk can see starts its turn
creature.basilisk.name: Basilisk
creature.basilisk.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.benthic-worm.abilities.benthic-: **Saving Throw** DC 37 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d6 poison damage and [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 2]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 4d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 6d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round)
creature.benthic-worm.abilities.breach.t: The benthic worm Swims up to its swim Speed, then [[action.leap|Leaps]] vertically out of the water up to 30 feet, making a Strike against a creature at the apex of the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 45 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the worm splashes back down. It can use [[ability.improved-grab-improved-knockdown-or-improved-push|Improved Grab]] on this Strike and follow it up with Fast Swallow.
creature.benthic-worm.abilities.inexorab: The cave worm recovers from the [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]], [[condition.slowed|slowed]], and [[condition.stunned|stunned]] conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.
creature.benthic-worm.abilities.slough-s: The cave worm negates the triggering condition or effect by sloughing an outer layer of its skin. Effects from [[trait.artifact|artifacts]], deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way.
The cave worm would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as [[spell.cursed-metamorphosis|cursed metamorphosis]])
creature.benthic-worm.abilities.thrash.t: The worm attempts one Strike against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws, up to once with its stinger, and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the worm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.
creature.benthic-worm.name: Benthic Worm
creature.benthic-worm.strikes.body.name: body
creature.benthic-worm.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.boar.abilities.boar-charge.name: Boar Charge

creature.boar.abilities.ferocity.name: Ferocity
creature.boar.name: Boar
creature.boar.strikes.tusk.name: tusk
creature.boggard-scout.abilities.swamp-p: A boggard scout ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.
creature.boggard-scout.abilities.terrify: The boggard scout unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes [[condition.frightened|frightened 1]] unless they succeed at a DC 17 Will save; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.
creature.boggard-scout.abilities.tongue-: If the boggard scout hits a creature with their tongue, that creature becomes [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] by the boggard. Unlike with a normal Grab, the creature isn't [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]], but it can't move beyond the reach of the boggard's tongue. A creature can sever the tongue by hitting AC 13 and dealing at least 2 slashing damage. Though this doesn't deal any damage to the boggard, it prevents them from using their tongue Strike until they regrow their tongue, which takes a week.
creature.boggard-scout.name: Boggard Scout
creature.boggard-swampseer.abilities.des: The swampseer utters a powerful croak that deals 4d6 sonic damage to any non-boggard within a 15-foot emanation (DC 19 basic Fortitude save); any creature with the [[condition.frightened|frightened]] condition takes additional sonic damage equal to twice the value of its frightened condition. The boggard can’t use Destructive Croak again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.boggard-swampseer.abilities.dro: The swampseer releases a croak that drowns out other sounds. They roll a [[skill.performance|Performance]] check. They and boggard allies in the area can use the higher result between the swampseer's Performance check and their saves to resolve the effects against the auditory or sonic effect.
The boggard swampseer or one of their allies within 60 feet attempts a saving throw against an [[trait.auditory|auditory]] or [[trait.sonic|sonic]] effect
creature.boggard-swampseer.abilities.swa: A boggard ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.
creature.boggard-swampseer.abilities.ter: The boggard unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes [[condition.frightened|frightened 1]] unless they succeed at a DC 19 Will save; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.
creature.boggard-swampseer.abilities.ton: If the boggard hits a creature with their tongue, that creature becomes [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] by the boggard. creature.boggard-warrior.name: Boggard Warrior
creature.bogwid.abilities.bogwid-fever.t: **Saving Throw** DC 20 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 day; **Stage 1** enfeebled 1 (1 day); **Stage 2** enfeebled 2, and the DC to recover from [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed]] is increased by 2 (1 day); **Stage 3** enfeebled 3, and the DC to recover from persistent bleed is increased by 5 (1 day); **Stage 4** enfeebled 4, the DC to recover from persistent bleed is increased by 5, and you take 1d8 persistent bleed damage every 1d4 hours (1 day)
creature.bogwid.abilities.ravenous-young: The larvae launched from the bogwid attach themselves to the target and begin to feed. Once a larva is attached, the target becomes [[condition.drained|drained 1]]. While the larva remains attached, the target cannot recover from [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed]]. To remove the larva, the target can attempt a DC 21 [[action.escape|Escape]] check. Additionally, any area damage dealt to the target destroys all attached larvae.
creature.bogwid.abilities.revolting-aura: 20 feet. creature.bogwid.name: Bogwid

creature.bone-prophet.abilities.raise-se: The bone prophet animates corpses of snakes, serpentfolk, or similar serpentine creatures within a 30-foot emanation. Any flesh on the bodies sloughs off, and they rise as skeletons. The bone prophet can raise one Large creature as a [[creature.skeletal-giant|skeletal giant]] or up to three Medium creatures as [[creature.skeletal-champion|skeletal champions]]; the equipment and attacks might be different depending on the corpses' possessions. These skeletons have the [[trait.minion|minion]] trait and are under the bone prophet's control; the bone prophet can give all these minions the same command with a single action that has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] trait. Any skeletal minions that still remain after 10 minutes crumble to dust.
creature.bone-prophet.abilities.serpentf: **Saving Throw** DC 26 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d4 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)
creature.bone-prophet.abilities.thin-of-: Zyss serpentfolk recover slowly from injuries. When they take physical damage from a critical hit, they gain 2d4 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]]. They take a –2 circumstance penalty to flat checks to recover from persistent damage and saving throws against afflictions.
creature.bone-prophet.items.1.name: religious symbol
creature.bone-prophet.name: Bone Prophet

creature.bottlenose-dolphin.abilities.aq: A bottlenose dolphin can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.
creature.bottlenose-dolphin.abilities.de: A bottlenose dolphin can hold its breath for 2 hours.
creature.bottlenose-dolphin.abilities.ra: The bottlenose dolphin Swims twice and then makes a snout Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to its attack roll. creature.bottlenose-dolphin.name: Bottlenose Dolphin
creature.brimorak.abilities.boiling-bloo: Each time an adjacent creature deals slashing or piercing damage to the brimorak, the attacker is sprayed with the brimorak's boiling blood, which deals 2d4 fire damage (DC 19 basic Reflex save).
creature.brimorak.abilities.extinguishin: Dousing a brimorak with water, either ordinary water or from a [[trait.water|water]] effect, causes no physical harm to the fiend but deals 3d6 mental damage. Fully immersing the brimorak in water deals 5d6 mental damage per round.
creature.brimorak.abilities.flaming-weap: A brimorak's hooves and any weapon they wield burst into flame. They can also Interact to create a sword of fire and steel, which dissolves if it leaves their grip.
creature.brimorak.abilities.frothing-spe: The brimorak spits their boiling blood in a 20-foot line that deals 6d6 fire damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save). Creatures that fail the save also fall prone as they slip in the greasy blood. The brimorak can't use Frothing Spew again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.brimorak.abilities.fume.name: Fume
creature.brimorak.abilities.fume.text: The brimorak emits a cloud of thick black smoke in a 10-foot burst adjacent to them. The cloud remains for 1 minute. All creatures within the smoke become [[condition.concealed|concealed]], and all creatures outside the smoke become concealed to creatures within it. A creature that enters or begins its turn within the smoke it must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save or become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (sickened 2 on a critical failure).
creature.brimorak.abilities.smoke-vision: Smoke doesn't impair a brimorak's vision; they ignore the [[condition.concealed|concealed]] condition from smoke.
creature.brimorak.name: Brimorak
creature.brimorak.strikes.hoof.name: hoof
creature.brine-shark.abilities.deep-plun: The brine shark dives into the water, [[action.swim|Swimming]] twice straight down. If it's [[condition.grabbed|grabbing]] or [[condition.restrained|restraining]] a creature, it brings that creature along with it.
creature.brine-shark.name: Brine Shark
creature.brine-shark.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.brontosaurus.abilities.tail-swe: The brontosaurus makes a tail Strike and compares the attack roll to the AC of up to three foes, each of whom must be within its tail's melee reach and adjacent to at least one other target. It rolls damage only once and applies it to each creature hit. A Tail Sweep counts as two attacks for its multiple attack penalty.
creature.brontosaurus.name: Brontosaurus
creature.brontosaurus.strikes.foot.name: foot
creature.brontosaurus.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.bugbear-prowler.abilities.bushw: The bugbear prowler Strides up to 10 feet and attempts to [[action.grapple|Grapple]] a creature they're [[condition.undetected|undetected]] by. If they succeed, they also deal fist damage to that creature.
creature.bugbear-prowler.abilities.maule: The bugbear prowler gains a +3 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures they have [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]].
creature.bugbear-prowler.name: Bugbear Prowler
creature.bugbear-tormentor.abilities.sne: The bugbear tormentor deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.bugbear-tormentor.abilities.twi: The bugbear tormentor makes a dazzling series of attacks with two weapons, using the first attack to throw their foe off-guard against a second attack at a different angle. They make one Strike with each of their two melee weapons, both against the same target. The target is automatically [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] against the second attack. The bugbear tormentor applies their multiple attack penalty to these Strikes normally.
creature.bugbear-tormentor.name: Bugbear Tormentor
creature.cacodaemon.abilities.cacodaemon: The cacodaemon can telepathically communicate with the afflicted creature at any distance on the same plane; **Saving Throw** DC 17 Fortitude; **Stage 1** carrier (1 day); **Stage 2** [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] (1 day); **Stage 3** stupefied 2 (1 day)
creature.cacodaemon.abilities.change-sha:
- **Lizard** Speed 20 feet; **Melee** {1a} jaws +8 (agile, finesse), **Damage** 1d8+1 piercing
- **Octopus** size Small; Speed 20 feet, swim 30 feet; Skills [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] +6; **Melee** {1a} tentacle +8 ([[trait.finesse|finesse]]), **Damage** 1d8+1 bludgeoning plus [[ability.grab|Grab]] (page 359); **Melee** {1a} beak +8 ([[trait.agile|agile]], [[trait.finesse|finesse]]), **Damage** 1d6 piercing plus 2 poison
- **Scorpion** size Small; Speed 30 feet; Skills [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] +6; **Melee** {1a} pincer +8 ([[trait.agile|agile]], [[trait.finesse|finesse]]), **Damage** 1d6+1 bludgeoning plus [[ability.grab|Grab]]; **Melee** {1a} stinger +8 ([[trait.agile|agile]], [[trait.finesse|finesse]]), **Damage** 1d6+1 piercing plus 1d4 poison
The cacodaemon ingests the soul of a sentient creature within 30 feet that died within the last minute. When they do, the cacodaemon grows a fist-sized soul gem (Hardness 2, HP 8) in their gut and can regurgitate it at any time as an Interact action. Destroying the gem frees the soul within but doesn't return the deceased creature to life. If a caster attempts to return to life a creature whose soul is trapped within a soul gem, they fail unless they succeed at a DC 30 [[skill.religion|Religion]] check. A success causes the soul gem to shatter so the creature is returned to life as normal for the spell.

A fiend can Interact to ingest a soul gem it is holding, condemning the soul to the fiend's home plane. The fiend gains [[ability.fast-healing|fast healing]] 5 for 1 minute.
creature.cacodaemon.name: Cacodaemon
creature.cacodaemon.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
The caldera oni transforms into a cloud of sparking volcanic ash and then Flies. This movement doesn't trigger reactions, and the caldera oni can move through small gaps and spaces occupied by other creatures. The caldera oni then returns to its physical form, affected by a 4th-rank [[spell.enlarge|enlarge]] spell with a duration of 1d4 rounds.
creature.caldera-oni.abilities.bean-pani: Oni are curiously afraid of beans, especially as the seasons begin to change. If a creature Interacts to throw a handful of beans at the oni, the oni becomes [[condition.frightened|frightened 2]]. While frightened this way, their weakness to spirit damage is increased by 5. The oni then becomes immune to bean panic for 24 hours.
creature.caldera-oni.abilities.change-sh: The caldera oni can take on the appearance of any Medium or Large [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] creature. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.caldera-oni.abilities.dance-of-: The oni's heat becomes overwhelming, causing them to breathe out superheated ash and dance across the battlefield. The caldera oni Strides, then makes a melee Strike. If the Strike hits, the oni can Stride again and Strike again, repeating this until they have either missed with a Strike or made three Strikes total. The oni then finishes the dance by calling down volcanic lightning through the cloud of ash. Each creature hit by a Strike during the dance takes 3d6 fire damage and 3d6 electricity damage with a DC 34 basic Reflex save.
creature.caldera-oni.abilities.stoke-the: When the caldera oni is critically hit, the flames of anger grow within them. They recharge their choice of Ash Form or Dance of Burning War.
creature.caldera-oni.name: Caldera Oni
creature.caldera-oni.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.caldera-oni.strikes.katana.name: katana
creature.caligni-dancer.abilities.dancer: The caligni dancer touches a foe and curses it. If the target fails a DC 18 Will save, it gains [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]] and [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]]. The target is then temporarily immune for 24 hours. These conditions persist until the curse is removed. The victim can attempt a new DC 18 Will save once per hour to end the curse.
creature.caligni-dancer.abilities.distra: The target ally can roll the save twice and take the better result.
An ally within 10 feet of the dancer rolls a saving throw against a [[trait.mental|mental]] or [[trait.illusion|illusion]] effect
creature.caligni-dancer.abilities.final-: When the dancer dies, their body dissolves into a swirling mass of darkness and light. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 17 Will save or be [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]] for 1d4 rounds. The dancer's possessions are left in a pile where they died.
creature.caligni-dancer.abilities.sneak-: The caligni dancer deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.caligni-dancer.items.0.name: baton
creature.caligni-dancer.name: Caligni Dancer

creature.caligni-hunter.abilities.encirc: Each [[creature.caligni-skulker|caligni skulker]] within 30 feet of the hunter can Step. Each skulker can benefit from Encircling Command only once per round.
creature.caligni-hunter.abilities.final-: When the hunter dies, their soul leaves their body in an explosion of spiritual energy. All creatures in a 20-foot burst take 5d6 spirit damage (DC 19 basic Will save). The hunter's possessions are left in a pile where they died.
creature.caligni-hunter.abilities.sneak-: The caligni hunter deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.caligni-hunter.items.0.name: darkening poison

creature.caligni-skulker.abilities.final: When the caligni skulker dies, their remains dissolve into a 20-foot emanation of inky darkness before dissipating. The darkness extinguishes non-magical light sources and attempts to counteract magical [[trait.light|light]] as a 1st-rank effect with a +10 counteract modifier. The skulker's possessions are left in a pile where they died.
creature.caligni-skulker.abilities.sneak: The caligni skulker deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.caligni-skulker.abilities.tumbl: When the caligni skulker [[action.tumble-through|Tumbles Through]] a creature's space, that creature is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] against the next attack the skulker makes against it before the end of its turn.
creature.caligni-skulker.items.0.name: darkening poison
creature.caligni-skulker.name: Caligni Skulker
creature.cassisian.abilities.change-shap:
A cassisian can take the appearance of a dove, a winged humanoid, a dog, or a fish. Normally, this doesn't change their Speed or the attack and damage bonuses for their Strikes, but it might change the damage type Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning). Any further changes for specific forms are noted below.
- **Dog** size Small scent (imprecise) 30 feet, Speed 40 feet; Skills Athletics +6; Melee {1a} jaws +7, Damage 1d6+2 piercing plus [[ability.knockdown|Knockdown]]
- **Fish** swim Speed 30 feet
creature.cassisian.abilities.eye-beams.t: The cassisian releases beams of heat or cold from their eyes, dealing 2d6 cold or fire damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save) to all creatures in a 15-foot line. They can’t use Eye Beams again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.cassisian.abilities.repository-: While the cassisian isn't particularly intelligent, they have perfect memory and can remember everything they see or hear. This allows them to attempt [[skill.lore|Lore]] checks on any topic with a +10 modifier, provided (at the GM's discretion) they've encountered the topic in question before. The cassisian's limited intellect often prevents them from acting upon their knowledge, making them a better resource than agent in using information.
creature.cassisian.abilities.transfer-pr: A creature can wear a willing cassisian as a helmet. While it does, the cassisian can't act, but the cassisian extends their +1 status bonus to AC and saves against [[trait.unholy|unholy]] creatures to their wearer. At any time, the cassisian can detach themself from their wearer as a single action.
creature.cassisian.name: Cassisian
creature.cassisian.saves.note: +1 status to all saves vs. unholy creatures
creature.cassisian.strikes.headbutt.name: headbutt
creature.catfolk-pouncer.abilities.cats-: Reroll that saving throw and take the better result.
The catfolk pouncer fails or critically fails a Reflex saving throw
creature.catfolk-pouncer.abilities.sudde: The catfolk pouncer Strides twice. If the catfolk ends their movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.
creature.catfolk-pouncer.name: Catfolk Pouncer
creature.cauthooj.abilities.hop-dodge.te: The cauthooj nimbly hops aside, redirecting the triggering Strike against the adjacent enemy. The cauthooj Strides up to half its Speed, and this movement does not trigger reactions.
creature.cauthooj.abilities.hop-dodge.tr: The cauthooj is the target of a melee Strike and is adjacent to another enemy that is also within the reach of the melee Strike
creature.cauthooj.abilities.staccato-str: With subtle alterations in the pitch and tone of its song, the cauthooj directs one creature confused by its Warbling Song to make a Strike. This works like other Strikes made by [[condition.confused|confused]] creatures, except that the cauthooj chooses the target. If no target is in reach or range, or the creature is unable to Strike for any other reason, this ability has no effect.
creature.cauthooj.abilities.thoughtsense: The cauthooj senses all non-[[trait.mindless|mindless]] creatures at the listed range.
creature.cauthooj.abilities.warbling-son:
The cauthooj gives a strange, ululating cry that causes nearby creatures to lash out violently and without control. Each creature within a 120-foot emanation that can hear the cauthooj must attempt a DC 32 Will save to resist the effect.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target is [[condition.confused|confused]] for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target is confused for 1 round and immediately attacks itself (in the normal fashion for attacking oneself while confused). This Strike doesn't give the creature a flat check to recover from the confusion.

creature.cave-bear.abilities.mauler.name: Mauler
creature.cave-bear.abilities.mauler.text: The bear gains a +4 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures it has [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]].
creature.cave-bear.abilities.rush.name: Rush
creature.cave-bear.abilities.rush.text: The cave bear Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. During the Stride, it gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed.
creature.cave-bear.name: Cave Bear
creature.cave-bear.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.cave-bear.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.cave-worm.abilities.cave-worm-v: **Saving Throw** DC 32 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 5d6 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 2]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 6d6 poison damage, and enfeebled 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 8d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)
The cave worm recovers from the [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]], [[condition.slowed|slowed]], and [[condition.stunned|stunned]] conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.
creature.cave-worm.abilities.regurgitate:
The cave worm can violently regurgitate a creature or boulder it has swallowed to make a ranged Strike. The Strike deals bludgeoning damage depending on the size of the projectile: Tiny deals 2d6+13, Small 3d6+13, Medium 4d6+13, Large 5d6+13, and Huge 6d6+13. A regurgitated creature takes falling damage from the height of the target or from 20 feet, whichever is greater.

Boulders occupy space in the worm's stomach as a creature of equivalent size, and cave worms often have several boulders swallowed. A cave worm can use a single action to swallow a new boulder.
creature.cave-worm.abilities.rock-tunnel: A cave worm can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does.
creature.cave-worm.abilities.slough-skin: The cave worm negates the triggering condition or effect by sloughing an outer layer of its skin. Effects from [[trait.artifact|artifacts]], deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way.
The cave worm would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as [[spell.cursed-metamorphosis|cursed metamorphosis]])
creature.cave-worm.abilities.thrash.name: Thrash
creature.cave-worm.abilities.thrash.text: The worm attempts one Strike against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws, up to once with its stinger, and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the worm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.
creature.cave-worm.name: Cave Worm
creature.cave-worm.strikes.body.name: body
creature.cave-worm.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.cave-worm.strikes.stinger.name: stinger
creature.centaur-herbalist.abilities.loa: The centaur herbalist has at least one herbal sachet
The centaur herbalist Interacts to load an herbal sachet in her sling. The next ranged Strike she makes with her sling deals an additional 1d6 poison damage.
creature.centaur-herbalist.items.1.name: herbal sachet
creature.centaur-herbalist.name: Centaur Herbalist
creature.centipede-swarm.abilities.centi: **Saving Throw** DC 20 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison damage and [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d8 poison damage, [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]], and off-guard (1 round)
creature.centipede-swarm.abilities.swarm: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 1d8 piercing damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save) plus centipede swarm venom.
creature.centipede-swarm.name: Centipede Swarm
creature.changeling-exile.name: Changeling Exile
creature.changeling-exile.saves.note: +2 circumstance to all saves vs. [[trait.dream|dream]] and [[trait.sleep|sleep]]
creature.charnel-creation.abilities.bers: The charnel creation Strikes with its fist at a –1 circumstance penalty. If it hits, it deals 1d6 extra damage and knocks the target [[condition.prone|prone]].

A severely damaged charnel creation has a chance of going berserk. If it has 40 or fewer HP at the start of its turn, the creation must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or go berserk. A berserk creation wildly attacks the nearest living creature, or the nearest object if no creatures are nearby. A creation loses its immunity to [[trait.mental|mental]] effects while berserk.
creature.charnel-creation.abilities.elec: Any time a charnel creation would be affected by an effect with the [[trait.electricity|electricity]] trait, it loses any [[condition.slowed|slowed]] condition it has and gains HP equal to half the damage the spell would have dealt. If the creation starts its turn in an area that deals electricity damage, it gains 2d4 HP.

The creation lashes out and tries to grab a nearby creature. The creation attempts an [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check to [[action.grapple|Grapple]] a creature within reach. The creature also takes 3d6 electricity damage on a success, or 6d6 electricity damage on a critical success.
The creation would be affected by an effect with the [[trait.electricity|electricity]] trait and a creature is in its reach
creature.charnel-creation.name: Charnel Creation
creature.chimera.abilities.draconic-bite: A chimera's dragon head deals an extra 2d6 damage of a type matching the damage dealt by its Dragon Breath.
creature.chimera.abilities.dragon-breath:
The chimera breathes a cone or line that deals 9d6 damage to all creatures in the area (DC 26 basic save of a type indicated below). The chimera's dragon head is linked to one of the traditions of magic, which determines the area of its Dragon Breath, the type of damage it deals, and the type of save to avoid it. This ability gains the related traits. The chimera can't use Dragon Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
- Arcane 60-foot line of [[trait.force|force]] (Reflex)
- Divine 60-foot line of [[trait.spirit|spirit]] (Reflex); this ability can also have the [[trait.holy|holy]] or [[trait.unholy|unholy]] trait
- Occult 30-foot cone of [[trait.mental|mental]] (Will)
- Primal 30-foot cone of [[trait.acid|acid]], [[trait.cold|cold]], [[trait.electricity|electricity]], [[trait.fire|fire]], or [[trait.sonic|sonic]] (Reflex); or [[trait.poison|poison]] (Fortitude)
creature.chimera.abilities.multiple-reac: A chimera gains 2 extra reactions each round that it can use only to make Reactive Strikes. It must use a different head for each reaction, and it can't use more than one on the same triggering action. If it loses one of its heads, it also loses one of these extra reactions.
creature.chimera.abilities.three-headed-: The chimera makes a Strike with its dragon jaws, lion jaws, and goat horns, each at a –2 penalty and targeting a different creature. These Strikes count as only one attack for the chimera's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after it has made all three attacks.
Any ability that would sever a chimera's head (such as a critical hit with a vorpal weapon) severs one head at random. Losing a head doesn't kill a chimera (as long as it has one head left), but it does prevent it from making Strikes with the lost head or using the head's Dragon Breath.
creature.chimera.name: Chimera
creature.chimera.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.chimera.strikes.goat-horns.name: goat horns
creature.chimera.strikes.lion-jaws.name: lion jaws
creature.choral.abilities.deafening-aria: On a critical hit with piercing hymn, the target is [[condition.deafened|deafened]] for 1 minute.
creature.choral.abilities.harmonize.name: Harmonize
creature.choral.abilities.harmonize.text: The choral angel lends their harmony to a choral angel ally within their harmonizing aura. The ally can, on their next turn, expend their 3rd-rank [[spell.noise-blast|noise blast]] to instead cast [[spell.calm|calm]], [[spell.heroism|heroism]], or 4th-rank noise blast. If the ally is benefiting from 5 or more chorals' Harmonize actions, they can instead choose [[spell.divine-decree|divine decree]].
creature.choral.abilities.harmonizing-au: 20 feet. Allies in the aura gain a +2 status bonus to sonic damage rolls and a +1 status bonus to AC and all saves against effects with the [[trait.auditory|auditory]] or [[trait.sonic|sonic]] trait. Enemies in the aura take a –2 status penalty to sonic damage rolls and a –1 status penalty to AC and all saves against sonic and auditory effects.
creature.choral.name: Choral
creature.choral.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.chupacabra.abilities.pounce.tex: The chupacabra Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the chupacabra began this action [[condition.hidden|hidden]], it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.
creature.chupacabra.abilities.suck-blood: The chupacabra sucks blood from the grabbed creature. The chupacabra gains the [[condition.quickened|quickened]] condition for 1 minute and can use the extra action only for Strike and Stride actions. A chupacabra can't Suck Blood again while it is quickened in this way. A creature that has its blood drained by a chupacabra is [[condition.drained|drained 1]] until it receives healing (of any kind or amount).
creature.chupacabra.name: Chupacabra
creature.chupacabra.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.chupacabra.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.cinder-rat.abilities.fetid-fume: 5 feet. A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn there must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude save or become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]]. Everything within the aura, including the cinder rat, is [[condition.concealed|concealed]] by smoke.
creature.cinder-rat.abilities.smoke-visi: The cinder rat ignores the [[condition.concealed|concealed]] condition from smoke.
creature.cinder-rat.name: Cinder Rat
creature.cinder-rat.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
A 20-foot emanation of spiritual energy pushes against intruders, as though trying to drive their souls away. Each creature in the area takes 8d6 spirit damage depending on a DC 29 Will save. The clay effigy can't Cast Out again for 1d4 rounds.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and 3d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent spirit damage]]. The persistent damage ends if the creature moves over 60 feet from the clay effigy or the effigy is destroyed.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the persistent damage is increased to 6d6.
creature.clay-effigy.abilities.effigys-c: When a creature damages the clay effigy, it must succeed at a DC 27 Will save or be afflicted with the effigy's curse. The accursed becomes [[condition.fatigued|fatigued]] when it carries part of the effigy or any item the effigy was assigned to guard. This fatigue can't be removed until the creature has given up such items for at least 24 hours.
creature.clay-effigy.abilities.heavy-str: The clay effigy Strides and can move through the spaces of Medium and smaller creatures. Each creature it moves through must succeed at a DC 29 Reflex save or be knocked [[condition.prone|prone]].
creature.clay-effigy.abilities.sacred-ar: The creator of a clay effigy can dedicate the effigy to a deity while constructing it. If the deity allows a divine sanctification, the effigy is sanctified to that deity, gaining the [[trait.holy|holy]] or [[trait.unholy|unholy]] trait as appropriate.
creature.clay-effigy.name: Clay Effigy
creature.clay-effigy.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.cloud-giant.abilities.cloudsigh: Cloud giants ignore [[condition.concealed|concealment]] from weather conditions, including clouds and rain.
creature.cloud-giant.abilities.crushing-: The cloud giant solidifies some clouds, including fog or mist, around a creature that's already in a cloud up to 120 feet away. The target takes 3d8 bludgeoning damage (DC 30 basic Fortitude save). If it fails its save, it treats clouds as difficult terrain for 1 round.
creature.cloud-giant.abilities.wind-stri:
The cloud giant Strikes a creature with their ranseur, surrounded in a roar of rushing air. On a hit, the target takes an additional 4d8 bludgeoning damage and is [[condition.deafened|deafened]] for 1 minute. Whether or not the Strike hits, each non-cloud giant within a 20-foot emanation, including the target of the Strike, is buffeted by roaring winds and must attempt a DC 30 Fortitude saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes 2d8 sonic damage.

**Failure** The creature takes 4d8 sonic damage and is deafened until the end of its next turn.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but double damage and also knocked [[condition.prone|prone]].
creature.cloud-giant.name: Cloud Giant
creature.cloud-giant.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.coarti.abilities.blood-contract: When the coarti takes damage from their holy weakness, blood flows freely from their eyes and the contract carved into their skin. They take 1d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] and are [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]] as long as the persistent damage continues, but their Despairing Shriek recharges.
creature.coarti.abilities.despairing-shr: The coarti lets out a terrible cry, dealing 4d6 sonic damage to all creatures in a 30-foot emanation with a DC 25 basic Will save. [[trait.holy|Holy]] creatures that fail this save are also [[condition.frightened|frightened 2]]; this added effect has the [[trait.emotion|emotion]], [[trait.fear|fear]], and [[trait.mental|mental]] traits. The coarti can't use Despairing Shriek again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.coarti.abilities.wing-snap.name: Wing Snap
creature.coarti.abilities.wing-snap.text: The coarti makes two wing Strikes, then falls if it's flying. It can't Fly until the end of its turn.
creature.coarti.name: Coarti
creature.coarti.strikes.morningstar.name: morningstar
creature.coarti.strikes.wing.name: wing
creature.cockatrice.abilities.calcificat:
A peck from a cockatrice hardens the flesh of the creature struck. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or become [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (or slowed 2 on a critical failure). Further failed saves against calcification increase the slowed condition. Once a creature's actions are reduced to 0 by calcification, that creature becomes [[condition.petrified|petrified]]. If the creature isn't petrified, the slowed conditions end once 1 minute passes without the creature failing a save against calcification.

Every 24 hours after it was petrified, the victim can attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save to recover. On a success, it becomes flesh again, but is slowed 1 for the next 24 hours. On a critical success, the creature recovers and isn't slowed. On a failure, the creature remains petrified but can try again in 24 hours. On a critical failure, the petrification is permanent, and the creature can't attempt any more saves.
creature.cockatrice.name: Cockatrice
creature.cockatrice.strikes.beak.name: beak
creature.coil-spy.abilities.deceptive-re: The Coil spy Strides up to half their Speed and attempts a [[action.feint|Feint]], in either order.
creature.coil-spy.abilities.maintain-dis: A Coil spy can maintain an ongoing [[spell.illusory-disguise|illusory disguise]] as long as they are conscious without having to re-cast the spell; they need only Cast the Spell again to reassume their illusory disguise if they wish to change their appearance or if the active spell is dispelled. Coil spies typically seek privacy when they need to sleep, as an ongoing illusory disguise ends an hour after they fall unconscious.
creature.coil-spy.abilities.serpentfolk-: **Saving Throw** DC 19 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d4 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)
creature.coil-spy.abilities.sneak-attack: The Coil spy's Strikes deal an extra 2d6 precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.coil-spy.abilities.thin-of-bloo: Zyss serpentfolk recover slowly from injuries. When they take physical damage from a critical hit, they gain 1d4 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]]. They take a –2 circumstance penalty to flat checks to recover from persistent damage and saving throws against afflictions.
creature.coil-spy.name: Coil Spy
creature.coil-spy.saves.note: Will +4 status vs. [[trait.mental|mental]]; +1 status to all saves vs. [[trait.magical|magic]]
creature.coil-spy.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.compsognathus.abilities.compsog: **Saving Throw** DC 16 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 4 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d8 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)
creature.compsognathus.name: Compsognathus
creature.compsognathus.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.con-rit.abilities.con-rit-venom: **Saving Throw** DC 25 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d10 poison (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d10 poison and [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d10 poison, off-guard, and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 round)
creature.con-rit.abilities.spit-venom.te: The con rit spits a propulsive blast of venom that deals 2d10 poison and 2d10 bludgeoning damage in a 30-foot line (DC 25 basic Fortitude save). Creatures who fail their save are also pushed 10 feet. The con rit cannot use Spit Venom again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.con-rit.abilities.undulate.name: Undulate
creature.con-rit.abilities.undulate.text: The con rit Swims. During this movement, it can pass through spaces as narrow as 5 feet without [[action.squeeze|Squeezing]].
creature.con-rit.name: Con Rit
creature.con-rit.strikes.mandible.name: mandible
creature.crag-linnorm.abilities.crag-lin: **Saving Throw** DC 34 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 10 rounds; **Stage 1** 4d6 fire damage and [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 6d6 fire damage and drained 2 (1 round)
creature.crag-linnorm.abilities.curse-of: When a creature slays the crag linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 35 Will save or gain weakness to fire 15 with an unlimited duration.
creature.crag-linnorm.abilities.magma-br: The crag linnorm breathes out a stream of magma in a 120-foot line that deals 12d6 fire damage to creatures within the area (DC 34 basic Reflex save). Any creature that fails its save also takes 4d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent fire damage]]. The linnorm can't use Magma Breath again for 1d4 rounds. The magma remains until the start of the linnorm's next turn. If the linnorm was on the ground, the magma remains as a burning line on the ground directly under the line of the Magma Breath; if the linnorm was airborne, the magma rains down in a sheet 60 feet high. Any creature that moves across or through the magma takes 6d6 fire damage (DC 34 basic Reflex save). At the start of the linnorm's next turn, the magma cools to a thin layer of brittle stone, or the magma rain finishes falling and turns to harmless pebbles. The cooled magma quickly degrades to powder and sand over the course of several hours.
creature.crag-linnorm.name: Crag Linnorm
creature.crag-linnorm.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.crag-linnorm.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.crag-linnorm.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.crawling-hand.abilities.mark-qu: A crawling hand can be assigned a quarry by anointing the hand with a drop of the intended quarry's blood. If the hand ever has no quarry, it automatically gains the next creature it damages as its quarry. The hand gains a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when it [[action.seek|Seeks]] its quarry, to [[skill.survival|Survival]] checks when it [[action.track|Tracks]] its quarry, and to damage rolls when it Strikes its quarry.
creature.crawling-hand.abilities.throat-: This ability functions as [[ability.grab|Grab]], but the crawling hand grips the throat of a Medium or smaller creature. A creature [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]] this way has difficulty speaking and must spend an extra action to perform any action that requires speaking, including casting spells.
creature.crawling-hand.name: Crawling Hand
creature.crawling-hand.strikes.claw.name: claw
The crocodile must have a creature [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]]

The crocodile tucks its legs and rolls rapidly, twisting its victim. It makes a jaws Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll against the grabbed creature. If it hits, it also knocks the creature [[condition.prone|prone]]. If it fails, it releases the creature.
creature.crocodile.abilities.deep-breath: The crocodile can hold its breath for about 2 hours.
creature.crocodile.name: Crocodile
creature.crocodile.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.crocodile.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.cuckoo-hag.abilities.change-sha: The cuckoo hag can take on the appearance of any Medium female [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]]. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.cuckoo-hag.abilities.coven.name: Coven
creature.cuckoo-hag.abilities.coven.text: A cuckoo hag adds [[spell.dominate|dominate]], [[spell.nightmare|nightmare]], [[spell.outcasts-curse|outcast's curse]], and [[spell.scrying|scrying]] to their coven's spells.
creature.cuckoo-hag.abilities.cuckoos-la:
A cuckoo hag is intrinsically connected to a pocket dimension that serves as their home domain. The lair is an extradimensional space that is 40 feet wide, 40 feet deep, and 30 feet tall. It contains whatever mundane food, buildings, landscapes, and objects that the cuckoo hag desires, though anything removed from the cuckoo's lair dissolves into nothingness instantly.

In order to enter or leave the plane, the cuckoo hag must create a door in the physical world as a single action, which has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] and [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]] traits. The door is [[condition.invisible|invisible]] by default, though the cuckoo hag can choose a target creature that can perceive the door normally. The cuckoo hag can Dismiss this door from reality, but only if they (and no other creature) are inside of their lair and alone.
creature.cuckoo-hag.abilities.soul-coven: The cuckoo hag can cast [[spell.seize-soul|seize soul]] at will, but only to target a creature who has agreed to stay with them forever. They typically do so as soon as the agreement is made but might hold off to gain leverage over a situation. They typically place the soul into a construct, typically a [[creature.soulbound-doll|soulbound doll]] if they want a companion or a more powerful construct if they want a guardian.
creature.cuckoo-hag.abilities.sound-imit: A cuckoo hag who succeeds at a [[skill.deception|Deception]] check to [[action.lie|Lie]] can mimic the sound of any feminine voice they have heard (in cases where this may be unclear, the GM is the final arbiter) and have a +4 circumstance bonus to this check.
creature.cuckoo-hag.name: Cuckoo Hag
creature.cuckoo-hag.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.cyclops.abilities.ferocity.name: Ferocity
creature.cyclops.abilities.flash-of-insi: The cyclops peers into an occluded spectrum of possible futures. They get a success (but not a critical success) on the roll instead of rolling.
The cyclops is about to roll a d20
creature.cyclops.abilities.swipe.name: Swipe
creature.cyclops.abilities.swipe.text: The cyclops makes a melee Strike and compares the attack roll result to the AC of up to two foes, each of whom must be within their melee reach and adjacent to each other. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature hit. A Swipe counts as two attacks for the cyclops's multiple attack penalty.
creature.cyclops.name: Cyclops
creature.cyclops.strikes.greataxe.name: greataxe
creature.cythnigot.abilities.sickening-d:
The cythnigot presents its awful appearance fully, and creatures in a 10-foot emanation must attempt a DC 17 Will save. Once a creature attempts this save, it's temporarily immune to further Sickening Displays for 1 minute.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] until its next turn.

**Failure** The creature is [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] and is off-guard for as long as it's sickened.

**Critical Failure** As failure but sickened 2.
creature.cythnigot.abilities.tangle-spor: A creature bitten by a cythnigot becomes afflicted by fast-growing spores that swiftly grow into twitching spikes and hideous pallid growths of hairlike fibers. These growths erupt from the bite wound and writhe and wrap around the creature's limbs. [[trait.plant|Plant]] creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to save against tangle spores; **Saving Throw** DC 17 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** clumsy 1 and [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] (1 round); **Stage 3** clumsy 2, off-guard, and if you attempt a [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]] action, you must succeed at a DC 5 flat check or it's lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied (1 round).
creature.cythnigot.name: Cythnigot
creature.cythnigot.strikes.bite.name: bite
creature.daeodon.abilities.daeodon-charg: The daeodon Strides twice and then makes a tusk Strike. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll. A Medium or smaller creature struck by this attack must succeed at a DC 19 Reflex save or be knocked [[condition.prone|prone]] by the blow.
creature.daeodon.abilities.ferocity.name: Ferocity
creature.daeodon.name: Daeodon
creature.daeodon.strikes.tusk.name: tusk
creature.deadly-mantis.abilities.fling.t: The deadly mantis flings a [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] creature into the air, up to 30 feet overhead and up to 30 feet away from the mantis (the creature takes damage from the fall as normal). If the flung creature lands on another creature, the creature it lands on takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage with a DC 31 basic Reflex save.
creature.deadly-mantis.abilities.leaping: The mantis Leaps up to 40 feet vertically and 20 feet horizontally. At any point during the jump, it can make a leg Strike. If it hits, it automatically [[ability.grab|Grabs]] the target, bringing the creature along until the end of the jump.
creature.deadly-mantis.abilities.rending: The mantis makes a mandibles Strike against a creature it has [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]]. If that Strike hits and the creature is wearing armor with Hardness 12 or lower, the armor is [[condition.broken|broken]]. This Strike doesn't further damage armor that's already broken.
creature.deadly-mantis.abilities.sudden-: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted are [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to the deadly mantis.
creature.deadly-mantis.name: Deadly Mantis
creature.deadly-mantis.strikes.leg.name: leg
creature.deinonychus.abilities.darting-a: The deinonychus Strides up to 10 feet and then makes a Strike, or makes a Strike and then Strides up to 10 feet.
creature.deinonychus.name: Deinonychus
creature.deinonychus.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.deinonychus.strikes.talon.name: talon
creature.deinosuchus.abilities.deep-brea: A deinosuchus can hold its breath for about 2 hours.
creature.deinosuchus.name: Deinosuchus

If the creature is already sickened, the condition value increases by 1, to a maximum of sickened 4. Once a creature succeeds at its saving throw, it is temporarily immune for 24 hours.
creature.globster.abilities.saturated.te: A globster can survive for 1 hour out of the water, after which it risks suffocation.

the gnome bard plays a ditty that inspires dance. One creature within 30 feet must make a Will saving throw DC 19.

**Success** the target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target must waste 1 action on its next turn dancing.

**Critical Failure** The target must waste 2 actions on its next turn dancing.
creature.gnome-bard.abilities.gnomish-sh: The gnome bard gains resistance 2 to the triggering damage and teleports to an adjacent space.
The gnome bard would take damage
creature.gnome-bard.name: Gnome Bard
creature.gnome-bard.strikes.dagger.name: dagger

creature.goblin-dog.abilities.buck.name: Buck
creature.goblin-dog.abilities.goblin-pox: [[trait.goblin|Goblins]] and goblin dogs are immune to goblin pox; **Saving Throw** DC 17 Fortitude; **Stage 1** sickened 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 round); **Stage 3** sickened 2 and can't reduce its sickened value below 1 (1 day)
creature.goblin-dog.abilities.irritating: A creature that hits a goblin dog with an [[trait.unarmed|unarmed]] attack, tries to [[action.grapple|Grapple]] it, or otherwise touches it is exposed to goblin pox.
creature.goblin-dog.abilities.juke.name: Juke
creature.goblin-dog.abilities.juke.requi: A creature must be mounted on the goblin dog
creature.goblin-dog.abilities.juke.text: The goblin dog Steps before following the command.
creature.goblin-dog.abilities.juke.trigg: The rider issues a command to the goblin dog
creature.goblin-dog.abilities.scratch.te: The goblin dog vigorously scratches itself, exposing all adjacent creatures to goblin pox.

creature.goblin-pyro.strikes.torch.name: torch

The war chanter sings annoying goblin songs, distracting foes with silly and repetitive lyrics. The chanter attempts a [[skill.performance|Performance]] check against the Will DCs of up to two enemies within 30 feet. This has the usual traits and restrictions for a Performance check.

**Critical Success** The target takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves for 1 minute.

**Success** As critical success, but the target is affected for only 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target is temporarily immune to Goblin Song for 1 hour.
creature.goblin-war-chanter.name: Goblin War Chanter

creature.gogiteth.abilities.carry-off-pr: The gogiteth can move at its full Speed while it has a creature [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] in its jaws, bringing the grabbed creature along.
creature.gogiteth.abilities.skittering-a: The gogiteth Strides three times. Once per Stride, it can attempt a leg Strike against a creature in its reach at any point during the Stride; it must make each attack against a different creature, but it doesn't apply its multiple attack penalty until after making all its Strikes. If the result of any of the Strikes is a critical failure, Skittering Assault ends.
creature.gogiteth.abilities.skittering-r: The gogiteth moves 10 feet. This does not trigger reactions.
A creature that starts its move outside the gogiteth's reach moves into its reach
creature.gogiteth.name: Gogiteth
creature.gogiteth.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.gogiteth.strikes.leg.name: leg
creature.goliath-spider.abilities.descen: The goliath spider moves straight down up to 120 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage. A creature that successfully Strikes the web (AC 20, Hardness 5, 20 HP) severs it, causing the spider to fall.
creature.goliath-spider.abilities.goliat: **Saving Throw** DC 30 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d6 poison damage and **slowed 1** (1 round); **Stage 2** 3d8 poison damage and slowed 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 3d10 poison damage and [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] for 2d4 hours
creature.goliath-spider.abilities.spring: Initiative has not yet been rolled
The goliath spider automatically notices the creature and Strides, Climbs, or Descends on a Web before it rolls initiative.
A creature touches the goliath spider's web while the spider is on it
creature.goliath-spider.abilities.web-se: The spider has imprecise [[ability.tremorsense|tremorsense]] to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.
creature.goliath-spider.abilities.web-te: A creature hit by the spider's web Strike is [[condition.restrained|restrained]] and tethered to the spider, preventing it from being moved farther away from the spider. The spider can have one creature tethered at a time. The DC to [[action.escape|Escape]] or [[action.force-open|Force Open]] the web is 30. The tether can be severed with a Strike (AC 20, Hardness 5, HP 20), but this doesn't free the restrained creature.
creature.goliath-spider.name: Goliath Spider
creature.goliath-spider.strikes.web.name: web
creature.gongorinan.abilities.disquietin:
The gongorinan opens its maw to reveal the forms hidden there, making observers question their own bodies. Creatures in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 30 Will save, after which they are temporarily immune to further Disquieting Displays for 1 minute.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]] for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is clumsy 2 and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but for 1 minute.
creature.gongorinan.abilities.gongorinan: **Saving Throw** Fortitude DC 30; **Stage 1** [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] and cosmetic signs appear of turning into an animal, fungus, or plant (1 round); **Stage 2** stupefied 2 and [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 2]] (1 round); **Stage 3** stupefied 4 and clumsy 4 (1 round); **Stage 4** [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] as changes completely overtake the body (1 round); **Stage 5** the victim permanently transforms into an animal, fungus, or plant in mind and body as a permanent curse, and the affliction ends
creature.gongorinan.abilities.painful-li: The gongorinan makes up to four Strikes against different targets, each using a different limb. All four Strikes count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the gongorinan has made all the attacks.
creature.gongorinan.abilities.reject-too: A creature hit by the gongorinan's club must succeed at a DC 30 Will save or [[action.release|Release]] any manufactured items it's holding.
creature.gongorinan.name: Gongorinan
creature.gongorinan.strikes.club.name: club
creature.gongorinan.strikes.pincer.name: pincer
creature.gongorinan.strikes.stinger.name: stinger
creature.gorilla.abilities.frightening-d:
The gorilla beats its chest in a terrifying display. Creatures within 30 feet must attempt a DC 20 Will save. While a creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened]] by this ability, it is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to the gorilla.

**Critical Success** No effect and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is frightened 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 2.
