creature.gosreg.abilities.borrow-languag: The gosreg can read and speak all languages known by creatures within range of its telepathy.
creature.gosreg.abilities.broadcast-stan: the gosreg is in its natural form

The gosreg secures its limbs into the ground as its brain-like head crackles with psychic energy. The gosreg's unsettled aura extends to 60 feet, and it blocks all other creatures' [[ability.telepathy|telepathy]] in the aura. Its Mind Bolt can also affect any number of targets in 60 feet. These effects end when the gosreg uses its claw Strike, leaves its space, or is knocked [[condition.prone|prone]].
creature.gosreg.abilities.change-shape.t: The gosreg takes on the appearance of any Small or Medium [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]]. This doesn't change its Speed or attack and damage modifiers with its claw, but it might change the damage type it deals (typically to bludgeoning). It cannot use its jaws Strike while in humanoid form.
creature.gosreg.abilities.mind-bolt.name: Mind Bolt
creature.gosreg.abilities.mind-bolt.text: A gosreg concentrates its field of discordant mental energy and projects it into the mind of one creature within 60 feet. The target takes 6d6 mental damage (DC 30 basic Will save). On a critical failure, the creature is also [[condition.confused|confused]] for 1 minute or until it takes damage.
creature.gosreg.abilities.thoughtsense.t: The gosreg senses a creature's mental essence as a precise sense with the listed range; it cannot sense [[trait.mindless|mindless]] creatures with thoughtsense.
creature.gosreg.abilities.unsettled-aura: 30 feet. Gosregs project a field of discordant energy that unsettles the minds of thinking creatures. Any non-[[trait.mindless|mindless]] creature within 30 feet of a gosreg takes a –1 status penalty to Will saves.
creature.gosreg.name: Gosreg
creature.gosreg.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.gosreg.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.gourd-leshy.abilities.change-sh: The gourd leshy transforms into a Small gourd-bearing plant. This ability otherwise uses the effects of [[spell.one-with-plants|one with plants]].
creature.gourd-leshy.abilities.ensnare.t: When the gourd leshy damages a creature with a fist or seed Strike, vines lash out from the leshy (or seed) and wrap around the target's limbs. The target must attempt a DC 17 Reflex save. On a failure, the target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed for 1 round; on a critical failure, the target is [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] for 1 round and the penalty to Speed lasts for 1 minute.
The leshy can store an item of light Bulk or less in their head, concealing it as [[spell.veil-of-privacy|veil of privacy]]. If stored for 24 hours, the item benefits from [[spell.mending|mending]].
creature.gourd-leshy.abilities.verdant-b: When a gourd leshy dies, a burst of primal energy explodes from their body, restoring 1d8 Hit Points to each [[trait.plant|plant]] creature in a 30-foot emanation. This area is filled with gourds, becoming difficult terrain. If the terrain is not a viable environment for these plants, they wither after 24 hours.
creature.gourd-leshy.name: Gourd Leshy
creature.gourd-leshy.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.gourd-leshy.strikes.seed.name: seed
creature.graveknight.name: Graveknight
creature.great-cyclops.abilities.flash-o: once per day, and recharges when the great cyclops uses Ferocity
The attack becomes a critical success.
The great cyclops succeeds at an attack roll
creature.great-cyclops.abilities.powerfu: The great cyclops Strides twice and makes a horn Strike. If they moved at least 20 feet away from their starting position, the Strike's damage is increased to 3d10+20.
creature.great-cyclops.name: Great Cyclops
creature.great-cyclops.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.great-cyclops.strikes.horn.name: horn
creature.great-cyclops.strikes.rock.name: rock
creature.great-white-shark.abilities.blo: The shark can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.
creature.great-white-shark.abilities.bre: The shark Swims up to its swim Speed, then [[action.leap|Leaps]] vertically out of the water up to 25 feet high, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 30 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the shark splashes back down into the water.
creature.great-white-shark.abilities.sav: The shark hit with a jaws Strike on its most recent action this turn
The creature the shark hit takes 1d12 slashing damage.
creature.great-white-shark.abilities.str: The shark Swims up to half its swim Speed, makes a jaws Strike, and then Swims up to half its Speed further. The Strike deals half damage.
creature.great-white-shark.name: Great White Shark
creature.greater-hell-hound.abilities.he: The hell hound breathes flames that deal 10d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 15-foot cone (DC 28 basic Reflex save.) The hell hound can't use Hellfire Breath again for 1d4 rounds. If the greater hell hound would take fire damage or be targeted by a [[trait.fire|fire]] effect, their Hellfire Breath recharges.
The greater hell hound's Hellfire Breath recharges. They can immediately use it as part of this reaction.
The greater hell hound is critically hit by any Strike
creature.greater-hell-hound.abilities.pa: The greater hell hound's Strikes deal 1d8 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of their allies.
creature.greater-hell-hound.name: Greater Hell Hound
creature.greater-nightmare.abilities.fla: The nightmare Strides or [[action.fly|Flies]] up to triple its Speed. Its hooves burst with intense flame, dealing 6d6 fire damage with a DC 30 basic Reflex save to each creature other than the nightmare's rider that the nightmare moves adjacent to during its gallop. Each creature can be affected only once during a single use of Flaming Gallop.
creature.greater-nightmare.abilities.smo:
20 feet. The nightmare continually exhales black smoke. Creatures within the aura are [[condition.concealed|concealed]] to those outside it, and creatures outside the aura are concealed to creatures within it. Nightmares and their riders can see through this smoke.

A creature that begins its turn in the area must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude save or be [[condition.sickened|sickened 2]]. It's then temporarily immune to being sickened by the smoke for 1 minute. This is an [[trait.inhaled|inhaled]] [[trait.poison|poison]], and the nightmare and its rider are immune to it.
creature.greater-nightmare.name: Greater Nightmare
creature.greater-shadow.abilities.light-: Attacks against the shadow are treated as [[trait.magical|magical]] if made by a creature who is in magical light or with an object that is in magical light (such as from the [[spell.light|light]] spell).
creature.greater-shadow.abilities.shadow: When a creature's shadow is pulled free by Steal Shadow, it becomes a shadow spawn under the command of the shadow that created it. This shadow spawn doesn't have Steal Shadow. If the creature the shadow spawn was pulled from dies, the shadow spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous shadow. If the creature recovers from its enfeeblement, its shadow returns to it and the shadow spawn is extinguished.
creature.greater-shadow.abilities.slink-: The shadow can [[action.hide|Hide]] or end its [[action.sneak|Sneak]] in a creature's or object's shadow.
creature.greater-shadow.abilities.steal-: The shadow hit a living creature with a shadow hand Strike on its previous action

The shadow pulls at the target's shadow, making the creature [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 2]] (or enfeebled 3 on a critical hit). This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from shadows, to a maximum of enfeebled 4. If this increases a creature's enfeebled value to 3 or more, the target's shadow is separated from its body (see shadow spawn). The enfeebled value from Steal Shadow decreases by 1 every hour.
creature.greater-shadow.name: Greater Shadow
creature.griffon.abilities.flying-strafe: The griffon [[action.fly|Flies]] up to its fly Speed and makes two talon Strikes at any point during that movement. Each Strike must target a different creature. The attacks take the normal multiple attack penalty.
creature.griffon.abilities.pounce.name: Pounce
creature.griffon.abilities.pounce.text: The griffon Strides and makes a talon Strike at the end of that movement. If the griffon began this action [[condition.hidden|hidden]], it remains hidden until after the attack.
The griffon unleashes a shriek that transitions into a terrifying roar. Each creature in a 60-foot emanation must attempt a DC 20 Will save. Regardless of the result, creatures are temporarily immune to all griffons' Regal Shrieks for 10 minutes.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened 1]].

**Failure** The creature is frightened 2. [[trait.animal|Animals]] are [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for as long as they're frightened.

**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 3. Animals are [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] as long as they're frightened.
creature.griffon.name: Griffon
creature.griffon.strikes.beak.name: beak
creature.griffon.strikes.talon.name: talon
creature.griffon.strikes.wing.name: wing
The grikkitog sinks its barbed teeth into the target, which must succeed at a DC 34 Reflex save or be [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]]. While immobilized, the victim takes 3d8 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] and the grikkitog feeds upon its flesh. The creature is immobilized until the grikkitog ends the effect as a free action or the target succeeds at a DC 38 check to [[action.escape|Escape]]. The grikkitog can immobilize any number of creatures with these maws.
The grikkitog hits a creature with a jaws Strike
creature.grikkitog.abilities.earth-glide: The grikkitog can [[action.burrow|Burrow]] through dirt and stone at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.
creature.grikkitog.abilities.implant-cor: The grikkitog implants its core into an adjacent section of earth or stone, melding seamlessly and changing its visual appearance to match the surrounding rock. It's [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] but automatically succeeds at its [[skill.deception|Deception]] check to [[action.impersonate|Impersonate]] the stone around it; creatures actively searching for it can still attempt Perception checks against its Deception DC as normal. A grikkitog can release its implantation as a free action, which has the [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]] trait. A grikkitog's infestation aura and manifold vision are only active while implanted.
creature.grikkitog.abilities.infestation: 120 feet. While its core is implanted, a grikkitog infests all earth and stone within 120 feet, as long as there is a contiguous physical connection between the earth, including stone objects touching the ground. This effect spreads even if the grikkitog does not have line of effect, though it can affect earth or stone on the surface and exposed to the air only if at least part of its core is exposed as well. Within the aura, it can grow maws and eyes everywhere. It can make jaws attacks against any creature, originating from any earth or stone in the aura adjacent to that creature. Determine cover from the origin point of the attack, not from the grikkitog's core.
creature.grikkitog.abilities.manifold-vi: While its core is implanted, the grikkitog can see through the eyes it creates throughout the area of its infestation aura, gaining the benefits of [[ability.all-around-vision|all-around vision]].
creature.grikkitog.name: Grikkitog
creature.grikkitog.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.aura-of-m: 20 feet. Living creatures in the aura must roll twice on all d20 rolls and use the lower result.
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.death-str: A creature critically hit by any of the Grim Reaper's attacks or that critically fails against any of its spells must succeed at a DC 47 Fortitude save or die.
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.deaths-gr: The Grim Reaper can choose whether or not it counts as [[trait.undead|undead]] for effects that affect undead differently. Even if it does not count as undead, the Grim Reaper still never counts as a living creature.
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.energy-dr: When the Grim Reaper hits and deals damage with its scythe, it regains 20 Hit Points, and the target must succeed at a DC 43 Fortitude save or become [[condition.doomed|doomed 1]]. If the target is already doomed, the doomed value increases by 1 (to a maximum of doomed 3).
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.final-dea: A creature killed by the Grim Reaper can't be brought back to life by any means short of divine intervention.
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.infuse-we: Any scythe gains the [[trait.agile|agile]] trait, can't be disarmed, and becomes a +3 [[item.striking-major|major striking]] keen scythe while the Grim Reaper wields it. If the Grim Reaper Strikes a creature with a weakness to any specific type of damage, the scythe's damage counts as that type of damage, in addition to slashing.
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.lurking-d: The Grim Reaper teleports to a square adjacent to the triggering creature and makes a melee Strike against it. If the Strike hits, the Grim Reaper disrupts the triggering action.
A creature within 100 feet makes a ranged attack or uses an action that has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]], [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]], or [[trait.move|move]] trait
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.status-si: The Grim Reaper automatically knows the Hit Points, conditions, afflictions, and emotions of all creatures it can see.
creature.grim-reaper.abilities.void-heal: The Grim Reaper can choose whether or not it takes vitality damage.
creature.grim-reaper.name: Grim Reaper
creature.grindylow.abilities.clinging-su: When a grindylow successfully Grabs a creature larger than themself, they attach to that creature. The [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] creature is not [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]], but if it moves, the grindylow moves with it. If the creature is Medium or smaller, it takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds while the grindylow is attached. The grindylow is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] while attached to a creature.
creature.grindylow.abilities.jet.name: Jet
creature.grindylow.abilities.jet.text: The grindylow moves up to 60 feet in a straight line through the water without triggering reactions.
creature.grindylow.abilities.reactive-st: A grindylow gains 1 extra reaction at the start of each of their turns that they can use only to make a Reactive Strike with a tentacle. They can't use more than one Reactive Strike triggered by the same action or choice.
creature.grindylow.name: Grindylow
creature.grindylow.strikes.bite.name: bite
creature.grindylow.strikes.spear-2.name: spear
creature.grindylow.strikes.spear.name: spear
creature.grindylow.strikes.tentacle.name: tentacle
creature.grizzly-bear.abilities.mauler.t: The grizzly bear gains a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures it has [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]].
creature.grizzly-bear.abilities.rush.tex: The grizzly bear Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. During the Stride, the grizzly bear gains a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its Speed.
creature.grizzly-bear.name: Grizzly Bear
creature.grizzly-bear.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.grizzly-bear.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.grothlut.abilities.disgusting-d: When the grothlut is reduced to 0 Hit Points, its digestive organs rupture, unleashing alchemical acid and poison upon all creatures in a 30-foot emanation. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save or take 2d6 acid damage and become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (double damage and sickened 2 on a critical failure).
creature.grothlut.abilities.piteous-moan: 60 feet. Each non-grothlut creature that enters or starts its turn within the area must succeed at a DC 17 Will saving throw or become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (sickened 2 on a critical failure). The creature then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute. The grothlut can Dismiss this aura. A grothlut usually does not begin moaning until it senses the presence of a non-grothlut creature, and it usually stops once it doesn't sense any more such creatures.
creature.grothlut.name: Grothlut
creature.grothlut.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.guard-dog.abilities.pack-attack: The dog's Strikes deal 1d4 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the dog's allies.
creature.guard-dog.name: Guard Dog
creature.guard-dog.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.guthallath.abilities.annihilati: A guthallath releases two beams of destruction from its eyes. Each beam is a 120-foot line. Everything in either line takes 13d10 damage with a DC 41 basic Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is reduced to a fine powder as the [[spell.disintegrate|disintegrate]] spell. There is no additional effect on creatures in any area where the beams overlap. The guthallath can't use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.guthallath.abilities.deadly-thr: The guthallath has a creature [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]]

The guthallath throws the creature into the air, 100 feet high and 50 feet away. If the flung creature lands on another creature, the creature it lands on takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage. The creature being landed on can attempt a DC 41 basic Reflex save.
creature.guthallath.abilities.erosion-au: 120 feet. The guthallath erodes away the physical integrity of all around it. Creatures and objects in the emanation other than the guthallath have their Hardness and resistances reduced by 10. At the start of their turn, a creature in the erosion aura's area takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC 39 basic Fortitude save.
creature.guthallath.abilities.immunity-t: The guthallath is immune to spells of 6th rank or lower and activations of magic items of 13th level or lower.
creature.guthallath.abilities.powerful-b: If a guthallath hits with an attack and rolls a natural 19 on the d20 roll, the attack is a critical hit. This has no effect if the 19 would be a failure.
creature.guthallath.name: Guthallath
creature.guthallath.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.guthallath.strikes.foot.name: foot
creature.gylou.abilities.change-shape.te: The gylou adopts the appearance of any Small or Medium [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]]. This doesn't change their Speed or the attack and damage modifiers of their Strikes, but it might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.gylou.abilities.encage-in-tenta: The gylou has a Medium or smaller creature [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]]

The gylou transfers the grabbed creature into their lower body's net of encaging tentacles, freeing their limbs and tentacles to make Strikes. This has the same effects as [[ability.swallow-whole|Swallow Whole]] (Medium, 2d12+12 bludgeoning, Rupture 30; page 360), except the encaged creature is not at risk of suffocation, and the gylou can bring the encaged creature with them when they cast [[spell.translocate|translocate]]. A gylou can have only one creature encaged at a time.
creature.gylou.abilities.indispensable-s: The gylou demonstrates a preternatural ability for the task at hand. They use their [[skill.deception|Deception]] modifier for the triggering check and for all skill checks using the same skill thereafter until the next time the gylou uses this ability or until 24 hours have passed, whichever happens first.
The gylou attempts a skill check but hasn't rolled yet
The gylou lashes out with a tentacle, attempting to [[action.grapple|Grapple]] the triggering creature. If the triggering Strike was with a melee weapon, the attacking creature can Release the weapon to cause the gylou to automatically fail the [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check.
A creature leaves a square within the gylou's reach using a [[trait.move|move]] action or attempts a melee Strike against the gylou
creature.gylou.name: Gylou

Whenever the halfling targets a creature that is [[condition.concealed|concealed]] or hidden from them, reduce the DC of the flat check to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one.
creature.halfling-street-watcher.name: Halfling Street Watcher
creature.halfling-troublemaker.abilities: the halfling troublemaker throws an egg filled with paint, glitter, and confetti at a creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed a DC 17 Reflex saving throw or become [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]] for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

The halfling gains a +2 circumstance bonus when using the [[action.seek|Seek]] action to find [[condition.hidden|hidden]] or [[condition.undetected|undetected]] creatures within 30 feet of it. The troublemaker deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.

creature.harpy.abilities.hungry-winds.te: The harpy uses the wind to pull its prey closer. A target within 20 feet must succeed at a DC 21 Fortitude save or be pulled adjacent to the harpy, where they make a jaws Strike against the target. If the target was pulled off the ground and can't fly, it then falls as normal.
creature.harpy.abilities.putrid-plague.t: The [[condition.sickened|sickened]] and [[condition.unconscious|unconscious]] conditions from putrid plague can't end or be reduced until the disease is cured; **Saving Throw** DC 19 Fortitude; **Stage 1** carrier with no ill effect (1d4 hours), **Stage 2** sickened 1 (1 day), **Stage 3** sickened 1 and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 day), **Stage 4** unconscious (1 day), **Stage 5** dead
creature.harpy.abilities.stench.name: Stench
When a harpy speaks, they can choose one creature within 90 feet. That creature can hear the harpy's words over any other sound, but no other creature hears the words at all.
creature.harpy.name: Harpy
creature.harpy.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.harpy.strikes.talon.name: talon
creature.hell-hound.abilities.hellfire-b: The hell hound breathes flames that deal 4d6 fire damage to all creatures in a 15-foot cone (DC 19 basic Reflex save). The hell hound can't use Hellfire Breath again for 1d4 rounds. If the hell hound would take fire damage or be targeted by a [[trait.fire|fire]] effect, their Hellfire Breath recharges.
creature.hell-hound.abilities.pack-attac: The hell hound's Strikes deal 1d4 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the hell hounds' allies.
creature.hell-hound.name: Hell Hound
creature.hell-hound.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.herexen.abilities.final-blasphe: When the herexen is destroyed, it explodes in a wave of void energy with the effects of a 3-action [[spell.harm|harm]] spell (DC 18). The herexen is destroyed, so it doesn't gain any Hit Points from this use of harm, and it doesn't need to have any harm spells remaining to use this ability.
creature.herexen.abilities.heretics-smit: While wielding the favored weapon of its former deity (such as a [[item.dagger|dagger]] for an ex-Pharasmin herexen), the herexen's Strikes deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage to creatures with the [[trait.holy|holy]] trait.
creature.herexen.items.1.name: defiled religious symbol
creature.herexen.name: Herexen

creature.hippocampus.abilities.buck.name: Buck
creature.hippocampus.abilities.sudden-re: The hippocampus makes a tail Strike, then Swims with a +10-foot circumstance bonus to its swim Speed. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.
creature.hippocampus.name: Hippocampus
creature.hippocampus.strikes.tail.name: tail

creature.hippogriff.abilities.flying-str: The hippogriff [[action.fly|Flies]] up to its fly speed and makes two talon Strikes at any point during that movement. Each Strike must target a different creature. The attacks take the normal multiple attack penalty.
creature.hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
creature.hippogriff.strikes.beak.name: beak
creature.hippogriff.strikes.talon.name: talon
creature.hippogriff.strikes.wing.name: wing
creature.hobgoblin-archer.abilities.cros: The first time the archer hits with a crossbow attack in a round, it deals 1d8 extra precision damage.
creature.hobgoblin-archer.abilities.form: When they're adjacent to at least two other allies, the hobgoblin archer gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 to Reflex saves against area effects.
creature.hobgoblin-archer.abilities.perf: The hobgoblin archer ignores the [[condition.concealed|concealed]] condition. Their targets don't benefit from lesser cover, and they reduce the AC bonus from standard cover by 2 against the hobgoblin archer's attack.
creature.hobgoblin-archer.abilities.runn: The archer Strides, Steps, or [[action.sneak|Sneaks]], then Interacts to reload.
creature.hobgoblin-archer.name: Hobgoblin Archer
creature.hobgoblin-general.abilities.for: When they're adjacent to at least two other allies, the hobgoblin general gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 to Reflex saves against area effects.
creature.hobgoblin-general.abilities.gen: When a hobgoblin general rolls initiative, as long as they can perceive at least one foe, they can yell a mighty battle cry. The hobgoblin general attempts an [[skill.intimidation|Intimidation]] check to [[action.demoralize|Demoralize]] a single foe within 60 feet as a free action. If successful, any ally can, as its first action on its first turn of the combat, Stride up to double its speed as a single action.
creature.hobgoblin-general.abilities.pol: On a critical hit, the target of the critical hit is moved 5 feet in a direction of the hobgoblin general's choice.
creature.hobgoblin-general.name: Hobgoblin General
creature.hobgoblin-soldier.abilities.for: When they're adjacent to at least two other allies, the hobgoblin soldier gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 to Reflex saves against area effects.
creature.hobgoblin-soldier.name: Hobgoblin Soldier
creature.homunculus.abilities.homunculus: A homunculus has one dose of poison in a reservoir in its head. It can refill this poison from its reserves with an Interact action; **Saving Throw** DC 15 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round).
creature.homunculus.abilities.master-lin: A homunculus can't speak, but it is telepathically linked to its creator. It can share information back and forth, including its master's knowledge and everything the homunculus hears. The range of this link is 1,500 feet. The homunculus typically has a similar attitude to its creator and is utterly faithful. If the homunculus is destroyed, the master takes 2d10 mental damage. If the master is slain, the homunculus becomes [[trait.mindless|mindless]], claims its current location as its lair, and instinctively attacks anyone who comes near.
creature.homunculus.name: Homunculus
creature.homunculus.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.hryngar-bombardier.abilities.al: A hryngar bombardier carries 6 alchemical grenades that deal either acid, cold, or fire damage plus 1 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent damage]] and 1 [[trait.splash|splash]] damage of the same type (typically two of each). The bombardier replenishes these grenades each day using easily collected materials.
creature.hryngar-bombardier.abilities.qu: The hryngar bombardier draws an alchemical grenade with an Interact action and throws it as a ranged Strike.
creature.hryngar-bombardier.name: Hryngar Bombardier
creature.hryngar-bombardier.saves.note: +2 status to all saves vs. magic
This shot deals no damage, but on a hit, the target must succeed at a DC 16 Reflex save or be knocked [[condition.prone|prone]] and become [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] until it is freed with a successful DC 15 check to [[action.escape|Escape]]. This check can be attempted either by the target or a creature adjacent to the target.
creature.hryngar-sharpshooter.name: Hryngar Sharpshooter
creature.hryngar-taskmaster.abilities.ir: Hryngar taskmasters automatically disbelieve all [[trait.illusion|illusions]] of 1st rank or lower.
creature.hryngar-taskmaster.abilities.ta: The hryngar taskmaster smashes their maul into the ground and invokes their deity's name to rally their allies to action. All allied hryngars of equal or lower level that are within 20 feet of the hryngar taskmaster gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls until the end of the hryngar taskmaster's next turn.
creature.hryngar-taskmaster.name: Hryngar Taskmaster
creature.hryngar-taskmaster.saves.note: +2 status to all saves vs. magic, iron mind
creature.hunting-spider.abilities.descen: The hunting spider moves straight down up to 40 feet, suspended by a web line. It can hang from the web or drop off. The distance it Descends on a Web doesn't count for falling damage. A creature that successfully Strikes the web (AC 20, Hardness 3, 5 HP) severs it, causing the spider to fall.
creature.hunting-spider.abilities.huntin: **Saving Throw** DC 16 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d4 poison damage and [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison damage, [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]], and off-guard (1 round); **Stage 3** 1d6 poison damage, clumsy 2, and off-guard (1 round)
creature.hunting-spider.abilities.spring: Initiative has not yet been rolled
The hunting spider automatically notices the creature and Strides, Climbs, or Descends on a Web before it rolls initiative.
A creature touches the hunting spider's web while the spider is on it
creature.hunting-spider.abilities.web-se: The spider has imprecise [[ability.tremorsense|tremorsense]] to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.
creature.hunting-spider.abilities.web-tr: A creature hit by the hunting spider's web Strike is [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[action.escape|Escapes]] (DC 17).
creature.hunting-spider.name: Hunting Spider
creature.hunting-spider.strikes.web.name: web
creature.hyaenodon.abilities.bonecrunchi: A creature that is critically hit by a hyaenodon must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or become [[condition.wounded|wounded 1]] as the creature's bones or cartilage are crushed by the beast's jaws.
creature.hyaenodon.abilities.drag.name: Drag
creature.hyaenodon.abilities.drag.text: The hyaenodon makes a jaws Strike against a [[condition.prone|prone]] enemy. If it hits, in addition to dealing damage, the hyaenodon Strides up to 10 feet, dragging the enemy along.
creature.hyaenodon.abilities.pack-attack: The hyaenodon deals an extra 1d6 damage to any creature within reach of at least two of the hyaenodon's allies.
creature.hyaenodon.name: Hyaenodon
creature.hyaenodon.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.hydra.abilities.focused-assault: The hydra attacks a single target with its heads, overwhelming its foe with multiple attacks and leaving almost nowhere to dodge. The hydra Strikes with its fangs. On a successful attack, the hydra deals damage from its fangs Strike to the target, plus an additional 1d6 damage for every head it has beyond the first. On a failure (but not a critical failure), the hydra deals the damage from one fangs Strike to the target creature. This Strike counts as a number of attacks equal to the number of heads the hydra has toward the hydra's multiple attack penalty.
creature.hydra.abilities.head-regrowth.t:
A hydra ordinarily has five heads. A creature can attempt to sever one of the hydra's heads by specifically targeting it and dealing damage equal to the head's Hit Points. A head that is not completely severed returns to full Hit Points at the end of any creature's turn.

A hydra can regrow a severed head using hydra regeneration. A creature can prevent this regrowth by dealing acid or fire damage to the stump, cauterizing it. Single-target acid or fire effects need to be targeted at a specific stump, but effects that deal [[trait.splash|splash]] damage or affect areas covering the hydra's whole space cauterize all stumps if they deal acid or fire damage. If the attack that severs a head deals any acid or fire damage, the stump is cauterized instantly. If all five heads are cauterized, the hydra dies.
creature.hydra.abilities.hydra-regenerat: The hydra has [[ability.regeneration|regeneration]] equal to 3 × the number of heads it has. If a hydra's body is missing any heads and the remaining stumps have not been cauterized, the hydra attempts a DC 25 Fortitude save after it regains Hit Points from regeneration. On a success, one uncauterized stump regrows two heads; on a critical success, two uncauterized stumps regrow into two heads each. The hydra can never grow more than double the number of heads it ordinarily has. The hydra's regeneration only fully deactivates if all its heads are severed and all stumps are cauterized, at which point it dies.
A hydra gains an extra reaction per round for each of its heads beyond the first, which it can use only to make Reactive Strikes. It can't use more than 1 reaction on the same triggering action, even if a creature leaves several squares within its reach, and the hydra must use a different head for each Reactive Strike it makes. Whenever one of the hydra's heads is severed, the hydra loses 1 of its extra reactions per round.
creature.hydra.abilities.storm-of-jaws.t: The hydra makes a number of Strikes up to its number of heads, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the hydra's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the hydra makes all its attacks.
creature.hydra.name: Hydra
creature.hydra.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.hyena.abilities.drag.name: Drag
creature.hyena.abilities.drag.text: The hyena makes a jaws Strike against a [[condition.prone|prone]] enemy. If it hits, in addition to dealing damage, the hyena Strides up to 10 feet, dragging the enemy along.
creature.hyena.abilities.pack-attack.tex: The hyena deals an extra 1d4 damage to any creature that's within reach of at least two of the hyena's allies.
creature.hyena.name: Hyena
creature.hyena.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.ice-linnorm.abilities.curse-of-: When a creature slays the ice linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 40 Will save or gain weakness to cold 15 with an unlimited duration.
creature.ice-linnorm.abilities.ice-linno: **Saving Throw** DC 38 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 10 rounds; **Stage 1** 5d6 cold damage and [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 7d6 cold damage and drained 2 (1 round)
creature.ice-linnorm.abilities.icemire-b: The ice linnorm spews out a blast of freezing, viscous ooze in a 60-foot cone that deals 15d6 cold damage to creatures within the area (DC 38 basic Reflex save). The freezing ooze clings to those struck and hardens into thick sheets of ice. A creature that fails the saving throw is [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] by the ice until it succeeds at a check to [[action.escape|Escape]] or it or an ally [[action.force-open|Forces Open]] the ice (DC 34 for either case). At the start of its turn, a creature still immobilized by the ice takes 4d6 cold damage. Another creature can free a frozen target by dealing a total of 20 fire damage to the frozen target. Left unattended, the ice crumbles away in 1 minute on its own. Creatures with the [[trait.fire|fire]] trait can't be frozen in place by Icemire Breath. Flying creatures fall if frozen, and swimming creatures that are frozen rise toward the surface of the water at a speed of 60 feet per round. The linnorm can't use Icemire Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.ice-linnorm.name: Ice Linnorm
creature.ice-linnorm.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.ice-linnorm.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.ice-linnorm.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.ifrit.abilities.burning-grasp.t: When the ifrit [[condition.grabbed|grabs]] or [[condition.restrained|restrains]] a creature that creature takes 2d6 fire damage and takes 2d6 fire damage at the end of each of its turns until freed.
creature.ifrit.abilities.change-shape.te: The ifrit transforms into a Small or Medium fire elemental or reptile, such as a snake. This doesn't affect their statistics but could change the damage type of their Strikes.
creature.ifrit.abilities.combat-grab.req: The ifrit has a hand free
creature.ifrit.abilities.combat-grab.tex: The ifrit makes a melee Strike. If the Strike hits, the target is [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] in the ifrit's free hand.
The ifrit grows flaming wings from their back. They gain a fly Speed of 35 feet for 1 minute. The flames also create an aura in a 5-foot emanation around the ifrit. Any creature that ends its turn in the aura takes 2d6 fire damage with a DC 25 basic Reflex save.
creature.ifrit.name: Ifrit
to the astral realm, Elemental Planes, or the Universe only
creature.ifrit.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.ifrit.strikes.scimitar.name: scimitar
creature.imp.abilities.change-shape.name: Change Shape
creature.imp.abilities.change-shape.text: The imp takes on the appearance of a Medium or smaller [[trait.animal|animal]] (page 358). While transformed, the imp loses their normal senses, innate spells, and special actions, but doesn't otherwise change their statistics and can still speak and use telepathy. The imp also gains any special senses of the animal and any Speeds the animal has. This doesn't change the attack and damage modifiers of their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (depending on what kinds of attacks the animal has) and prevents them from exposing creatures to imp venom.
creature.imp.abilities.fiendish-temptati: The imp offers a non-[[trait.fiend|fiend]] within 15 feet a bargain, granting a boon of good luck if the creature accepts voluntarily. The boon lasts for 1 hour once accepted. Once during the hour, the creature can roll an attack roll or saving throw twice and use the higher result. If the creature dies while the boon is in place, the imp decides where the creature's soul travels. This typically makes the soul bound for eternity in the imp's home plane, and the creature unable to be raised or resurrected except by the wish ritual or similar magic.
creature.imp.abilities.imp-venom.name: Imp Venom
creature.imp.abilities.imp-venom.text: **Saving Throw** DC 16 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison and [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison damage, clumsy 1, and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 round)
creature.imp.name: Imp
creature.imp.strikes.stinger.name: stinger
creature.irnakurse.abilities.mind-lash.t: A creature hit by an irnakurse's tentacle is overwhelmed with corrupted images of a ruined life and must succeed at a DC 28 Will save or be [[condition.stunned|stunned 2]] (or stunned 4 on a critical failure). After attempting this save, the creature is temporarily immune to mind lash for 24 hours.
creature.irnakurse.abilities.soul-scream:
The irnakurse unleashes an alien shriek of nightmarish horror and pain. All non-[[trait.aberration|aberration]] creatures within a 10-foot emanation must attempt a DC 28 Will save. The irnakurse can Sustain Soul Scream for up to 6 rounds; each time it does, it repeats the effect without a new save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected, and it's temporarily immune to Soul Scream for 24 hours.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is stupefied 1. Further failed saves against Soul Scream increase the stupefied value by 1, to a maximum of stupefied 4. Each time the character gets a full night's rest, the stupefied condition gained from Soul Scream decreases by 1.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the stupefied value increases by 2 instead of by 1.
creature.irnakurse.abilities.storm-of-te: The irnakurse makes up to four tentacle Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the irnakurse's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all of its attacks.
creature.irnakurse.name: Irnakurse
creature.irnakurse.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.irnakurse.strikes.tentacle.name: tentacle
creature.iron-hag.abilities.bonds-of-iro: The hag causes a cage built of cold iron fingernails to spring out of nothingness around one creature within 30 feet, attempting an [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check to [[action.grapple|Grapple]] against the target's Fortitude DC; if the target has a weakness to cold iron, the iron hag gains a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. On a success, the creature is [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] by the magical fingernails (or [[condition.restrained|restrained]] on a critical success). If the creature successfully [[action.escape|Escapes]] (DC 24), the cage crumbles into rust. Any creature can attempt to destroy the cage by attacking it. It has an AC of 19, Hardness 10, and 40 Hit Points.
creature.iron-hag.abilities.change-shape: The iron hag can take on the appearance of any Medium female [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]]. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.iron-hag.abilities.coven.name: Coven
creature.iron-hag.abilities.coven.text: An iron hag adds [[spell.earthbind|earthbind]], [[spell.impaling-spike|impaling spike]], and [[spell.spellwrack|spellwrack]] to their coven's spells. Their spell DC when leading a coven is 24.
creature.iron-hag.abilities.embrace-of-i: A creature is [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]] by the iron hag's claw

The hag's nails tear into their captured victim, dealing 2d8 piercing damage (the nails are cold iron). Then the hag can attempt to [[action.reposition|Reposition]] the creature. If the creature is adjacent to the hag, they can then attempt a jaws Strike against it.
creature.iron-hag.name: Iron Hag
creature.iron-hag.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.iron-hag.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.iron-warden.abilities.breathe-p: The iron warden exhales poisonous gas in a 10-foot burst centered on the corner of one of the iron warden's squares. The gas persists until the start of the warden's next turn. Any creature in the area (or that later enters the area) is exposed to the iron warden's poison. The warden can't Breathe Poison again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.iron-warden.abilities.inexorabl: The iron warden Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 37 Fortitude save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it's damaged as if hit by the iron warden's fist.
creature.iron-warden.abilities.iron-ward: Any [[condition.drained|drained]] value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour; **Saving Throw** DC 33 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 4 rounds; **Stage 1** 2d6 poison and drained 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** 4d6 poison and drained 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 8d6 poison and drained 3 (1 round)
creature.iron-warden.abilities.shield-ar: The iron warden has a shield built into its arm, that it can use as a steel shield (+2 to AC and Hardness 5). Because it's a part of the iron warden, all damage in excess of its Hardness is dealt only to the iron warden.
creature.iron-warden.name: Iron Warden
creature.iron-warden.resistances.1.note: except acid and spells that cause rust
creature.iron-warden.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.island-oni.abilities.bean-panic: Oni are curiously afraid of beans, especially as the seasons begin to change. If a creature Interacts to throw a handful of beans at the oni, the oni becomes [[condition.frightened|frightened 2]]. While frightened this way, their weakness to spirit damage is increased by 5. The oni then becomes immune to bean panic for 24 hours.
creature.island-oni.abilities.change-sha: The island oni can take on the appearance of any Medium or Large [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] creature. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.island-oni.abilities.conductive: The island oni fires a bolt of lightning into the air, which immediately roils with dark clouds. Rain falls in a 60-foot radius emanation, centered on the oni, for 1 minute, filling the air and pooling on the ground. Creatures in the aura gain weakness 10 to electricity, and the entire area is greater difficult terrain for [[action.fly|Flying]] creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground or [[action.climb|Climbing]], unless they also have a swim Speed.
creature.island-oni.abilities.electrifyi: The island oni's last action was a successful longspear Strike against a Medium or smaller target

The island oni drives the spear through the target and calls lightning to strike the spear. The target takes 6d6 electricity damage with a DC 37 basic Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is also impaled on the spear. It's [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]], and if the oni moves, they bring the grabbed creature along with them. The island oni doesn't need to use additional actions to keep the creature grabbed; the creature remains grabbed as long as it's impaled. The grabbed creature can attempt to [[action.escape|Escape]] as normal. The island oni can only have one creature impaled this way at a time.
creature.island-oni.abilities.lost-oni-i: An island oni can claim an island of up to 1-mile radius in a process that takes 1 week, during which the oni must defeat any who come to challenge its claim. If successful, the oni can freely control the weather on its island and in a 1-mile radius from the shore, with the effect of a successful [[ritual.control-weather|control weather]] ritual. This altered weather surrounds the island in thick fog, seaborne mirages, or other phenomena that increase the DC of checks to locate and navigate to the island (Such as [[skill.lore|Sailing Lore]] or [[skill.survival|Survival]]) to 40, though the oni can allow allies to pass freely. If the oni dies or leaves the island, the weather returns to normal immediately.
creature.island-oni.abilities.mist-visio: The island oni ignores the [[condition.concealed|concealed]] condition from fog and mist.
creature.island-oni.abilities.tripping-t: The island oni sweeps their spear in a full circle, releasing waves of seawater. All creatures in a 20-foot emanation must succeed a DC 37 Reflex Saving throw or fall [[condition.prone|prone]].
creature.island-oni.name: Island Oni
creature.island-oni.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.jaathoom.abilities.change-shape: The jaathoom transforms into a Small or Medium air elemental or aerial [[trait.animal|animal]], such as an owl. This doesn't affect their statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes.
creature.jaathoom.abilities.cloud-of-vis: 60 feet. A jaathoom has [[ability.telepathy|telepathy]] 60 feet but can only show images, not speak.
creature.jaathoom.abilities.hurricane-bl: The jaathoom moves all creatures without the [[trait.air|air]] trait in their turbulent skies aura 20 feet directly away, clockwise, or counterclockwise. A creature avoids being moved if it succeeds at a DC 21 Fortitude save.
creature.jaathoom.abilities.naturally-in: The jaathoom is [[condition.invisible|invisible]] at all times, though when they take a hostile action of any kind, they are [[condition.hidden|hidden]] instead of [[condition.undetected|undetected]] until the start of their next turn, as the vague outline of their form is faintly visible for a short period of time.
creature.jaathoom.abilities.ominous-drea: The jaathoom sends a prophetic dream to a sleeping creature within 10 feet. An unwilling creature avoids the vision if it succeeds at a DC 23 Will save. The jaathoom chooses the dream's subject, but not its exact events. The target sees a brief vision of its future related to that subject, with the effect of [[spell.augury|augury]]. If the result is bad or mixed, the creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened 2]] and can't recover from being frightened until it wakes.
creature.jaathoom.abilities.turbulent-sk: 20 feet. All squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for Striding and Flying creatures. Creatures with the [[trait.air|air]] trait are immune. The jaathoom can activate or deactivate this aura as a single action with the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] trait.
creature.jaathoom.language-note: (can't speak any language); cloud of visions
creature.jaathoom.name: Jaathoom
creature.jaathoom.spellcasting.0.ranks.7: to the astral realm, Elemental Planes, or the Universe only
creature.jaathoom.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.jaathoom.strikes.scimitar.name: scimitar
creature.jabali.abilities.earth-glide.te: The jabali can [[action.burrow|Burrow]] through dirt and stone at their full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of their passing.
creature.jabali.abilities.stone-clutch.t: When the jabali [[ability.push|Pushes]] a creature into a stone barrier, the surface grips it with fingers of stone. The target must succeed at a DC 22 Reflex save or become [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] by the surface ([[action.escape|Escape]] DC 28).
creature.jabali.name: Jabali
creature.jabali.spellcasting.0.ranks.7.0: to the astral realm, Elemental Planes, or the Universe only
creature.jabali.strikes.falchion.name: falchion
creature.jabali.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.jah-tohl.abilities.brain-bliste: A jah-tohl has seven brain blisters on its back that it uses to house stolen brains. A jah-tohl without all seven blisters full is [[condition.stupefied|stupefied]] with a value equal to the number of empty blisters.
creature.jah-tohl.abilities.brain-loss.t: If a jah-tohl takes 30 damage from a critical hit or 25 mental damage, it must succeed at a DC 26 save (Fortitude for critical damage or Will for mental damage) or one of its brain blisters is destroyed.
creature.jah-tohl.abilities.collect-brai: The jah-tohl extracts the brain of a creature within its reach that has been dead for no more than 1 minute. It can then use an Interact action to secure the brain in one of its empty brain blisters and heal 20 Hit Points.
creature.jah-tohl.abilities.mind-snatche: **Saving Throw** DC 26 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison, enfeebled 1, and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d6 poison, enfeebled 2, and slowed 1 (1 round)
creature.jah-tohl.abilities.thoughtsense: The jah-tohl senses a creature's mental essence as a precise sense with the listed range; it cannot sense [[trait.mindless|mindless]] creatures with thoughtsense.
creature.jah-tohl.name: Jah-Tohl
creature.jah-tohl.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.jah-tohl.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.jann.abilities.all-made-one.tex: The jann calls upon all of the elements that make up their being to gain an additional arcane spell they can cast at will and empower their Strikes with the element, dealing an extra 1d4 damage of the listed type. These benefits last until the jann uses this ability again. **Air** [[spell.tailwind|tailwind]], 1d4 electricity; **Earth** [[spell.pummeling-rubble|pummeling rubble]], 1d4 bludgeoning; **Fire** [[spell.breathe-fire|breathe fire]], 1d4 fire; **Metal** [[spell.thunderstrike|thunderstrike]], 1d4 electricity; **Water** [[spell.hydraulic-push|hydraulic push]], 1d4 bludgeoning; **Wood** [[spell.summon-plant-or-fungus|summon plant or fungus]], 1d4 piercing.
creature.jann.abilities.change-shape.tex: The jann transforms into any Small or Medium [[trait.animal|animal]]. This doesn't affect their statistics, but it could change the damage type of their Strikes.
creature.jann.abilities.commanding-prese: 20 feet. A creature that enters the aura must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or be [[condition.frightened|frightened 1]] (frightened 2 on a critical failure) and is then temporarily immune for 1 minute. A [[trait.genie|genie]] (with the exception of another jann) takes a –4 circumstance penalty to its save.
creature.jann.abilities.elemental-resist: The jann's elemental resistance applies to cold, electricity, and fire damage, as well as all damage from elemental sources (including environmental damage from the elemental planes and damage from anything with the [[trait.air|air]], [[trait.earth|earth]], [[trait.fire|fire]], [[trait.metal|metal]], [[trait.water|water]], or [[trait.wood|wood]] trait).
creature.jann.abilities.wanderers-wish.t: The jann instantly grants the benefits of a critical success with the wish ritual to a mortal creature. This has no cost. That creature specifies what they wish for, but the interpretation is up to the jann. A jann typically attempts to grant wishes in a way that encourages growth and exploration. A summoned jann can't use this ability.
creature.jann.name: Jann

creature.jinkin.abilities.sneak-attack.t: The jinkin deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.jinkin.abilities.tinker.name: Tinker
creature.jinkin.abilities.tinker.text: A group of six jinkins can work together for an hour to imbue an item with a curse at a range of 60 feet. While this process is lengthy, it's also unobtrusive and can be performed while [[action.hide|Hiding]]. Jinkins prefer to use this ability on magic items. The curse makes the item unreliable (DC 5 flat check or waste any action to Interact with or Activate the item), adds a bizarre requirement to use the item, or imparts some other curse of a similar caliber.
creature.jinkin.name: Jinkin
creature.jinkin.strikes.shortsword.name: shortsword
creature.jungle-drake.abilities.draconic: The jungle drake makes one fangs Strike and two stinger Strikes in any order.
creature.jungle-drake.abilities.forest-p: The jungle drake ignores difficult terrain caused by plants, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth. Even plants manipulated by magic don't impede their progress.
creature.jungle-drake.abilities.jungle-d: **Saving Throw** DC 24 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison and enfeebled 2 (1 round)
creature.jungle-drake.abilities.predator: As [[ability.grab|Grab]], but the jungle drake's Grab doesn't end if they move away. Instead, they carry the [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] creature with them. A jungle drake can't [[action.fly|Fly]] while grabbing a creature unless that creature can also Fly.
creature.jungle-drake.abilities.speed-su: The jungle drake Strides or Flies twice.
creature.jungle-drake.abilities.spit-ven: A jungle drake can spit a sticky glob of their venom to a range of 50 feet that explodes in a 10-foot burst. Those in the burst must succeed at a DC 24 Reflex save or be exposed to jungle drake venom. The jungle drake can't use Spit Venom again for 1d6 rounds.
creature.jungle-drake.abilities.twisting: The jungle drake Strikes the target with their stinger. If it hits, the jungle drake disrupts the creature's action.
A creature within reach of the jungle drake's stinger uses a [[trait.move|move]] action or leaves a square during a move action they're using
creature.jungle-drake.name: Jungle Drake
creature.jungle-drake.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.kanya.abilities.free-expression: A kanya's [[trait.auditory|auditory]] and [[trait.sonic|sonic]] effects attempt to counteract any effect that would directly control, manipulate, or prevent them from expressing themself freely, such as silence. They can also spend an action, which has [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] trait, to speak forcefully and counteract such effects. The counteract modifier is +16 in either case.
creature.kanya.abilities.muses-courage.t: Any [[spell.courageous-anthem|courageous anthem]] the kanya casts grants a +2 status bonus instead of +1.
creature.kanya.items.1.name: virtuoso harp
creature.kanya.name: Kanya
creature.kanya.strikes.longsword.name: longsword
creature.kanya.strikes.tail.name: tail
The keketar can take the appearance of any Huge or smaller creature. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal.
creature.keketar.abilities.entropy-sense: A protean can anticipate the most likely presence of a creature through a supernatural insight into chaotic probabilities and chance. This grants them the ability to sense creatures within the listed range. [[spell.veil-of-privacy|Veil of privacy]] prevents a creature from being detected via entropy sense automatically (without a counteract check).
creature.keketar.abilities.protean-anato:
A protean's vital organs shift and change shape and position constantly. Immediately after the protean takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage, they gain the listed amount of resistance to that damage type. This lasts for 1 hour or until the next time the protean takes damage of one of the other types (in which case their resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first.

The protean is immune to [[trait.polymorph|polymorph]] effects unless they're a willing target. If [[condition.blinded|blinded]] or [[condition.deafened|deafened]], the protean automatically recovers at the end of their next turn as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.
creature.keketar.abilities.reshape-reali: When the keketar casts [[spell.mirage|mirage]], they infuse the illusion with quasi-real substance. Creatures that do not disbelieve the illusion treat structures and terrain created through the spell as though they were real, ascending illusory stairs, becoming trapped by illusory quicksand, and so on.
creature.keketar.abilities.spatial-ripti: 30 feet. A creature using a [[trait.teleportation|teleportation]] ability within the aura or arriving in it via teleportation must succeed at a DC 38 Fortitude save or wink out of existence for 1d4 rounds before completing the teleport. The creature can't act, sense anything, or be targeted. On a successful save, the creature completes the teleport normally but is [[condition.stunned|stunned 1]]. Keketars are immune to this effect.
creature.keketar.abilities.warpwave-stri: A creature struck by a keketar's jaws or claw Strike must succeed at a DC 36 Fortitude save or be subject to a warpwave.
creature.keketar.name: Keketar
creature.keketar.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.keketar.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.keketar.strikes.tail.name: tail

creature.kholo-sergeant.abilities.pack-a: A kholo sergeant deals 1d4 extra damage to any creature that's within reach of at least two of the kholo sergeant's allies.

creature.kobold-cavern-mage.abilities.in: The cavern mage's previous action was to Cast a Spell
The cavern mage uses their magical display to inspire another kobold within 30 feet. That kobold gains 4 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of the cavern mage's next turn.
creature.kobold-cavern-mage.abilities.sc: The cavern mage is adjacent to at least one enemy

The cavern mage Strides up to their Speed plus 5 feet and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. They must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.
creature.kobold-cavern-mage.name: Kobold Cavern Mage
creature.kobold-scout.abilities.construc: The kobold scout creates a rudimentary trap on any square adjacent to it. This must be on a surface, such as a floor, wall, or ceiling. The trap activates the next time a creature moves adjacent to it. The creature takes 1d6 piercing damage and 1 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] with a DC 16 basic Reflex save. The trap is destroyed when activated or after 1 hour, whichever comes first. The scout typically carries enough raw materials to make one trap.
The kobold scout is adjacent to at least one enemy

creature.kobold-scout.name: Kobold Scout
creature.kobold-warrior.abilities.scampe: The kobold warrior is adjacent to at least one enemy

The kobold warrior Strides up to their Speed plus 5 feet and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement. They must end this movement in a space that's not adjacent to any enemy.
creature.kobold-warrior.abilities.sneak-: The kobold warrior deals an extra 1d4 precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.kobold-warrior.name: Kobold Warrior
creature.kraken.abilities.altered-weathe: A kraken reshapes the weather within 2 miles of it, with the effect of the control weather ritual centered on the kraken and based on its emotional state, at the GM's discretion. If the kraken dies, the weather returns to normal immediately.
creature.kraken.abilities.constrict.name: Constrict
creature.kraken.abilities.constrict.text: 2d10+17 bludgeoning, DC 40 (page 358). On a failed save, a creature that is holding its breath loses 1d4 rounds worth of air.
The kraken makes two Strikes with two different arms or tentacles, each limb targeting a different creature. Double Attack counts as two attacks toward the kraken's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks are made. If the kraken subsequently uses the [[ability.grab|Grab]] action, it Grabs any number of creatures it hit with Double Attack.
creature.kraken.abilities.ink-cloud.name: Ink Cloud
creature.kraken.abilities.ink-cloud.text: The kraken releases a cloud of black, venomous ink in an 80- foot emanation. This cloud has no effect outside water. Creatures inside the ink cloud are exposed to kraken ink poison and are [[condition.undetected|undetected]] while inside the cloud. The kraken can't use Ink Cloud again for 2d6 rounds, and the cloud dissipates after 1 minute.
creature.kraken.abilities.jet.name: Jet
creature.kraken.abilities.jet.text: The kraken moves through the water up to 280 feet in a straight line without triggering reactions.
creature.kraken.abilities.kraken-ink.tex: Krakens are immune to this poison; **Saving Throw** DC 39 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 10 rounds; **Stage 1** 4d6 poison damage and [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 5d6 poison damage and sickened 2 (1 round)
creature.kraken.name: Kraken
creature.kraken.strikes.arm.name: arm

creature.kraken.strikes.tentacle.name: tentacle
creature.krooth.abilities.pain-frenzy.te: Whenever the krooth is damaged by a critical hit, it gains a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls until the end of its next turn. It can't use reactions while this frenzy lasts.
creature.krooth.abilities.poison-tooth.r: The krooth damaged a creature with its jaws on its most recent action this turn
creature.krooth.abilities.poison-tooth.t: The krooth snaps off one of its teeth in the creature it hit. The creature takes 1d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] and is [[condition.drained|drained 1]]. Neither can be healed while the tooth remains. Removing the tooth safely requires a successful DC 26 check to [[action.administer-first-aid|Administer First Aid]]. Instead of ending bleeding or stabilizing, this removes the tooth and the drained condition, but it doesn't automatically end the bleed damage.
creature.krooth.name: Krooth
creature.krooth.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.krooth.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.krooth.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.lamia-matriarch.abilities.chang: The lamia matriarch can take on the appearance of a Medium [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]]. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage modifiers with their Strikes, but it does prevent them from using their cursed touch. Each lamia matriarch has a fixed humanoid form that resembles their upper torso when in their true form. This is the only humanoid form they can adopt using this ability.
creature.lamia-matriarch.abilities.matri: The lamia touches a creature, who must succeed at a DC 28 Will save or become [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]]. If the target fails additional saves against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of stupefied 4). This condition value decreases by 1 every 24 hours. The creature is stupefied 2 (or has its existing stupefied increased by 2) if it critically fails.
creature.lamia-matriarch.abilities.scimi: The lamia matriarch makes a scimitar attack against each enemy within reach. Each attack counts toward their multiple attack penalty, but the penalty does not increase until after all the attacks. The first enemy they damage is subject to Matriarch's Caress.
creature.lamia-matriarch.name: Lamia Matriarch
creature.lamia.abilities.lamias-caress.t: The lamia touches a creature, who must succeed at a DC 23 Will save or become [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]]. If the target fails additional saves against this ability, the condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of stupefied 4). This condition value decreases by 1 every 24 hours.
creature.lamia.name: Lamia
creature.lamia.strikes.javelin.name: javelin
creature.lamia.strikes.spear-2.name: spear
creature.lamia.strikes.spear.name: spear
creature.lamia.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.larval-ofalth.abilities.hide-in: A larval ofalth can hide in any pile of filth or trash that is its size or larger, allowing it to use [[skill.stealth|Stealth]] for initiative. If it rolls Stealth for initiative, on the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to it.
creature.larval-ofalth.abilities.shield-: The larval ofalth's trash shield has a hardness of 5 and 20 Hit Points.
creature.larval-ofalth.abilities.wretche: **Saving Throw** DC 19 Fortitude; **Stage 1** carrier with no ill effect (1 day); **Stage 2** 2d4 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed]] every hour and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 day); **Stage 3** 2d6 persistent bleed every hour and enfeebled 2 (1 day)
creature.larval-ofalth.name: Larval Ofalth

The lawbringer has a [[spell.heal|heal]] or [[spell.harm|harm]] spell prepared

The lawbringer makes a melee Strike and expends a harm or heal spell. On a hit, they cast the 1-action version of the spell to damage the target. The target automatically gets a failure on its save (or a critical failure if the lawbringer's Strike was a critical hit). The spell doesn't have the [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]] trait when cast this way.
The lawbringer has a [[spell.heal|heal]] spell prepared
Before the ally falls [[condition.unconscious|unconscious]] or dies, the lawbringer Strides toward them and casts a 2-action heal spell targeting the ally. The ally remains standing.
One of the lawbringer's allies is reduced to 0 Hit Points
creature.lawbringer-warpriest.name: Lawbringer Warpriest
creature.leaf-leshy.abilities.change-sha: The leaf leshy transforms into a Small tree. This ability otherwise uses the effects of [[spell.one-with-plants|one with plants]].
creature.leaf-leshy.abilities.deafening-:
When a leaf leshy hits with their seedpod Strike, the pod explodes loudly. The target must attempt a DC 16 Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected and temporarily immune for 24 hours.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target is [[condition.deafened|deafened]] for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target is deafened for 1 minute.
creature.leaf-leshy.abilities.glide.name: Glide
creature.leaf-leshy.abilities.glide.text: The leshy glides gently through the air, moving 5 feet toward the ground and up to 25 feet forward. As long as the leshy spends at least 1 action gliding each round, they remain in the air at the end of each turn. For the purpose of determining damage from falls, a leaf leshy always treats falls as if they were 20 feet shorter.
creature.leaf-leshy.abilities.verdant-bu: When a leaf leshy dies, a burst of primal energy explodes from their body, restoring 1d4 Hit Points to each [[trait.plant|plant]] creature in a 30-foot emanation. This area is filled with tree saplings, becoming difficult terrain. If the terrain is not a viable environment for these trees, they wither after 24 hours.
creature.leaf-leshy.name: Leaf Leshy
creature.leaf-leshy.strikes.seedpod.name: seedpod
creature.leopard.abilities.maul.name: Maul
creature.leopard.abilities.maul.text: The leopard makes two claw Strikes against a creature it has [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]]. Both count toward its multiple attack penalty, but the penalty increases only after both attacks are made.
creature.leopard.abilities.pounce.name: Pounce
creature.leopard.abilities.pounce.text: The leopard Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the leopard began this action [[condition.hidden|hidden]], it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.
The leopard deals 1d4 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.leopard.name: Leopard
creature.leopard.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.leopard.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.lesser-death.abilities.aura-of-: 20 feet. Living creatures in the aura must roll twice on all d20 rolls and use the lower result.
creature.lesser-death.abilities.deaths-g: A lesser death can choose whether or not it counts as [[trait.undead|undead]] for effects that affect undead differently. Even if it does not count as undead, the lesser death still never counts as a living creature.
creature.lesser-death.abilities.infuse-w: Any scythe gains the [[trait.agile|agile]] trait, can't be disarmed, and becomes a +2 [[item.striking-greater|greater striking]] keen scythe while the lesser death wields it.
creature.lesser-death.abilities.lurking-: The lesser death teleports to a square adjacent to the triggering creature and makes a melee Strike against it. If the Strike hits, the lesser death disrupts the triggering action.
A creature within 60 feet makes a ranged attack or uses an action that has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]], [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]], or [[trait.move|move]] trait
creature.lesser-death.abilities.status-s: A lesser death automatically knows the Hit Points, conditions, afflictions, and emotions of all creatures it can see.
creature.lesser-death.abilities.void-hea: A lesser death can choose whether or not it takes vitality damage.
creature.lesser-death.name: Lesser Death
creature.leukodaemon.abilities.daemonic-: The leukodaemon can telepathically communicate with the afflicted creature at any distance on the same plane; **Saving Throw** DC 28 Fortitude; **Stage 1** carrier (1 day); **Stage 2** [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 day); **Stage 3** drained 2 (1 day); **Stage 4** drained 2 (1 day); **Stage 5** drained 3 (1 week); **Stage 6** dead
creature.leukodaemon.abilities.infectiou: 30 feet. Leukodaemons radiate infection. All creatures within 30 feet of a leukodaemon take a –2 status penalty to saves against [[trait.disease|disease]]. If a creature within range contracts or progresses a disease, all adjacent creatures are exposed to the same disease, at the same DC.
creature.leukodaemon.abilities.plague-br: The leukodaemon exhales a cloud of corpse-bloated, biting black flies in a 20-foot cone. Creatures within the cone take 4d8 piercing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save). A creature that fails the save becomes [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (or sickened 2 on a critical failure).
creature.leukodaemon.abilities.plaguesen: A leukodaemon senses any creature with a [[trait.disease|disease]], and they know the type and current stage of all diseases carried by any creature within range.
creature.leukodaemon.abilities.quicken-p: The leukodaemon coaxes a disease into full bloom. They choose a target in their aura of pestilence that's currently affected by a [[trait.disease|disease]]. That creature must attempt a Fortitude save against the disease as if the interval for the disease's current stage had passed.
creature.leukodaemon.name: Leukodaemon

creature.leukodaemon.strikes.jaws.name: jaws

creature.lich.abilities.counterspell.tri: A creature casts a spell the lich has prepared
creature.lich.abilities.siphon-life.name: Siphon Life
creature.lich.abilities.steady-spellcast: If a reaction would disrupt the lich's spellcasting action, the lich attempts a DC 15 flat check. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.
creature.lich.items.1.name: [[spell.teleport|scroll of teleport]]

creature.lion.abilities.sneak-attack.tex: The lion deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
