creature.living-landslide.abilities.crum: The living landslide crumbles into the ground, [[action.burrow|Burrowing]] down 10 feet. This Burrowing does not trigger reactions. The living landslide can't Crumble again for 1d4 rounds.
The living landslide takes damage from a hostile source while atop rock or earth
creature.living-landslide.abilities.eart: The elemental can [[action.burrow|Burrow]] through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the elemental moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.
When not touching solid ground, the living landslide is [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] and can't use reactions.
creature.living-landslide.abilities.slid: The living landslide Strides up to twice its normal Speed in a straight line, then attempts to [[action.trip|Trip]] a creature in its reach. If a creature falls prone from this Trip, it takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet the living landslide moved.
creature.living-landslide.name: Living Landslide
creature.living-tar.abilities.adhesive-m: A weapon that hits the living tar is stuck to the ooze. Removing it requires a successful DC 23 [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check to [[action.force-open|Break Open]]. The living tar can have any number of objects or creatures stuck to it at a time. It can release a stuck object with an Interact action, and the adhesive dissolves 1 minute after the ooze dies, releasing all stuck objects and creatures.
creature.living-tar.abilities.motion-sen: A living tar can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.
creature.living-tar.name: Living Tar
creature.living-waterfall.abilities.dren: The elemental puts out all fires in a 5-foot emanation. It extinguishes all non-magical fires automatically and attempts to counteract magical fires (+14 counteract modifier).
creature.living-waterfall.abilities.vort: 30 feet. Water in the area that is in the same body of water as the living waterfall is difficult terrain for [[action.swim|Swimming]] creatures that don't have the [[trait.water|water]] trait.
creature.living-waterfall.abilities.wate: When not touching water, the living waterfall is [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] and can't use reactions.
creature.living-waterfall.name: Living Waterfall
creature.living-whirlwind.abilities.disp: The living whirlwind disperses. Until the end of the current turn, it can't be attacked or targeted, doesn't take up space, and its high winds aura is suppressed. At the end of the turn, the living whirlwind reforms in any unoccupied space within 25 feet of where it dispersed, and its high winds are restored.
The living whirlwind takes damage from a hostile action
creature.living-whirlwind.abilities.forc: The living whirlwind creates a 60-foot line of violent wind. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude save or be pushed back 10 feet and knocked [[condition.prone|prone]].
creature.living-whirlwind.abilities.high: 20 feet. Air within the emanation is difficult terrain for [[action.fly|Flying]] creatures that don't have the [[trait.air|air]] trait.
creature.living-whirlwind.abilities.swif: The living whirlwind's movement doesn't trigger reactions.
creature.living-whirlwind.name: Living Whirlwind
creature.living-wildfire.abilities.explo: When the living wildfire dies, it explodes, dealing 3d6 fire damage to each creature in a 10-foot emanation (DC 19 basic Reflex save).
creature.living-wildfire.abilities.smoke: The living wildfire ignores the [[condition.concealed|concealed]] condition from smoke.
creature.living-wildfire.abilities.sprea: The living wildfire's last action was a Strike that dealt fire damage
The fire flares, dealing 3d6 fire damage to each creature adjacent to that target with a DC 19 basic Reflex save.
creature.living-wildfire.name: Living Wildfire
creature.lizardfolk-defender.abilities.d: A lizardfolk defender can hold their breath for 15 minutes.
creature.lizardfolk-defender.abilities.t: Non-[[trait.lizardfolk|lizardfolk]] creatures that are in difficult terrain or are in water and lack a swim Speed are [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to the lizardfolk defender.
creature.lizardfolk-defender.name: Lizardfolk Defender
creature.lizardfolk-scout.abilities.deep: A lizardfolk scout can hold their breath for 15 minutes.
creature.lizardfolk-scout.abilities.gian: **Saving Throw** DC 14 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d4 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d4 poison damage and [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] (1 round); **Stage 3** 1d4 poison damage, [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]], and [[condition.fatigued|fatigued]] (1 round)
creature.lizardfolk-scout.abilities.hidd: If the lizardfolk scout starts its turn [[condition.hidden|hidden]] from or [[condition.undetected|undetected]] by a creature, that creature is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] against the scout's attacks until the end of the turn.
creature.lizardfolk-scout.abilities.snea: The lizardfolk scout deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.lizardfolk-scout.abilities.terr: Non-[[trait.lizardfolk|lizardfolk]] creatures that are in difficult terrain or are in water and lack a swim Speed are [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to the lizardfolk scout.
creature.lizardfolk-scout.items.1.name: 1 of which is coated with [[item.giant-centipede-venom|giant centipede venom]]
creature.lizardfolk-scout.name: Lizardfolk Scout
A lizardfolk stargazer can hold their breath for 20 minutes.
creature.lizardfolk-stargazer.name: Lizardfolk Stargazer
creature.lyrakien.abilities.starlight-bl: The lyrakien unleashes a blast of holy starlight in a 5-foot emanation. Enemies in the area take 2d6 spirit damage with a DC 17 basic Reflex save. The lyrakien can't use Starlight Blast or their starlight ray ranged attack for 1d4 rounds.
creature.lyrakien.name: Lyrakien
creature.lyrakien.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.magma-worm.abilities.fire-breat: The magma worm breathes a blast of flame in a 60-foot cone that deals 18d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 41 basic Reflex save). It can't use Fire Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.magma-worm.abilities.fire-heali: As long as a magma worm is in contact with a fire or body of magma at least as large as itself, it gains [[ability.fast-healing|fast healing]] 20. When struck by a magical [[trait.fire|fire]] effect from anything other than itself, a magma worm regains Hit Points equal to half the fire damage the effect would otherwise deal.
creature.magma-worm.abilities.inexorable: The cave worm recovers from the [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]], [[condition.slowed|slowed]], and [[condition.stunned|stunned]] conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.
creature.magma-worm.abilities.magma-worm: **Saving Throw** DC 41 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison damage and [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d6 poison damage and drained 1 (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d6 poison damage and drained 2 (1 round)
creature.magma-worm.abilities.rock-tunne: A cave worm can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does.
creature.magma-worm.abilities.slough-ski: The cave worm negates the triggering condition or effect by sloughing an outer layer of its skin. Effects from [[trait.artifact|artifacts]], deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way.
The cave worm would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as [[spell.cursed-metamorphosis|cursed metamorphosis]])
creature.magma-worm.abilities.thrash.tex: The worm attempts one Strike against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws, up to once with its stinger, and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the worm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.
creature.magma-worm.name: Magma Worm
creature.magma-worm.strikes.body.name: body
creature.magma-worm.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.magma-worm.strikes.stinger.name: stinger
creature.mammoth.abilities.cold-adaptati: The mammoth reduces the effects it suffers from cold environments by one step.
creature.mammoth.abilities.dual-tusks.te: The mammoth makes two tusk Strikes, each against a different creature. This counts as one attack for the mammoth's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.
creature.mammoth.abilities.grabbing-trun: A Medium or smaller creature hit by the mammoth's trunk is [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]]. If the mammoth moves, it can bring the grabbed creature along with it.
creature.mammoth.abilities.trample.name: Trample
creature.mammoth.name: Mammoth
creature.mammoth.strikes.foot.name: foot
creature.mammoth.strikes.trunk.name: trunk
creature.mammoth.strikes.tusk.name: tusk
creature.manticore.abilities.spike-volle:
The manticore flings up to two spikes from its tail, targeting either two different creatures or a single creature. If the manticore targets two different creatures, these creatures must be within 20 feet of one another, and the manticore makes a separate Strike against each; this counts as only one Strike for the manticore's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks. If the manticore flings both spikes at the same creature, it makes a single Strike. If the attack hits, it deals the damage of a single spike, but the target is pinned in place, rendering it [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]]. A creature can get free if it [[action.force-open|Forces Open]] the spike or [[action.escape|Escapes]]; either option is DC 23.

A manticore can hurl no more than 12 spikes in 24 hours.
creature.manticore.name: Manticore
creature.manticore.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.manticore.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.manticore.strikes.spike.name: spike
creature.marsh-giant.abilities.drowning-: A creature is [[condition.prone|prone]] within the marsh giant's reach

The marsh giant uses its gaff to push the creature down as water bubbles up below it. The target becomes submerged in water until they are no longer prone and must hold their breath if they cannot breathe water. They take 4d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 23 basic Fortitude save) and lose 3 rounds worth of air if they fail the save.
creature.marsh-giant.abilities.twist-the: The marsh giant makes a melee Strike with its gaff. If it hits, it twists and yanks the gaff to knock the target [[condition.prone|prone]] and create an awful wound, dealing 2d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] to the creature.
creature.marsh-giant.name: Marsh Giant
creature.marsh-giant.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.marsh-giant.strikes.gaff.name: gaff
creature.marsh-giant.strikes.spit.name: spit
The medusa makes a snake fangs Strike against the creature.
A creature ends its turn adjacent to the medusa
creature.medusa.abilities.focus-gaze.tex: The medusa fixes their glare at a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Fortitude save against the medusa's petrifying gaze. If the creature was already slowed by petrifying gaze before attempting its save, a failed save causes it to be [[condition.petrified|petrified]] permanently. After attempting its save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of the medusa's next turn.
creature.medusa.abilities.petrifying-gaz: 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a DC 25 Fortitude save. If the creature fails, it becomes [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for 1 minute. The medusa can deactivate or activate this aura by using a single action, which has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] trait.
**Saving Throw** DC 25 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)
creature.medusa.name: Medusa
creature.medusa.strikes.shortsword.name: shortsword
creature.medusa.strikes.snake-fangs.name: snake fangs
creature.megalodon.abilities.blood-scent: The shark can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away
creature.megalodon.abilities.breach.name: Breach
creature.megalodon.abilities.breach.text: The shark Swims up to its swim Speed, then [[action.leap|Leaps]] vertically out of the water up to 25 feet high, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 35 feet of the water's surface, or 40 feet with its tail). After the Strike, the shark splashes back down into the water.
creature.megalodon.abilities.savage.name: Savage
creature.megalodon.abilities.savage.requ: The shark hit with a jaws Strike on its most recent action this turn
creature.megalodon.abilities.savage.text: The creature the shark hit takes 2d12 slashing damage.
creature.megalodon.name: Megalodon
creature.megalodon.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.megalodon.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.megaprimatus.abilities.mangling: A megaprimatus makes two fist Strikes against the same target. If both hit, the attack deals an additional 2d6 bludgeoning damage, the target is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]], and the target takes a –20-foot status penalty to all Speeds until the end of its next turn.
creature.megaprimatus.abilities.terrifyi:
The megaprimatus beats its chest in a terrifying display. Creatures within 50 feet must attempt a DC 27 Will save. While a creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened]] by this ability, it is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to the megaprimatus and to gorillas.

**Critical Success** No effect and temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is frightened 1.

**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 2 and [[condition.fleeing|fleeing]] until the end of its next turn.
creature.megaprimatus.name: Megaprimatus
creature.megaprimatus.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.megaprimatus.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.merfolk-warrior.abilities.aquat: The merfolk warrior swims and attacks in one of two patterns. They either [[action.swim|Swim]] twice and Strike at the end of their movement, or Swim once and Strike at any point during their movement.
creature.merfolk-warrior.name: Merfolk Warrior
creature.merfolk-wavecaller.abilities.hy: The target is fully submerged in water, within 30 feet of the merfolk wavecaller, and holding its breath

The merfolk wavecaller commands the tides to crush their foe's throat, rooting the target in place and forcing it to choke up precious air. The target must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or become [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] for 1 round and immediately lose 1d4 rounds' worth of air (or twice that on a critical failure).
creature.merfolk-wavecaller.name: Merfolk Wavecaller
creature.minotaur-hunter.abilities.axe-s: The minotaur swings their axe in a wide arc, making greataxe Strikes against any two foes who are adjacent to each other and within the minotaur's reach. The multiple attack penalty does not increase until after both attacks are resolved.
creature.minotaur-hunter.abilities.hunte: The minotaur snorts and clomps as they hunt their prey, inspiring terror. The minotaur makes an [[skill.intimidation|Intimidation]] check to [[action.demoralize|Demoralize]] all living creatures within 60 feet that can hear the minotaur but not see them. Roll once and apply the result to all creatures. If the targets are in a maze or similarly difficult-to-navigate structure, the minotaur gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this check. Creatures that become [[condition.frightened|frightened]] as a result also take a –2 circumstance penalty to [[skill.survival|Survival]] checks to avoid getting lost for 1 minute. Each target is temporarily immune for 1 minute.
creature.minotaur-hunter.abilities.perfe: A minotaur automatically critically succeeds at [[skill.survival|Survival]] checks to [[action.sense-direction|Sense Direction]] or [[action.track|Track]].
creature.minotaur-hunter.abilities.power: The minotaur Strides twice, then makes a horn Strike. If they moved at least 20 feet from their starting position, the Strike's damage is increased to 2d8+10.
creature.minotaur-hunter.name: Minotaur Hunter
creature.mitflit.abilities.self-loathing: A mitflit's self-loathing makes it easy to influence. It takes a –4 penalty to its Will DC against checks to [[action.coerce|Coerce]], [[action.demoralize|Demoralize]], [[action.make-an-impression|Make an Impression]], and [[action.request|Request]].
creature.mitflit.abilities.vengeful-ange: As long as it isn't [[condition.frightened|frightened]], a mitflit gains a +2 status bonus to damage rolls against a creature that has previously damaged or tormented it.
creature.mitflit.name: Mitflit
creature.mitflit.strikes.dart.name: dart
creature.mitflit.strikes.shortsword.name: shortsword
creature.morrigna.abilities.change-shape: A morrigna can take the appearance of any Small or Medium animal or humanoid. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage modifiers with their Strikes, but it might change the damage type their Strikes deal. Unless they choose to manifest their web wrappings in their new form, they cannot make web wrappings Strikes.
creature.morrigna.abilities.shepherds-to: A morrigna's Strikes have the benefit of a ghost touch property rune and deal an additional 4d6 void damage to living creatures or 4d6 vitality damage to undead.
creature.morrigna.abilities.spider-minio: The morrigna summons a [[creature.giant-tarantula|giant tarantula]] (page 321) or [[creature.spider-swarm|spider swarm]]. These spiders have the [[trait.summoned|summoned]] trait and remain for 10 minutes or until reduced to 0 Hit Points, whichever comes first. The morrigna does not need to Sustain the Spell to direct these summoned creatures, and the morrigna can have any number of summoned spiders in existence at once. The morrigna can see through the eyes of any of their summoned spiders at any time.
creature.morrigna.abilities.wrappings-la: The morrigna makes a web wrappings Strike against the triggering creature. If the strike is a critical hit, the triggering action is disrupted.
A creature within reach of the morrigna's web wrappings uses an action to Strike or attempt a skill check
creature.morrigna.name: Morrigna
creature.morrigna.strikes.bo-staff.name: bo staff
creature.mountain-oni.abilities.bean-pan: Oni are curiously afraid of beans, especially as the seasons begin to change. If a creature Interacts to throw a handful of beans at the oni, the oni becomes frightened 2. While frightened this way, their weakness to spirit damage is increased by 5. The oni then becomes immune to bean panic for 24 hours.
creature.mountain-oni.abilities.change-s: The mountain oni can take on the appearance of any Medium or Large [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] creature. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.mountain-oni.abilities.thunderi: The oni lifts their tetsubo and brings it down in a deafening peal. They make a tetsubo Strike. On a success, the target takes an additional 1d10 sonic damage. Each creature in a 10-foot emanation around the target, other than the oni, take this damage as well and is pushed 5 feet away from the target.
creature.mountain-oni.name: Mountain Oni
creature.mountain-oni.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.mukradi.abilities.breathe-energ:
The mukradi breathes a blast of energy from one of its three heads; each creature in the area must attempt a DC 36 basic Reflex save. The mukradi can't Breathe Energy again for 1d4 rounds.
- **Acid Maw** ([[trait.acid|acid]]) 10-foot-wide, 60-foot line of acid dealing 16d6 acid damage.
- **Flame Maw** ([[trait.fire|fire]]) 60-foot cone of fire dealing 16d6 fire damage.
- **Shock Maw** ([[trait.electricity|electricity]]) 120-foot line of electricity dealing 16d6 electricity damage.
creature.mukradi.abilities.partitioned-a: The mukradi confines the debilitating effect to a certain portion of its nervous system, ignoring the effect but causing a maw of its choice to go dormant for the effect's duration. That maw can't be used for a Strike or to Breathe Energy during that time. This ability can't be used if all the mukradi's heads are dormant.
creature.mukradi.abilities.pull-apart.te: The mukradi makes two Strikes with different maws against the same target. If both hit, the target takes an extra 2d12+13 slashing damage, with a DC 36 basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the creature is torn to pieces and dies. The mukradi's multiple attack penalty increases only after all the attacks are made.
creature.mukradi.abilities.spitting-rage: The mukradi's Breathe Energy recharges. It can use Breathe Energy immediately as part of this reaction. It can't use this reaction again until it recharges Breathe Energy naturally.
A creature scores a critical hit on the mukradi
creature.mukradi.abilities.thrash.name: Thrash
creature.mukradi.abilities.thrash.text: The mukradi Strikes once against each creature in its reach. It can make one of these Strikes with each of its maws, one with its tail lash, and the rest with its legs. Each attack takes a –2 circumstance penalty and counts toward the mukradi's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks are made.
creature.mukradi.abilities.trample.name: Trample
creature.mukradi.name: Mukradi
creature.mukradi.strikes.acid-maw.name: acid maw
creature.mukradi.strikes.flame-maw.name: flame maw
creature.mukradi.strikes.leg.name: leg
creature.mukradi.strikes.shock-maw.name: shock maw
creature.mukradi.strikes.tail-lash.name: tail lash
creature.mummy-guardian.abilities.alchem: The guardian's weakness to alchemical items not only applies to damage from [[trait.alchemical|alchemical]] items, but the guardian also takes 5 damage when splashed with non-damaging alchemical items or dosed with alchemical poisons, even if they're immune to their other effects.
creature.mummy-guardian.abilities.blight: The food or drink burns like the caustic substances fed to the mummy before its death. If the creature fails a DC 24 Fortitude save, they become [[condition.sickened|sickened 2]] after they finish the consumption and can't reduce their sickened condition while within 30 feet of any mummy.
A creature within 30 feet eats or drinks (including an alchemical item or potion)
creature.mummy-guardian.abilities.chokin: The mummy's last action was a successful fist Strike

The mummy shares the pain of its dying moments with the target of that Strike. That creature takes 3d8 void damage with a DC 24 basic Will save. If the creature critically fails the saving throw, it can't speak for 1 round, including to Cast a Spell.
creature.mummy-guardian.language-note: plus any one language they knew while alive
creature.mummy-guardian.name: Mummy Guardian
creature.mummy-pharaoh.abilities.reactiv: The mummy pharaoh can use Reactive Strike when a creature within its reach uses a [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] action, in addition to its normal trigger. It can disrupt triggering concentrate actions, and it disrupts actions on any hit, not just a critical hit.
creature.mummy-pharaoh.abilities.rejuven: When a mummy pharaoh is destroyed, necromantic energies rebuild its body in its tomb over 1d10 days. If the body is destroyed during that time, the process starts anew. A reforming mummy pharaoh is destroyed permanently if their tomb is consecrated.
creature.mummy-pharaoh.abilities.sacred-: When a creature deals physical damage to the pharaoh or triggers one of the pharaoh's weaknesses, it must succeed at a DC 28 Will save or become [[condition.doomed|doomed 1]]. Regardless of the results of the save, the creature is then immune to that mummy's sacred wrappings for 24 hours.
creature.mummy-pharaoh.abilities.sandsto: The mummy pharaoh exhales a 60-foot cone of superheated sand that deals 5d6 fire and 5d6 slashing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save). The mummy pharaoh can't use Sandstorm Wrath again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.mummy-pharaoh.abilities.undead-: 100 feet. Commanded or allied [[trait.undead|undead]] in the aura that have a lower level than the mummy pharaoh gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, saves, and skill checks.
creature.mummy-pharaoh.abilities.veil-of: Sand whirls around the mummy pharaoh in a 5-foot emanation until the beginning of their next turn. Creatures inside the sand are [[condition.concealed|concealed]] to those outside it and any living creature ending its turn within the sand takes 4d6 slashing damage with a DC 28 basic Fortitude save. Veil of Sand ends if the mummy takes damage from their water weakness.
creature.mummy-pharaoh.language-note: plus any two languages they knew while alive
creature.mummy-pharaoh.name: Mummy Pharaoh
creature.mummy-pharaoh.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.naiad-queen.abilities.animal-em: The naiad queen can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the [[skill.diplomacy|Diplomacy]] skill with [[trait.animal|animals]].
creature.naiad-queen.abilities.focus-bea: If a target already affected by nymph's beauty fails its save, the image of the queen sears into the creature's mind, effectively [[condition.blinded|blinding]] the creature until its vision is restored with [[spell.sound-body|sound body]] or a similar effect. The naiad queen can Dismiss the effect.
creature.naiad-queen.abilities.nymphs-be: 30 feet. DC 23. A creature that fails its save is [[condition.stunned|stunned 1]] and becomes stunned 1 each time it starts its turn within the aura for the next 24 hours, even if it can't see the naiad queen.
creature.naiad-queen.abilities.tied-to-t: The queen is tied to a body of water or area with a great deal of water features.
creature.naiad-queen.abilities.water-hea: For every 10 minutes a naiad queen spends soaking in any body of water in her domain, she regains 30 Hit Points.
creature.naiad-queen.name: Naiad Queen

creature.naiad.abilities.water-dependent: A naiad is bonded to a spring, pond, or similar-sized water feature. If she is more than 300 feet away from it for 24 hours or more, she gains the weak adjustments until she returns. She can perform a 24-hour ritual to bond herself to a new body of water.
creature.naiad.abilities.water-healing.t: For every 10 minutes a naiad spends soaking in her bonded body of water, she regains 7 Hit Points.
creature.naiad.name: Naiad
creature.naiad.strikes.aqueous-fist.name: aqueous fist
creature.naiad.strikes.water-orb.name: water orb
creature.nessari.abilities.commanders-au: 100 feet. Commanded or allied [[trait.unholy|unholy]] creatures in the aura of lower level than the nessari gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, saves, and skill checks.
creature.nessari.abilities.fast-swoop.te: The nessari Flies and makes a wing Strike at any point during its movement.
creature.nessari.abilities.masterful-qui: If the nessari's next action is to cast an 8th-rank or lower innate spell, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).
creature.nessari.abilities.nessari-venom: **Saving Throw** DC 43 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 10 rounds; **Stage 1** 6d6 poison damage and [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 7d6 poison damage and drained 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 8d6 poison damage and drained 3 (1 round)
creature.nessari.abilities.reactive-stri: The nessari can make a Reactive Strike when a creature within reach uses a [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] action, in addition to the usual trigger. The devil can disrupt triggering concentrate actions, and they disrupt actions on any hit, not only a critical hit.
The nessari reshapes a large number of [[creature.ort|orts]] within a 600-foot emanation into more powerful devils to swell Hell's legions. The nessari must have available the number of orts listed on the table in the sidebar on page 92. The nessari can shape 100 orts per day, to a maximum of 1,100 orts in 11 days. Devils created in this way are in thrall to the nessari and follow their orders, with the exception of created nessaris or other devils of similar power, which are always independent. As a result, few nessaris choose to create peers. At the end of the Shape Devils activity, the nessari attempts an incredibly hard [[skill.religion|Religion]] check of the desired devil's level, with results as follows.

**Critical Success** The nessari shapes two devils from the massed orts instead of one.

**Success** The nessari shapes a devil of the desired type and level.

**Failure** The devil shaped from the orts is 2 levels lower than the intended devil.

**Critical Failure** The nessari fails to shape any devils and draws the ire of an archdevil for their waste of resources.

**Shape Devils** A nessari needs a minimum number of orts in order to shape the roiling mass into a devil of a particular level.

- **Devil level 4 or below** 4 orts
- **Devil level 5–6** 8 orts
- **Devil level 7–8** 16 orts
- **Devil level 9–10** 32 orts
- **Devil level 11–12** 64 orts
- **Devil level 13–14** 128 orts
- **Devil level 15–16** 256 orts
- **Devil level 17–18** 512 orts
- **Devil level 19–20** 1,024 orts

creature.nightmare.abilities.flaming-gal: The nightmare Strides or [[action.fly|Flies]] up to triple its Speed. creature.nightmare.abilities.smoke.name: Smoke
creature.nightmare.abilities.smoke.text:
15 feet. The nightmare continually exhales black smoke. Creatures within the aura are [[condition.concealed|concealed]] to those outside it, and creatures outside the aura are concealed to creatures within it. Nightmares and their riders can see through this smoke.

A creature that begins its turn in the area must succeed at a DC 23 Fortitude save or be [[condition.sickened|sickened 2]]. It's then temporarily immune to being sickened by the smoke for 1 minute. creature.nightmare.name: Nightmare
creature.nightmare.strikes.hoof.name: hoof
creature.nightmare.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.nilith.abilities.mind-crush.tex: The nilith reaches into the mind of the grabbed creature and implants disjointed images of the victim's worst fears and nightmares. The grabbed creature takes 6d6 mental damage with a DC 31 basic Will save. On a critical failure, the target is also affected as though by [[spell.never-mind|never mind]], and it must attempt a second Will save against that effect.
creature.nilith.name: Nilith
creature.nilith.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.nilith.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.norn.abilities.fated.name: Fated
creature.norn.abilities.fated.text: When a creature is subject to a [[trait.fortune|fortune]] effect from a norn and a [[trait.misfortune|misfortune]] effect from any source other than a norn (or vice versa), the norn's effect automatically counteracts the other effect and then takes place normally, rather than the two effects canceling each other out. If both the fortune and misfortune effect are from a norn, then the two cancel each other out as normal. At the GM's discretion, powerful entities related to fate or luck, like a deity of luck, a fey lord of fate, or a deity of death and fate, can't have their effects negated by this ability.
creature.norn.abilities.sense-fate.name: Sense Fate
creature.norn.abilities.sense-fate.text: A norn automatically rolls a 20 when she rolls initiative.
creature.norn.abilities.sever-fate.name: Sever Fate
creature.norn.abilities.sever-fate.text: When a norn deals void damage with a Strike, she regains 10 Hit Points. The target must succeed at a DC 39 Fortitude save or become [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (drained 2 on a critical failure). Further void damage dealt by the norn increases the drained condition value by 1 on a failed save (or by 2 on a critical failure), to a maximum of drained 4.
creature.norn.abilities.shift-fate.name: Shift Fate
creature.norn.abilities.shift-fate.text: The creature rolls the saving throw twice, and then the norn decides which result applies. If the norn chooses the lower roll, this is a [[trait.misfortune|misfortune]] effect; if she chooses the higher roll, it's a [[trait.fortune|fortune]] effect; if they're the same, she decides which trait to apply.
creature.norn.abilities.shift-fate.trigg: A creature within 120 feet attempts a saving throw
creature.norn.abilities.snip-thread.name: Snip Thread
creature.norn.abilities.snip-thread.text: The norn produces a golden thread linked to the fate of a creature within 100 feet of her, then snips it short with her shears. The target takes 100 void damage (DC 42 basic Fortitude save). If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points from this damage, the thread is completely severed and the creature dies immediately. A creature slain by Snip Thread can't be restored to life except by a [[ritual.wish|wish]] ritual or similarly powerful magic; or by divine intervention. Regardless of the outcome of their saving throw, a creature targeted by Snip Thread then becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours. The norn can't use Snip Thread again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.norn.abilities.triumvirate.name: Triumvirate
creature.norn.abilities.triumvirate.text: This functions as the [[ability.coven|coven]] ability, except only norns can join a triumvirate, and it functions only as long as exactly three norns are part of the triumvirate. A triumvirate grants the following spells: [[spell.cataclysm|cataclysm]], [[spell.foresight|foresight]], [[spell.manifestation|manifestation]] (once per day), [[spell.pinpoint|pinpoint]], and [[spell.revival|revival]].
creature.norn.name: Norn
creature.norn.strikes.hand-of-fate.name: hand of fate
creature.norn.strikes.shears.name: shears
creature.nosoi.abilities.change-shape.te: The nosoi takes the appearance of a raven or songbird. This doesn't change its Speed or its attack and damage modifiers with its Strikes.
creature.nosoi.abilities.haunting-melody:
The nosoi croons an entrancing song. Each living or [[trait.undead|undead]] creature within a 60-foot emanation must attempt a DC 18 Will save. The effect lasts until the end of the nosoi's next turn, but the nosoi can Sustain it. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 24 hours. Despite being a [[trait.mental|mental]] effect, this ability affects [[trait.mindless|mindless]] undead. Psychopomps are immune to this ability.

**Failure** The creature is [[condition.fascinated|fascinated]] with the nosoi.

**Critical Failure** The creature is fascinated with the nosoi and must spend each of its actions on its turn to move closer to the nosoi as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a fascinated creature is adjacent to the nosoi, it stays still and doesn't act. If the creature is attacked, the fascination ends.
creature.nosoi.abilities.shepherds-touch: A nosoi's Strikes have the benefit of a ghost touch property rune and deal an additional 1d6 void damage to living creatures or 1d6 vitality damage to undead.
creature.nosoi.name: Nosoi
creature.nosoi.strikes.beak.name: beak
creature.noxious-needler.abilities.alche: A noxious needler's body contains six alchemical chambers filled with different substances. When a noxious needler's ability calls upon a randomly determined alchemical effect, roll 1d6 and consult the following (if you roll the result of a chamber that was shattered, there is no alchemical effect): 1 acid damage; 2 cold damage; 3 electricity damage; 4 fire damage; 5 poison damage; 6 sickness, with a DC 26 Fortitude save or [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (sickened 2 on a critical failure).

When a noxious needler hits a creature with a syringe Strike, roll 1d6 on the alchemical chambers list to determine the additional effect of the attack. The syringe deals an additional 2d6 damage of the appropriate type (or exposes the target to the sickness effect, as appropriate).

When a noxious needler takes physical damage from a critical hit or is affected by a [[spell.shatter|shatter]] spell, one glass chamber within its body shatters, spewing alchemical liquid in a 5-foot emanation. Roll on the alchemical chambers list (see above) to determine which one shatters—on a roll of 1–5, creatures in the area take 10d6 damage of the appropriate type (DC 28 basic Reflex). On a roll of 6, creatures must instead save against the sickness effect.
creature.noxious-needler.abilities.gener: The needler fills an empty vial from one of its alchemical chambers to create a bomb and then makes a bomb Strike. Roll 1d6 on the alchemical chambers list above. On a roll of 1–5, the bomb deals 3d10 damage and 3 [[trait.splash|splash]] damage, matching the damage type of the chamber; you can instead choose to create an alchemical bomb of 11th level or lower that deals the same damage type, such as an acid flask on a roll of 1. On a roll of 6, it creates a sickness bomb, which exposes the target and all creatures in the splash radius to the sickness effect; creatures hit by only the splash receive a +2 circumstance bonus to their Fortitude saves.
creature.noxious-needler.name: Noxious Needler
creature.nuckelavee.abilities.blight-bre: The nuckelavee breathes a 30-foot cone of foulness, dealing 8d6 void damage to living creatures in the area with a DC 28 basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails also takes 2d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]]. The nuckelavee can't use Blight Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.nuckelavee.abilities.mortasheen: The target can't recover from the [[condition.fatigued|fatigued]] condition caused by mortasheen until the disease is cured. Mortasheen gains the [[trait.virulent|virulent]] trait against [[trait.animal|animals]] and [[trait.plant|plants]]; **Saving Throw** DC 28 Fortitude; **Stage 1** Carrier with no ill effect (1 day); **Stage 2** [[condition.drained|drained 1]] and fatigued (1 day); **Stage 3** drained 2 and fatigued (1 day); **Stage 4** dead
creature.nuckelavee.abilities.purity-vul: Unpolluted fresh water burns a nuckelavee like acid, dealing 1d6 damage to it and causing it to be [[condition.sickened|sickened 2]]. A nuckelavee can't heal from damage when it's in an area that isn't polluted (subject to GM discretion).
creature.nuckelavee.name: Nuckelavee

creature.nuckelavee.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.ofalth.abilities.filth-wallow.t: An ofalth gains [[ability.fast-healing|fast healing 2]] when in an area with a high concentration of debris or excrement, such as a refuse heap or sewer.
creature.ofalth.abilities.refuse-pile.te: When they're not in danger, an ofalth can spend 1 minute settling into a 10-foot pile that looks like a heap of garbage. Until the next time it takes an action, the ofalth gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC. A creature that enters the area of the garbage heap or interacts with it must attempt a save against the ofalth's stench.
creature.ofalth.abilities.stench.name: Stench
creature.ofalth.abilities.wretched-weeps: **Saving Throw** DC 26 Fortitude; **Stage 1** carrier with no ill effect (1 day); **Stage 2** 2d4 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed]] every hour and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 day); **Stage 3** 2d6 persistent bleed every hour and enfeebled 2 (1 day)

creature.omox.abilities.cleanly-vulnerab: An omox embodies filth, and they find the concept of cleanliness abhorrent. An omox subjected to an effect that cleans them, such as the tidy command of [[spell.prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], takes 2d6 mental damage. They also take this damage the first time each round a creature hit by one of the omox's attacks spends actions cleaning off the filth.
creature.omox.abilities.liquid-leap.name: Liquid Leap
creature.omox.abilities.liquid-leap.requ: The omox is in a space of liquid
creature.omox.abilities.liquid-leap.text: The omox teleports from its current space to any unoccupied space of liquid within 120 feet.
creature.omox.abilities.slime-trap.name: Slime Trap
creature.omox.abilities.slime-trap.text: A creature hit by an omox's slime ball must succeed at a DC 32 Reflex save or take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute or until it [[action.escape|Escapes]] (DC 35). creature.omox.abilities.smother.name: Smother
creature.omox.abilities.smother.requirem: The omox has a creature [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]]
creature.omox.abilities.smother.text: The demon flows over the creature, covering it in oozing acidic slime. The creature must succeed at a DC 32 Fortitude save or it becomes [[condition.blinded|blinded]] and must hold its breath or begin suffocating. These effects lasts as long as the omox has the creature grabbed or restrained.

creature.orc-commander.name: Orc Commander
creature.orc-commander.strikes.fist.name: fist

creature.orca.abilities.aquatic-ambush.t: 30 feet. An orca can travel no further than 5 feet onto land as part of an Aquatic Ambush. After it does so, it's [[condition.prone|prone]] until it [[action.crawl|Crawls]] to return to the water.
creature.orca.abilities.aquatic-echoloca: An orca can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.
creature.orca.abilities.breach.name: Breach
creature.orca.abilities.breach.text: The orca Swims up to its swim Speed, then [[action.leap|Leaps]] vertically out of the water up to 25 feet in the air, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 30 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the orca splashes back down into the water.
creature.orca.abilities.deep-breath.name: Deep Breath
creature.orca.abilities.deep-breath.text: An orca can hold its breath for 2 hours.
creature.orca.name: Orca
creature.orca.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.ort.abilities.subservience.name: Subservience
creature.ort.abilities.subservience.text:
Orts have little drive of their own, but other devils can take command of them. A non-ort [[trait.devil|devil]] can issue a command to all orts within 60 feet of it with a single action, which has the [[trait.auditory|auditory]] and [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] traits. The devil picks one of the following orders orts can understand, and the orts follow that order. The command and its effects end once the commander is out of the ort's sight, when a new command is issued by the same or another devil, or when the ort dies.
- **Kill** The ort attacks one target the commander singles out and gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the target.
- **Defend** The ort circles the commander and attacks any creature that comes near. It gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saves.
- **Fetch** The ort gains a +10–foot circumstance bonus to its Speed and attempts to get an object or person the commander singles out. It attacks anyone and anything that gets in the way.
- **Work** The ort performs drudge work dictated by the commander.
creature.ort.name: Ort
creature.ort.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.pachycephalosaurus.abilities.cl: The pachycephalosaurus Strides up to its Speed. If it ends its movement within melee reach of a target, it can make a skull Strike against that target. If the pachycephalosaurus critically hits with this Strike, the creature hit is [[condition.stunned|stunned 1]].
creature.pachycephalosaurus.abilities.su:
The pachycephalosaurus digs in and flings its head up, shoving its foe away. It attempts an [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check against the target's Fortitude DC.

**Critical Success** The pachycephalosaurus pushes the opponent up to 10 feet away from itself and knocks the target [[condition.prone|prone]].

**Success** The pachycephalosaurus pushes the opponent back 5 feet.

**Failure** The pachycephalosaurus fails to push the opponent.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the failed attempt leaves the pachycephalosaurus [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] for 1 round.
The pachycephalosaurus damages a Medium or smaller foe with its skull Strike
creature.pachycephalosaurus.name: Pachycephalosaurus
creature.paleohemoth.abilities.fossiliza: The first time each round a creature takes damage from the paleohemoth's jaws, the target must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save. If it fails and has not already been [[condition.slowed|slowed]] by this ability, it becomes slowed 1 for 1 minute. If the creature was already slowed by this ability, a failed save causes it to be [[condition.petrified|petrified]] permanently.
creature.paleohemoth.abilities.reassembl: The paleohemoth reorganizes its bones, increasing its [[trait.reach|reach]] to 25 feet and reducing its Speed to 15 feet. It can revert to its original form by taking this action again.
creature.paleohemoth.name: Paleohemoth
creature.paleohemoth.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.pegasus.abilities.assisted-moun: The pegasus is [[action.fly|Flying]] without a rider
The pegasus Flies. At any point during the movement, it can allow a willing adjacent creature to [[action.mount|Mount]] it. That creature must use a reaction to do so.
creature.pegasus.abilities.buck.name: Buck
creature.pegasus.abilities.gallop.name: Gallop
creature.pegasus.abilities.gallop.text: The pegasus uses 2 move actions, each of which can be either Stride or [[action.fly|Fly]]. It gains a +20-foot circumstance bonus to its Speeds during a Gallop.

creature.phade.abilities.hush.text: The phade calms the air in a 30-foot emanation until the beginning of its next turn, reducing sounds in it to a whisper that can't be heard outside the emanation. This doesn't prevent casting spells, but a phade attempts to counteract any [[trait.auditory|auditory]] or [[trait.sonic|sonic]] effect originating in the area with a +17 counteract modifier. If the counteract attempt fails, Hush ends early.
creature.phade.abilities.naturally-invis: The phade is [[condition.invisible|invisible]] at all times, though when it takes a hostile action of any kind, it is [[condition.hidden|hidden]] instead of [[condition.undetected|undetected]] until the start of its next turn, as the vague outline of its humanoid form is faintly visible for a short period of time.
creature.phade.abilities.sneak-attack.te: The phade deals 2d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.phade.name: Phade
creature.phade.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.phantom-beast.abilities.grab-it: The phantom beast attempts to [[action.steal|Steal]] one item of up to 1 Bulk from a creature, even if the creature is in combat, though the object still must not be one that is actively in use. If they succeed, they carry the object along with them telekinetically.
creature.phantom-beast.abilities.phantom: Each time they make a Strike, a phantom can choose to deal [[trait.spirit|spirit]] damage instead of the normal physical damage type.
creature.phantom-beast.abilities.suscept: Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they [[trait.undead|undead]], and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death. A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a [[trait.death|death]] effect (such as from a spell like [[spell.execute|execute]]) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.
creature.phantom-beast.abilities.walk-th: The phantom walks the thin line between the ethereal realm and the Universe in order to exist on both planes simultaneously. They can shift back to solely the ethereal realm by using this ability again.
creature.phantom-beast.name: Phantom Beast
creature.phantom-beast.saves.note: –1 status penalty to all saves vs. [[trait.death|death]] effects
creature.phantom-knight.abilities.phanto: Each time they make a Strike, a phantom can choose to deal [[trait.spirit|spirit]] damage instead of the normal physical damage type.
creature.phantom-knight.abilities.suscep: Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they [[trait.undead|undead]], and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death. A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a [[trait.death|death]] effect (such as from a spell like [[spell.execute|execute]]) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.
creature.phantom-knight.abilities.walk-t: The phantom walks the thin line between the ethereal realm and the Universe in order to exist on both planes simultaneously. They can shift back to solely the ethereal realm by using this ability again.
creature.phantom-knight.name: Phantom Knight
creature.phantom-knight.saves.note: –1 status penalty to all saves vs. [[trait.death|death]] effects
creature.phistophilus.abilities.draft-co:
The contract devil produces an infernal contract for a single living mortal. This contract can grant a wide range of abilities and effects, akin to the power of a [[ritual.wish|wish]] ritual but fulfilled to the letter by the contract devil. To receive any of those benefits, the mortal must willingly sign its true name to the contract. At that point, the mortal's soul is bound to the contract devil and Hell.

While the contract is in effect, the victim can't be restored to life except by wish or similar magic. If the mortal is restored to life by those means, the contract devil knows which mortal came to life and can locate the creature or creatures who restored the mortal to life for 1 year, gaining the effects of a [[spell.locate|locate]] spell with unlimited range. Avoiding the terms of an infernal contract is difficult and often dangerous.
creature.phistophilus.abilities.infernal: A contract devil can cast a 10th-rank innate [[spell.scrying|scrying]] spell at will, but only to target a creature with which they have a contract. The target automatically critically fails its save.

The wounds from a contract devil's Strikes resist healing. A spellcaster or item attempting to use [[trait.healing|healing]] magic on a creature suffering first attempts to counteract infernal wound (DC 29). If it is not counteracted, the healing has no effect.
creature.phistophilus.abilities.ward-con: A signed contract carried by a living contract devil (including draped over their horns) is immune to damage from all creatures other than that contract devil. A contract devil is immune to [[trait.mental|mental]] effects that would make them destroy, nullify, or alter a contract.
creature.phistophilus.name: Phistophilus
creature.phistophilus.strikes.horn.name: horn
creature.phoenix.abilities.flaming-straf: The phoenix blazes with superheated flame and [[action.fly|Flies]] up to their Speed. They deal 6d6 fire damage to each creature within 20 feet of each square they move through (DC 37 basic Reflex save).
creature.phoenix.abilities.self-resurrec: When a phoenix dies, they collapse into a pile of smoldering ashes before returning to life fully healed 1d4 rounds later, as if subject to a 7th-rank resurrect ritual. Self-resurrection happens only if there are some remains to resurrect; for instance, a phoenix killed by a [[spell.disintegrate|disintegrate]] spell can't use this ability. A phoenix whose remains rest within an area devoted to an unholy deity by consecrate can't self-resurrect until their remains are no longer in that area. A phoenix can self-resurrect only once per year.
creature.phoenix.abilities.shroud-of-fla: 20 feet. 4d6 fire, DC 37 basic Reflex save. While this aura is active, any adjacent creature that hits the phoenix with a melee attack or otherwise touches them takes 2d6 fire damage. The phoenix can activate or deactivate the aura with a single action, which has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] trait.
creature.phoenix.name: Phoenix
creature.phoenix.strikes.beak.name: beak
creature.phoenix.strikes.flame-jet.name: flame jet
creature.phoenix.strikes.talon.name: talon
creature.pipefox.abilities.master-of-ton: Even if the pipefox does not speak a creature's language, it can rapidly pick up on inflection, root words, and body language. If the pipefox interacts or observes a creature for at least 10 minutes and that creature can speak a language, it can communicate basic concepts to that creature.
creature.pipefox.abilities.rapid-eruditi: The pipefox saw a [[trait.cantrip|cantrip]] cast within the last minute
The pipefox can cast the cantrip it saw as an innate arcane spell for 1 minute.
creature.pipefox.name: Pipefox
creature.pipefox.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.pitborn-adept.abilities.drain-b: The adept hasn't acted yet on this turn

The adept expends the power stored in its staff. This gives the adept the ability to cast one prepared spell it had already previously cast today (choosing a different spell rank each time), without spending a spell slot. The adept must still Cast the Spell and meet the spell's other requirements.
creature.pitborn-adept.items.1.name: spellbook
creature.pitborn-adept.name: Pitborn Adept
creature.pixie.abilities.sprinkle-pixie-:
The pixie sprinkles pixie dust onto one of their arrows. If the pixie hits a creature with that arrow before the pixie's next turn, the arrow inflicts one of the following special effects of the pixie's choice instead of dealing damage. Each effect depends on the target's DC 21 Will save. On a critical hit, the target gets a result one degree worse than it rolled.
- Charm ([[trait.emotion|emotion]], [[trait.incapacitation|incapacitation]], [[trait.mental|mental]]) The arrow has the effect of a charm spell, except the target doesn't gain a bonus to its save if the only hostile act was the pixie firing its bow, and the pixie can choose to direct the target's adoration toward another creature rather than itself.

creature.pleroma.abilities.generate-sphe: The pleroma manifests a 2-foot-diameter sphere of energy—either a white sphere of creation that hovers above their left hand or a black sphere of oblivion above their right. This action has the [[trait.vitality|vitality]] trait for a sphere of creation or the [[trait.void|void]] trait for a sphere of oblivion. A sphere vanishes after 1 minute, when it is more than 300 feet from the pleroma, or when the pleroma Generates a Sphere of that type again. A sphere of oblivion winks out of existence when it vanishes, but a sphere of creation explodes in blinding light—each creature in a 30-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 43 Fortitude save or be permanently [[condition.blinded|blinded]]. This is a [[trait.light|light]] effect.
creature.pleroma.abilities.propel-sphere: The pleroma has a sphere of creation or sphere of oblivion active

The pleroma makes one of its spheres fly 10 feet in any direction, ignoring difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain. A sphere of creation creates new matter in its path, which the pleroma can have manifest as normal terrain, difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, or a cube of solid mater (such as clay, wood, or stone). A sphere of oblivion destroys unattended objects it touches, though larger objects are destroyed at a rate of one 10-foot cube per round of contact.

The sphere can enter the space of a creature; when it does, the creature takes 20d6 damage with a DC 43 Fortitude save. This is an [[trait.incapacitation|incapacitation]] effect.

**Success** The creature takes no damage and is pushed out of the sphere to the nearest open space of the GM's choice.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage; this is vitality damage for a sphere of creation or void damage for a sphere of oblivion, but it can damage any type of creature regardless of its normal immunities. The creature is then pushed out of the sphere as on a success. A creature reduced to 0 HP is slain instead of being pushed out, either merged with new matter for a sphere of creation or completely destroyed for a void of oblivion; the creature can be restored only via a wish ritual or similarly powerful effect. This is a [[trait.death|death]] effect.

creature.revenant.abilities.baleful-shri:
The revenant wails horribly. Each creature within a 60-foot burst must attempt a DC 23 Will save. Regardless of the outcome of their saving throw affected creatures are then immune to Baleful Shriek for 1 hour. The revenant's murderer never improves their degree of success due to this ability's incapacitation trait. The revenant can't use Baleful Shriek again for 1d4 rounds.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened 2]].

**Failure** The creature is frightened 2 and [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 3 and paralyzed for 1d4 rounds.
creature.revenant.abilities.self-loathin:
If a revenant sees their own reflection or any object that was important to them in life, they must attempt a DC 25 Will save.

**Critical Success** The revenant is unaffected and can no longer be affected by that reflection or object in this way.

**Success** The revenant is distracted by self-loathing and becomes [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for 1 round.

**Failure** The revenant becomes [[condition.fascinated|fascinated]] by the source that triggered their self-loathing and does everything they can to destroy it until the end of the revenant's next turn.

**Critical Failure** The revenant becomes [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] as long as the source of their self-loathing is apparent, until they're attacked, or until they see their murderer.
creature.revenant.abilities.sense-murder: A revenant knows the direction of their murderer (as long as both are on the same plane), but not the distance.
creature.revenant.abilities.undying-vend: If the revenant's murderer dies, the revenant is immediately destroyed. A revenant that can't sense their murderer must attempt a DC 11 flat check once every 24 hours to avoid becoming [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] and [[condition.prone|prone]]; they immediately rise again once they can sense their murderer. A murderer who becomes [[trait.undead|undead]] does not trigger the revenant's destruction until the murderer is finally destroyed. The revenant gains a +2 status bonus to checks and DCs against their murderer.
creature.revenant.language-note: any one spoken in life by their murderer (typically Common)
creature.revenant.name: Revenant
creature.revenant.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.rhinoceros.abilities.rhinoceros: The rhinoceros Strides twice, then makes a horn Strike. As long as the rhinoceros moved at least 20 feet, the Strike's damage increases to 3d8+6. A Medium or smaller creature struck by this attack must succeed at a DC 21 Reflex save or be automatically [[action.shove|Shoved]] back 5 feet and knocked [[condition.prone|prone]] by the force of the blow.
creature.rhinoceros.name: Rhinoceros
creature.rhinoceros.strikes.foot.name: foot
creature.rhinoceros.strikes.horn.name: horn
creature.rhu-chalik.abilities.excruciati: A rhu-chalik's tendrils secrete an enzyme that causes intense pain. A living creature hit by a tendril Strike must succeed at a DC 24 Fortitude save or become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] from the pain.
creature.rhu-chalik.abilities.label-memo:
The rhu-chalik invades the mind of a target within 100 feet, sorting the memories into alien structures for transmission. The target must attempt a DC 24 Will save.

**Critical Success** The target creature is unaffected and temporarily immune to Label Memories for 1 minute.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target becomes [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 2]] for 1 minute as its mind is reorganized to fit the rhu-chalik's needs. If it's already stupefied by this effect, the target instead becomes [[condition.confused|confused]] for 1 minute or until it recovers due to taking damage.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but if the target is already stupefied by Label Memories, they become [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] for 1 minute instead of confused.
A rhu-chalik doesn't breathe and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as [[trait.inhaled|inhaled]] [[trait.poison|poisons]]).
creature.rhu-chalik.abilities.thoughtsen: The rhu-chalik senses a creature's mental essence as a precise sense with the listed range; it cannot sense [[trait.mindless|mindless]] creatures with thoughtsense.
creature.rhu-chalik.abilities.transmit-m: The rhu-chalik is adjacent to a creature [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] due to Label Memories

The rhu-chalik copies the creature's consciousness and mentally sends this copied consciousness through the void of space to their waiting masters. The target creature is deeply disoriented by this procedure, becoming [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 2]] for 1 day afterward.
creature.rhu-chalik.name: Rhu-Chalik
creature.rhu-chalik.strikes.tendril.name: tendril
creature.riding-dog.abilities.buck.name: Buck
creature.riding-dog.abilities.pack-attac: The dog's Strikes deal 1d4 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the dog's allies.
creature.riding-dog.name: Riding Dog
creature.riding-dog.strikes.jaws.name: jaws

creature.river-drake.abilities.caustic-m: The river drake spits a ball of caustic mucus up to a range of 50 feet that explodes in a 10-foot burst. Creatures within the burst take 4d6 acid damage (DC 19 basic Reflex save). Those that fail this save also take 1d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent acid damage]] and take a –5-foot status penalty to their Speed. This Speed reduction ends with the persistent acid damage. The river drake can't use Caustic Mucus again for 1d6 rounds.
creature.river-drake.abilities.draconic-: The river drake makes one fangs Strike and two tail Strikes in any order.
creature.river-drake.abilities.speed-sur: The river drake Strides or Flies twice.
creature.river-drake.abilities.tail-lash: The river drake attempts to Strike the triggering creature with their tail. If it hits, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to the triggering roll.
A creature within reach of the river drake's tail uses an action to Strike or attempt a skill check

creature.roc.abilities.carry.name: Carry
creature.roc.abilities.carry.text: A roc can [[action.fly|Fly]] at half Speed while it has a creature grabbed or restrained in either or both of its talons, carrying that creature along with it.
creature.roc.abilities.flying-strafe.tex: The roc [[action.fly|Flies]] up to its Speed and makes two talon Strikes at any point during that movement. Each Strike must target a different creature. Each attack takes the normal multiple attack penalty.
creature.roc.abilities.snack.name: Snack
creature.roc.abilities.snack.text: A roc gains a +2 circumstance bonus to hit with its beak Strike if the target is [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]] in its talon.
creature.roc.abilities.wing-rebuff.name: Wing Rebuff
creature.roc.abilities.wing-rebuff.text: The roc makes a wing Strike against the triggering creature. If the roc [[ability.push|Pushes]] the creature, it disrupts the triggering [[trait.move|move]] action.
creature.roc.abilities.wing-rebuff.trigg: A creature moves from beyond the reach of the roc's wing to within the reach of the roc's wing

creature.roc.strikes.beak.name: beak

creature.rune-giant.abilities.command-gi: When a rune giant casts a [[trait.mental|mental]] spell against another [[trait.giant|giant]], the DC is 39, rather than 35.
creature.rune-giant.abilities.demand.tex: When a rune giant casts their innate [[spell.sending|sending]] spell, they can also cast [[spell.suggestion|suggestion]] on the target.
creature.rune-giant.abilities.flashing-r:
The runes on the giant's body flash with magical energy. Each creature within a 10-foot emanation must attempt a DC 35 Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]] for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature is [[condition.blinded|blinded]] for 1 round.
The rune giant uses an arcane ability or casts an arcane spell
creature.rune-giant.abilities.invoke-run:
The rune giant invokes one of the runes on their body, causing the rune to spray forth a 30-foot cone of sparks that deals 6d12 electricity damage to all creatures in the cone (DC 37 basic Reflex save). The giant can't use Invoke Rune again for 1d4 rounds.

A glowing copy of the invoked rune appears on a single weapon the giant holds, granting the weapon one effect listed below of the giant's choice. The effect on the weapon lasts for 1 minute. If the giant places a new rune on a weapon, any previously placed rune immediately vanishes, ending its effect.
- **Rune of Destruction** The weapon gains the [[trait.deadly|deadly]] trait with three weapon damage dice of the same die size as for the base weapon, and a creature hit with the weapon is [[condition.drained|drained 1]] unless it succeeds at a DC 35 Fortitude save.
- **Rune of Flames** The weapon deals an additional 3d6 fire damage on all attacks.
- **Rune of Smiting** When the weapon hits, the giant can [[ability.push|Push]] the target back 10 feet, or 20 feet on a critical hit.
- **Rune of Space** During the rune giant's turn, the weapon's [[trait.reach|reach]] is increased to 60 feet.
creature.rune-giant.abilities.reactive-s: The rune giant gains an additional reaction at the beginning of each of their turns that they can use only for a Reactive Strike.
creature.rune-giant.abilities.wide-swing: The rune giant makes a single greatsword Strike and compares the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes within their reach. This counts as two attacks for the giant's multiple attack penalty.
creature.rune-giant.name: Rune Giant
creature.rune-giant.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.sargassum-heap.abilities.mirage: 120 feet. The sargassum heap constantly produces a field of hallucinogenic spores that causes those affected to see the monster as whatever they desire most. Each creature within the emanation must succeed a DC 22 Will save or become [[condition.fascinated|fascinated]] with the sargassum heap and compelled to move toward it on the creature's turn. Creatures fascinated this way are also [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]]. If the sargassum heap attacks, the fascinated condition ends only for the creature that is attacked. On a successful save, a creature is temporarily immune to mirage spores for 24 hours.
creature.sargassum-heap.name: Sargassum Heap
creature.sarglagon.abilities.drown.name: Drown
creature.sarglagon.abilities.drown.text:
The sarglagon conjures murky water to fill the lungs of a creature within 30 feet of it that can't breathe water. The target must attempt a DC 26 Fortitude save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target coughs up water and is [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]].

**Failure** The target is holding its breath. The only action it can take is to attempt a Fortitude save against Drown to expel the water, which is a single action.

**Critical Failure** The target falls [[condition.unconscious|unconscious]] and begins suffocating. If the target succeeds at its Fortitude save while suffocating, it coughs up the water and can breathe again.
10 feet. A creature that enters the heavy aura must attempt a DC 23 Will save. It is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is [[condition.encumbered|encumbered]] while it remains in the area. If the creature is already encumbered, it is [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] while it remains within the aura.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the effect persists for 3 rounds after leaving the aura.
creature.sarglagon.abilities.sarglagon-v: **Saving Throw** DC 26 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 2d6 poison damage and [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 3d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round)
creature.sarglagon.abilities.stygian-gua: The sarglagon interposes themself, giving the creature or object standard cover against the attack (+2 circumstance bonus to AC), or greater cover (+4 circumstance bonus to AC) if the sarglagon was already granting it lesser cover.
A creature or object within the sarglagon's reach is targeted by an attack
creature.sarglagon.name: Sarglagon
creature.sarglagon.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.satyr.abilities.fleet-performer: When the satyr Plays the Pipes to cast a spell, he can Step or Stride as part of the activity.
The satyr is holding a [[item.musical-instrument|musical instrument]]

The satyr plays a melody on his instrument to cast charm, [[spell.fear|fear]], [[spell.sleep|sleep]], or [[spell.suggestion|suggestion]] without expending the spell slot. The spell gains the [[trait.auditory|auditory]] trait and targets all creatures in a 60-foot emanation instead of its usual targets. A creature that succeeds at its Will save against any spell is then temporarily immune from spells played from that satyr's pipes for 1 minute. Satyrs are immune to this music.
creature.satyr.abilities.sylvan-wine.tex: A satyr's wineskin magically enchants any alcohol inside. With an Interact action, a living creature can imbibe the alcohol and gain a +1 item bonus to Will saves and a +3 item bonus to Will saves against [[trait.fear|fear]] effects for the following hour. When the wineskin is removed from a satyr's person, the magic remains only until the wine spoils. The wineskin holds up to eight drafts of wine.
creature.satyr.items.1.name: panpipes
creature.satyr.items.3.name: wineskin

creature.satyr.strikes.shortbow.name: shortbow
creature.scarecrow.abilities.baleful-glo: The scarecrow's head bursts into ghostly, heatless flame that sheds bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light to the next 20 feet). If the scarecrow uses this ability on the first round of combat, any creature that has not acted yet is startled, becoming [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] against the scarecrow for 1 round. The scarecrow can suppress the light by using this action again.
creature.scarecrow.abilities.clawing-fea: The scarecrow's strikes deal an additional 1d6 mental damage to [[condition.frightened|frightened]] creatures.
creature.scarecrow.abilities.mundane-app: Until it acts, the scarecrow resembles an ordinary scarecrow. It has an automatic result of 32 on [[skill.deception|Deception]] checks and DCs to pass as an ordinary scarecrow.
creature.scarecrow.abilities.scarecrows-:
40 feet. The scarecrow's eyes flicker with an unnerving glow. A creature can't reduce its [[condition.frightened|frightened]] condition below 1 as long as it's in the aura. When a creature enters or starts its turn in the aura, it must attempt a DC 18 Will save. Birds and other avian creatures take a –2 circumstance penalty to this save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected and is then temporarily immune for 24 hours.

**Success** The creature is frightened 1.

**Failure** The creature is frightened 2 and is [[condition.fascinated|fascinated]] by the scarecrow until the end of its next turn.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but frightened 3.
creature.scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
creature.scarecrow.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.scorpion-swarm.abilities.scorpi: **Saving Throw** DC 18 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round)
creature.scorpion-swarm.abilities.swarmi: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d8 piercing damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save) and is exposed to scorpion venom.
creature.scorpion-swarm.name: Scorpion Swarm
creature.sea-hag.abilities.coven.name: Coven
creature.sea-hag.abilities.coven.text: A sea hag adds [[spell.humanoid-form|humanoid form]], [[spell.mariners-curse|mariner's curse]], and [[spell.water-walk|water walk]] to their coven's spells. Their spell DC when leading a coven is 20.
creature.sea-hag.abilities.dread-gaze.te:
The hag gazes upon a creature, afflicting it with a gnawing sense of impending doom, with a result depending on its Will save (DC 20). The target doesn't need to be able to see the sea hag.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened 1]].

**Failure** The creature is frightened 1 and is [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for 1 round. If the target was [[condition.dying|dying]], it remains [[condition.unconscious|unconscious]] for 1 day. At the end of the day, it must attempt a Fortitude save against the same DC; if it fails, it dies.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature is frightened 2 and slowed 1 for 1 minute.
creature.sea-hag.abilities.sea-hags-barg:
The sea hag can make a bargain with a willing creature who must be of sound mind. The creature gives away a special or cherished quality—such as its courage, its beauty, or its voice. In exchange, the sea hag spends 1 minute polymorphing the creature into a form the target desires.

This functions as [[ability.change-shape|Change Shape]]. It might be a total transformation or just changing one or more aspects of the target's body, and it can't make the creature more than one size smaller or larger. The creature changes its Speeds as appropriate for the new form. It doesn't change the attack and damage bonuses with its Strikes, but it might change the damage type the Strikes deal. This has an unlimited duration, and as long as it's transformed, the creature is [[condition.sickened|sickened 2]] and can't reduce its sickened condition below 2. The creature can slowly and carefully eat and drink despite being sickened. The only way to restore the lost quality used as payment is to defeat the sea hag or make another bargain for its return. Ending the bargain in this way also removes the transformation.
creature.sea-hag.name: Sea Hag
creature.sea-hag.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.sea-serpent.abilities.capsize.t: The sea serpent attempts to capsize an aquatic vessel of its size or smaller that it's adjacent to. It must succeed at an [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check with a DC of 35 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller than the sea serpent) or the pilot's [[skill.lore|Sailing Lore]] DC, whichever is higher.
creature.sea-serpent.abilities.sea-serpe: The water in the ballast organs around the sea serpent's neck is full of psychotropic algae. **Saving Throw** DC 34 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** [[condition.confused|confused]] and, if flying, spends its first action each turn to descend 20 feet (1 round); **Stage 2** confused and, if flying, descends until reaching the ground or water below (1 round)
creature.sea-serpent.abilities.spine-rak: The sea serpent extends the spines along its back and [[action.swim|Swims]] or Strides. Each creature the serpent is adjacent to at any point during its movement takes 4d6+8 slashing damage with a DC 32 basic Reflex save.
creature.sea-serpent.abilities.undetecta: A sea serpent automatically tries to counteract any [[trait.detection|detection]], [[trait.revelation|revelation]], or [[trait.scrying|scrying]] effect attempted against it, using its [[skill.stealth|Stealth]] modifier for its counteract modifier.
creature.sea-serpent.name: Sea Serpent

The marauder unleashes a terrifying battle cry. Each enemy in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 21 Will save. Regardless of the results, creatures are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened 1]].

**Failure** The creature is frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature is [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] for 1 round and frightened 3.
creature.sedacthy-marauder.abilities.sea: A sedacthy speaking Thalassic can be understood by any [[trait.animal|animal]] that has a swim Speed or the [[trait.amphibious|amphibious]] or [[trait.aquatic|aquatic]] trait. By spending a week regularly interacting with such an animal, the sedacthy can make it permanently [[condition.helpful|helpful]].
creature.sedacthy-marauder.abilities.sha: The sedacthy makes a jaws Strike. If it hits, an ally of their choice can spend a reaction to make a jaws Strike against the same target. Allies with beaks or similar attacks can use those instead of jaws.
creature.sedacthy-marauder.abilities.ven: The marauder makes a ranged spear Strike against the triggering creature. This attack doesn't take a range increment penalty if the target is within the second range increment.

By spending a week regularly interacting with such an animal, the sedacthy can make it permanently [[condition.helpful|helpful]].
creature.sedacthy-scout.abilities.shared: The sedacthy makes a jaws Strike. If it hits, an ally of their choice can spend a reaction to make a jaws Strike against the same target. Allies with beaks or similar attacks can use those instead of jaws.
creature.sedacthy-scout.abilities.wriggl: The scout takes a Stride action and a [[action.swim|Swim]] action, in either order. They ignore difficult terrain from mud, quicksand, and similar terrain during this movement.
creature.sedacthy-scout.name: Sedacthy Scout
creature.sedacthy-speaker.abilities.anim: The sedacthy speaker is adjacent to a Large or larger [[trait.animal|animal]] ally
The speaker gains cover until the start of their next turn or when they're no longer adjacent to the animal, whichever comes first.
creature.sedacthy-speaker.abilities.expl: The speaker's Strikes deal 1d6 additional damage to creatures that are [[condition.frightened|frightened]] or [[condition.sickened|sickened]].
creature.sedacthy-speaker.abilities.pain: The sedacthy shrieks across a range of painfully high tones, dealing 3d6 sonic damage and 1d6 mental damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone, with a DC 23 basic Fortitude save. A creature that fails its save is [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]].
creature.sedacthy-speaker.abilities.sea-: A sedacthy speaking Thalassic can be understood by any [[trait.animal|animal]] that has a swim Speed or the [[trait.amphibious|amphibious]] or [[trait.aquatic|aquatic]] trait. By spending a week regularly interacting with such an animal, the sedacthy can make it permanently [[condition.helpful|helpful]].
creature.sedacthy-speaker.abilities.shar: The sedacthy makes a jaws Strike. If it hits, an ally of their choice can spend a reaction to make a jaws Strike against the same target. Allies with beaks or similar attacks can use those instead of jaws.
creature.sedacthy-speaker.abilities.spea: The sedacthy speaker has cover from an [[trait.animal|animal]] ally
The animal takes the damage instead.
creature.sedacthy-speaker.abilities.swim: The speaker is adjacent to an [[trait.animal|animal]] ally
The speaker and the animal both [[action.swim|Swim]], ending their movement adjacent to one another.
