creature.seraptis.abilities.blood-healin: 30 feet. Whenever a humanoid within the aura takes bleed damage, the blood flows through the air to the seraptis's mouths and the seraptis heals by the same amount.
creature.seraptis.abilities.bloody-dance: The seraptis makes a Strike with up to four arms, each against a different target and using a claw or scimitar as appropriate. These attacks count toward the seraptis's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks. The seraptis can use [[ability.grab|Grab]] following this activity, separately attempting to [[action.grapple|Grapple]] each creature hit by a claw.
creature.seraptis.abilities.gnawing-arms: The seraptis has at least one creature [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]]

The seraptis's arm mouths gnaw on those creatures, dealing each of them 2d6+8 piercing damage with a DC 37 basic Fortitude save. Creatures that fail the save also take 2d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]].
creature.seraptis.abilities.isolating-wo: The seraptis telepathically explains a plausible secret to a creature within 30 feet. That creature must succeed at a DC 37 Will save or be mentally cut off from those around them for 1 minute (or permanently on a critical failure). The affected creature treats no one as an ally and any speech they hear is warped, encouraging conflict, and negating any [[trait.linguistic|linguistic]] ability from creatures that aren't [[trait.unholy|unholy]]. Regardless of the results of the saving throw, the creature is immune to Isolating Words for 24 hours.
creature.seraptis.abilities.recovery-vul: When a creature within the seraptis's blood healing aura recovers from [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent damage]], the seraptis takes 3d6 mental damage.
creature.seraptis.name: Seraptis
creature.seraptis.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.sewer-ooze.abilities.filth-wave: The sewer ooze unleashes a wave of filth, covering all creatures in a 20-foot emanation. Each creature in the area must succeed at a DC 17 Reflex save or take 1d4 acid damage and take a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute (on a critical failure, the creature also falls [[condition.prone|prone]]). A creature can spend an Interact action to clean someone off, decreasing the Speed penalty by 5 feet with each action.
creature.sewer-ooze.abilities.motion-sen: A sewer ooze can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.
creature.sewer-ooze.name: Sewer Ooze
creature.shadow-giant.abilities.pall-of-: When a shadow giant hits with a melee attack, the target must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude save or become [[condition.drained|drained 1]] and take a –1 status penalty to Perception checks involving sight as long as they remain drained. On a critical failure, this condition doesn't heal naturally and can be removed only with magic.
creature.shadow-giant.abilities.shadow-c: Shadows extend the giant's chain as they make a spiked chain Strike, increasing their reach to 60 feet for that Strike. If this hits, the target must succeed at a DC 33 Will save or be teleported to an empty space within the shadow giant's normal reach.
creature.shadow-giant.abilities.shadowcl: The shadow giant gains the effect of the [[spell.blur|blur]] spell for 1 minute or until it is exposed to direct sunlight, whichever comes first.
creature.shadow-giant.name: Shadow Giant
creature.shadow-giant.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.shadow.abilities.light-vulnerab: Attacks against the shadow are treated as [[trait.magical|magical]] if made by a creature who is in magical light or with an object that is in magical light (such as from the [[spell.light|light]] spell).
creature.shadow.abilities.shadow-spawn.t: When a creature's shadow is pulled free by Steal Shadow, it becomes a shadow spawn under the command of the shadow that created it. This shadow spawn doesn't have Steal Shadow and is perpetually and incurably [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 2]]. If the creature the shadow spawn was pulled from dies, the shadow spawn becomes a full-fledged, autonomous shadow. If the creature recovers from its enfeeblement, its shadow returns to it and the shadow spawn is extinguished.
creature.shadow.abilities.slink-in-shado: The shadow can [[action.hide|Hide]] or end its [[action.sneak|Sneak]] in a creature's or object's shadow.
creature.shadow.abilities.steal-shadow.r: The shadow hit a living creature with a shadow hand Strike on its previous action
creature.shadow.abilities.steal-shadow.t: The shadow pulls at the target's shadow, making the creature [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]]. This is cumulative with other enfeebled conditions from shadows, to a maximum of enfeebled 4. If this increases a creature's enfeebled value to 3 or more, the target's shadow is separated from its body (see shadow spawn). The enfeebled value from Steal Shadow decreases by 1 every hour.
creature.shadow.name: Shadow
creature.shadow.strikes.shadow-hand.name: shadow hand
creature.shemhazian.abilities.enfeebling: If the shemhazian's jaws Strike damages a creature, the target is enfeebled 3 for 24 hours. The target can attempt a DC 37 Fortitude save to reduce this to enfeebled 1 (or be unaffected on a critical success).
creature.shemhazian.abilities.focused-ga: The shemhazian focuses their gaze on a non-[[trait.demon|demon]] creature they can see within 30 feet. If that creature isn't already [[condition.slowed|slowed]] by the shemhazian's paralyzing gaze, it must attempt a save against the shemhazian's paralyzing gaze. If that creature is slowed, it must succeed at a DC 35 Fortitude save or be [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] for 1 round. A shemhazian can't use this ability against the same creature more than once per round.
creature.shemhazian.abilities.paralyzing: 30 feet. A non-[[trait.demon|demon]] creature that ends its turn in the aura must attempt a DC 35 Fortitude save. If it fails, it's [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for 1 round, and if it critically fails, it is [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] for 1 round.
creature.shemhazian.abilities.rend.name: Rend
creature.shemhazian.abilities.succor-vul: A shemhazian's mutilation is a part of them, and they can't bear to see it reversed. The first time each round that a creature heals from damage the shemhazian dealt on their last turn, the demon takes 3d6 mental damage.
The shemhazian attempts to [[action.trip|Trip]] the triggering creature. On a success, the creature also takes damage as if the shemhazian had hit with a tail Strike, and if the creature was flying, it falls 30 feet.
A creature within reach of the shemhazian's tail leaves a square during a [[trait.move|move]] action it's using
creature.shemhazian.name: Shemhazian
creature.shemhazian.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.shemhazian.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.shemhazian.strikes.pincer.name: pincer
creature.shemhazian.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.shining-child.abilities.blindin: 60 feet. The shining child sheds bright light. Any creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed at a DC 29 Fortitude save. If it fails, it is [[condition.blinded|blinded]] for 1 minute, and if it critically fails, it's permanently blinded. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to this effect for 24 hours.
creature.shining-child.abilities.overwhe: The shining child attempts to counteract the magical darkness (counteract rank 7, counteract modifier +23).
The shining child enters an area of magical [[trait.darkness|darkness]] or begins its turn in an area of magical darkness
creature.shining-child.abilities.radianc: The shining child is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] while in areas of darkness.
creature.shining-child.name: Shining Child
creature.shining-child.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.shuln.abilities.armor-rending-s: Any time the shuln scores a critical hit with a melee Strike, it also deals the same amount of damage to the target's armor, bypassing any Hardness lower than 10, as if adamantine.
creature.shuln.abilities.shuln-saliva.te: **Saving Throw** DC 32 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 2d6 poison damage and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 3d6 poison damage and slowed 1 (1 round); **Stage 3** 4d6 poison damage and [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] for 2d6 hours. Shuln saliva overcomes the inexorable ability.
creature.shuln.abilities.unstoppable-bur: Shulns can burrow into solid rock and any metal with a hardness less than that of adamantine as though it were soil or loose rubble, leaving a tunnel 10 feet in diameter.
creature.shuln.name: Shuln
creature.sinspawn.abilities.sin-scent.te: A sinspawn can smell creatures that reflect its sin as the scent ability. The GM determines which creatures are appropriately sinful.
creature.sinspawn.abilities.sin.name: Sin
creature.sinspawn.abilities.sin.text: A sinspawn gains an additional skill based on their sin, as well as a weapon that reflects the preferences of the ancient creators of sinspawn. The seven sins and the benefits they confer upon a sinspawn are noted in the Sinspawn Sins section.
A creature hit by the jaws of a sinspawn must attempt a DC 18 Will save as it is assailed by sinful thoughts.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]].

**Failure** The creature is sickened 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature is sickened 2 and takes an additional effect determined by the sinspawn's sin.
creature.sinspawn.items.0.name: one weapon determined by its sin
creature.sinspawn.name: Sinspawn
creature.sinspawn.saves.note: +1 status to saves vs. [[trait.magical|magic]], +4 status to saves vs. [[trait.mental|mental]]
creature.sinspawn.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.sinspawn.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.skeletal-champion.name: Skeletal Champion
creature.skeletal-giant.abilities.broad-: The giant makes two Strikes with its glaive against two adjacent foes, both of whom are within its reach. Both attacks count toward the giant's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.
creature.skeletal-giant.abilities.terrif: The giant Strides and makes a horns Strike with a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. If the strike hits, the giant attempts to [[action.demoralize|Demoralize]] the target.
creature.skeletal-giant.name: Skeletal Giant
creature.skeletal-horse.abilities.gallop: The horse Strides twice, with its Speed increased by 10 feet.
creature.skeletal-horse.abilities.undead: Undead and creatures allied with them can [[action.command-an-animal|Command]] a skeletal horse without needing to attempt a skill check.
creature.skeletal-horse.name: Skeletal Horse
creature.skeletal-hulk.abilities.broad-s: As skeletal giant, but with its claw Strike.
creature.skeletal-hulk.abilities.massive: The hulk Strides and makes a claw Strike with a +4 circumstance bonus to damage. If the Strike hits, the hulk automatically pushes the target 10 feet.
creature.skeletal-hulk.name: Skeletal Hulk
creature.skeletal-hulk.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.skeleton-guard.name: Skeleton Guard
Whenever a creature dies within 60 feet of a skulltaker, the skulltaker draws a portion of the creature's bones into its shard storm. The creature must succeed at a DC 40 Will save or rise as a [[creature.skeletal-champion|skeletal champion]] in 1d4 rounds. These skeletal champions are controlled by the skulltaker.
creature.skulltaker.abilities.shard-stor:
10 feet. A cloud of bone shards surrounds the skulltaker. When a creature moves into the emanation or begins its turn there, shard storm deals 4d6 slashing damage and 4d6 void damage to the creature, with a DC 40 basic Reflex save.

If the creature has resistance or immunity to void damage, or an effect that protects it against [[trait.death|death]] effects, or an effect that protects it against the [[condition.doomed|doomed]] or [[condition.drained|drained]] condition, the creature must first succeed at a DC 40 Will save or have all such benefits suppressed for 1 minute.
creature.skulltaker.abilities.skeletal-l: A skulltaker taps into the memories of the creatures whose bones make up its body. This gives it the Skeletal Lore skill, which it can use to [[action.recall-knowledge|Recall Knowledge]] of any kind. In addition, it can speak and understand all the languages known by the creatures whose bones make up its body (typically including Common and the regional language of the skulltaker's home region). The skulltaker can use Skeletal Lore as the primary skill check for the [[ritual.collective-memories|collective memories]] ritual, and it can cast collective memories without secondary casters.
creature.skulltaker.abilities.splintered: The skulltaker causes splintered bones to erupt from all solid surfaces in a 100-foot emanation, except for surfaces of worked stone. A creature moving through the bones takes 10 piercing damage and 10 void damage for every 5 feet of movement. The first time each round a creature takes piercing damage from these splintered bones, it must succeed at a DC 40 Reflex save or take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to all Speeds for 10 minutes, or a –15-foot circumstance penalty for 24 hours on a critical failure. The bones remain in place until the skulltaker uses this action again or the bones are manually removed, which takes 10 minutes for each 5-foot square.
creature.skulltaker.abilities.vitality-d: When a skulltaker hits with a melee Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 40 Fortitude save or become [[condition.drained|drained 2]] and [[condition.doomed|doomed 1]].
creature.skulltaker.name: Skulltaker
creature.skulltaker.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.skulltaker.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.slurk.abilities.belly-grease.te: The slurk extrudes a slippery grease from its ventral glands to coat the floor under it and in a 5-foot emanation, turning the affected area into uneven ground for 10 minutes, after which it dries to a putrid crust. The DC to [[action.balance|Balance]] across the slime is 18.
creature.slurk.abilities.entangling-slim: A creature struck by a slurk's slime squirt becomes [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]] and takes a –5-foot penalty to Speed for 1 hour or until the slime is removed. The slime can be removed with a total of three Interact actions by the entangled creature or creatures adjacent to the creature. These actions don't need to be consecutive or made by the same creature.
creature.slurk.name: Slurk
creature.slurk.strikes.slime-squirt.name: slime squirt
creature.slurk.strikes.tusks.name: tusks
creature.smaranava.abilities.coils-of-kn: The naga's grip is more spiritual than physical. A creature hit by a smaranava's tail must succeed at a DC 25 Will save or become [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] by the tail until they [[action.escape|Escape]], the naga releases them with an Interact action, or the naga dies. A captive takes a –4 status penalty to Escape, but can choose to attempt an [[skill.occultism|Occultism]] or [[skill.religion|Religion]] check to Escape instead of the usual options without taking this penalty.
creature.smaranava.abilities.smaranava-v: When a [[trait.holy|holy]] creature succeeds at a saving throw against this poison, it is immediately cured; **Saving Throw** DC 25 Will; **Maximum Duration** 5 minutes; **Stage 1** [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** slowed 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** [[condition.unconscious|unconscious]] with no Perception check to wake up (1 minute)
creature.smaranava.name: Smaranava
creature.smaranava.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.smaranava.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.smilodon.abilities.pierce-armor: The smilodon makes a fangs Strike against a creature that's [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]]. If the attack hits, the creature is knocked [[condition.prone|prone]]; if the creature is wearing armor with Hardness 10 or lower, the armor is [[condition.broken|broken]]. If this Strike breaks a creature's armor or damages a creature who is unarmored or wearing broken armor, the creature also takes 2d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]]. This Strike doesn't further damage armor that's already broken.
creature.smilodon.abilities.pounce.name: Pounce
creature.smilodon.abilities.pounce.text: The smilodon Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the smilodon began this action [[condition.hidden|hidden]], it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.
creature.smilodon.abilities.sneak-attack: The smilodon deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.smilodon.name: Smilodon
creature.smilodon.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.smilodon.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.snapping-flytrap.abilities.focu: The flytrap attacks a single target with both its two leaves. The flytrap makes one leaf Strike. On a success, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike plus an additional 1d8 damage for every leaf beyond the first. On a failure, the flytrap deals the damage from one leaf Strike, but it can't use Improved Grab. It deals no damage on a critical failure. This counts toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty as a number of attacks equal to the number of leaves the flytrap has.
creature.snapping-flytrap.abilities.hung: The flytrap makes two leaf Strikes at a –2 penalty, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the flytrap's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all its attacks.
creature.snapping-flytrap.abilities.quic: The flytrap makes a leaf Strike against the triggering creature. If it hits, the creature is [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] in that leaf.
A creature hits or touches the flytrap
creature.snapping-flytrap.name: Snapping Flytrap
creature.snow-oni.abilities.bean-panic.t: Oni are curiously afraid of beans, especially as the seasons begin to change. If a creature Interacts to throw a handful of beans at the oni, the oni becomes [[condition.frightened|frightened 2]]. While frightened this way, their weakness to spirit damage is increased by 5. The oni then becomes immune to bean panic for 24 hours.
creature.snow-oni.abilities.change-shape: The snow oni can take on the appearance of any Medium or Large [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] creature. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal
creature.snow-oni.abilities.chilling-com: The snow oni makes two fist Strikes targeting the same creature. If they both hit, the target becomes [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] for 1 round.
creature.snow-oni.abilities.falling-froz: The snow oni calls down a bolt of icy lightning, white as fallen snow. The bolt strikes a location within 60 feet, freezing the air into a cloud of snow that fills a 20-foot burst and lasts for 1 minute. All creatures within the snow become [[condition.concealed|concealed]], and all creatures outside the snow become concealed to creatures within it. A creature that enters the snow or begins its turn there takes 15 cold damage, with a DC 33 basic Fortitude save.
creature.snow-oni.abilities.icy-deflecti: The snow oni creates a reflective blockade of ice, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack roll. If the attack misses, the snow oni redirects the attack to another creature within 20 feet of the snow oni. The attacker rerolls the attack roll against the new target.
The snow oni is targeted by a ranged Strike or spell attack roll that doesn't have the [[trait.fire|fire]] trait
Snow doesn't impair the snow oni's vision; they ignore [[condition.concealed|concealment]] from snowfall.
creature.snow-oni.name: Snow Oni
creature.snow-oni.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.snow-oni.strikes.ice-dart.name: ice dart
creature.snow-oni.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.sod-hound.abilities.crystal-sen: A sod hound can sense crystals or gems within 60 feet as if using the [[ability.scent|scent]] ability.
creature.sod-hound.abilities.earth-glide: The sod hound can [[action.burrow|Burrow]] through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the sod hound moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.
creature.sod-hound.name: Sod Hound
creature.sod-hound.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.soulbound-doll.abilities.person: A soulbound doll shares fragments of its donor soul's personality, though none of that creature's memories. This causes a soulbound doll to match a strong personality trait of the donor soul (see sidebar). Because of its soul sliver, a soulbound doll is not immune to spirit as most constructs are.
creature.soulbound-doll.language-note: one spoken by its creator (typically Common)
creature.soulbound-doll.name: Soulbound Doll
creature.soulbound-doll.spellcasting.0.r: one spell based on donor soul's personality trait (see sidebar)
creature.sphinx.abilities.bardic-lore.te: Sphinxes are naturally curious, and their love of puzzles and mysteries leads them to gather information on a broad range of topics. Sphinxes have Bardic Lore, a special [[skill.lore|Lore]] skill that can be used only to [[action.recall-knowledge|Recall Knowledge]], but on any topic.
creature.sphinx.abilities.claw-rake.name: Claw Rake
creature.sphinx.abilities.claw-rake.text: The sphinx rears back on their hind legs and makes two claw Strikes at the same target, using the same attack bonus as their highest melee attack. If both attacks deal damage, the target takes extra damage equal to one claw Strike.
creature.sphinx.abilities.pounce.name: Pounce
creature.sphinx.abilities.pounce.text: The sphinx Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the sphinx began this action [[condition.hidden|hidden]], they remain hidden until after the attack.
Once per week, a Sphinx can create a magical symbol as the rune trap ritual. The sphinx usually shapes it to take the form of a written riddle and sets the password to the answer. A creature that gives the wrong answer or tries to pass without answering must succeed at a DC 26 Will save or be affected by one of the following spells, chosen by the sphinx when creating the symbol: [[spell.synaptic-pulse|synaptic pulse]] (5th), [[spell.charm|charm]] (4th), [[spell.fear|fear]] (4th), [[spell.phantom-pain|phantom pain]] (4th), [[spell.sleep|sleep]] (4th). The sphinx learns the identity of any creature that answers the riddle and tends to be friendly to them if they answered correctly.
creature.sphinx.name: Sphinx
creature.sphinx.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.spider-swarm.abilities.spider-s: **Saving Throw** DC 14 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 4 rounds; **Stage 1** 1 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d4 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)
creature.spider-swarm.abilities.swarming: Each enemy in the spider swarm's space takes 1d4 piercing damage with a DC 14 basic Reflex save. A creature that fails its save is exposed to spider swarm venom.
creature.spider-swarm.abilities.web-sens: The spider swarm has imprecise [[ability.tremorsense|tremorsense]] to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.
creature.spider-swarm.name: Spider Swarm
creature.sprigjack.abilities.bramble-jum: The twigjack scrambles into the undergrowth and instantly teleports to a square of undergrowth within 60 feet. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
creature.sprigjack.name: Sprigjack
creature.sprigjack.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.sprigjack.strikes.splinter.name: splinter
A sprite naturally sheds light like a [[item.torch|torch]]. The sprite can extinguish, rekindle, or change the color of this light by using an action with the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] trait. While this light is extinguished, the sprite's Strikes don't deal fire damage, and they can't use their luminous spark Strike.
creature.sprite.name: Sprite
creature.sprite.strikes.rapier.name: rapier
creature.stegosaurus.abilities.dorsal-de: The stegosaurus leans its dorsal plates into the attack, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the stegosaurus Steps after the attack.
The stegosaurus is targeted with a melee attack
creature.stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
creature.stegosaurus.strikes.foot.name: foot
creature.stegosaurus.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.stone-bulwark.abilities.binding: Any creature hit by the stone bulwark's fist or rock Strike is affected by a DC 30 [[spell.earthbind|earthbind]] spell.
creature.stone-bulwark.abilities.inexora: The stone bulwark Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 34 Fortitude save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise it is damaged as if hit by the construct's fist.
creature.stone-bulwark.abilities.statuar: 20 feet. Rocks of marble magically arise from the ground in the aura. They protect the bulwark's allies, giving each of them standard cover. These stones can be used for Throw Rock. This aura automatically activates at the start of the stone bulwark's first turn in combat and deactivates at the end of combat.
creature.stone-bulwark.name: Stone Bulwark
creature.stone-bulwark.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.stone-bulwark.strikes.rock.name: rock
creature.stone-giant.abilities.big-swing: The stone giant makes a greatclub Strike. The target is [[ability.push|Pushed]] up to 10 feet on a hit or up to 20 feet on a critical hit. If the target collides with a solid object, it takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen the distance it moved.
creature.stone-giant.abilities.create-bo: The stone giant molds a boulder from primal earth and throws it as a rock Strike. A creature hit by the Strike must succeed at a DC 26 Reflex save or be knocked [[condition.prone|prone]].
creature.stone-giant.abilities.swat-proj: The stone giant must have a free hand but can Release anything as part of this reaction

The stone giant gains a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses and the projectile was made of stone, the giant can throw it back at the attacker as a rock ranged Strike.
The giant is targeted by a physical ranged attack
creature.stone-giant.name: Stone Giant
creature.stone-giant.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.stone-giant.strikes.rock.name: rock
The elemental crumbles into the ground, [[action.burrow|Burrowing]] down 15 feet. This Burrowing does not trigger reactions. The elemental can't Crumble again for 1d4 rounds
The elemental takes damage from a hostile source while atop rock or earth
creature.stone-mauler.abilities.earth-gl: The elemental can [[action.burrow|Burrow]] through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the elemental moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.
creature.stone-mauler.abilities.earthbou: When not touching solid ground, a stone mauler is [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] and can't use reactions.
creature.stone-mauler.abilities.spike-st: 5 feet. Spikes of rock rise up from all stone surfaces in the emanation, creating difficult terrain. A creature moving in the terrain takes 2d6 piercing damage for each square of spikes it moves into (a Large or larger creature takes damage only once for each square it moves, even if its space covers multiple squares of spikes). Creatures with the [[trait.earth|earth]] trait ignore all effects within the area. The stone mauler can disable or activate this aura using a single action, which has the [[trait.concentrate|concentrate]] trait.
creature.stone-mauler.name: Stone Mauler
creature.stone-mauler.strikes.fist.name: fist
creature.stone-mauler.strikes.rock.name: rock
creature.string-slime.abilities.motion-s: A string slime can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.
creature.string-slime.abilities.split.te: Whenever a string slime would take slashing damage (if it weren't immune) and has at least 10 HP, it splits into two identical slimes with half the original's HP. One string slime is in the same space as the original, and the other appears in an adjacent unoccupied space. If no adjacent space is unoccupied, move smaller creatures and objects out of the way to make a space or the split is canceled at the GM's discretion.
creature.string-slime.abilities.tag-team: another string slime is within 30 feet

The slime arcs protoplasm to the other string slime. Creatures in that line take 3d6 acid damage with a DC 16 basic Reflex save. A creature that fails its save is also knocked [[condition.prone|prone]].
creature.string-slime.abilities.weak-aci: A string slime's acid damages only organic material—not metal, stone, or other inorganic substances.
creature.string-slime.name: String Slime
creature.succubus.abilities.change-shape: The succubus can take on the appearance of any Small or Medium [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]]. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage modifiers with their Strikes, but it might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.succubus.abilities.embrace.name: Embrace
creature.succubus.abilities.embrace.text: The succubus attempts to [[action.grapple|Grapple]] a creature using their [[skill.diplomacy|Diplomacy]] bonus instead of [[skill.athletics|Athletics]]. If the creature is willing, the succubus automatically succeeds.
creature.succubus.abilities.passionate-k: The succubus engages a creature they have [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]] in an embrace or other act of passion to drain its vital essence. The kiss makes the creature [[condition.drained|drained 1]] or increases its drained value by 1, to a maximum of 4. The creature takes 3d6 void damage and the succubus regains Hit Points equal to the damage dealt. The target must succeed at a DC 26 Will save or be affected by a [[spell.suggestion|suggestion]] to submit to more actions of passion rather than trying to [[action.escape|Escape]].
creature.succubus.abilities.profane-gift:
The succubus gives a willing [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] a profane gift. That creature gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, skill checks, and saving throws. As long as the gift persists, the succubus can communicate telepathically with the target at any distance, see through the creature's senses, and target the creature with [[spell.suggestion|suggestion]] through the telepathic link. In addition, the creature uses an outcome one degree of success worse than it rolls on saving throws against the succubus's suggestion spells.

A humanoid can't have more than one profane gift at a time, and a succubus can't grant more than one profane gift at a time. Removing the gift requires an [[ritual.atone|atone]] ritual. The succubus can remove the gift as a free action to give the recipient a curse, making them [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 3]] with an unlimited duration.

A summoned succubus can't grant a profane gift.
creature.succubus.abilities.rejection-vu: As succubi are beings of pure lust, creatures that reject their lust can metaphysically harm them. When a succubus fails a [[skill.diplomacy|Diplomacy]] check to Embrace or [[action.request|Request]], or when a creature succeeds at its save against a succubus's [[trait.mental|mental]] spell or ability, the succubus takes 2d6 mental damage. For 1 hour after causing mental damage to a succubus in this way, a creature can deal 2d6 mental damage to the succubus with a successful [[action.demoralize|Demoralize]] action incorporating its rejection.
creature.succubus.abilities.seductive-pr: 10 feet. Any creature in the aura that could be sexually attracted to a succubus takes a –2 circumstance penalty to checks and DCs to oppose the succubus's [[trait.mental|mental]] spells, [[skill.deception|Deception]], and [[skill.diplomacy|Diplomacy]].
creature.succubus.name: Succubus
creature.succubus.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.sweet-hag.abilities.betraying-t: The sweet hag touches a creature that doesn't realize the hag is an enemy. The betrayed creature is affected by soporific strike with a –4 circumstance penalty to their saving throw.
creature.sweet-hag.abilities.change-shap: The sweet hag can take on the appearance of any Medium [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] woman. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes, but it might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).
creature.sweet-hag.abilities.coven.name: Coven
creature.sweet-hag.abilities.coven.text: A sweet hag adds [[spell.charm|charm]], [[spell.honeyed-words|honeyed words]], and [[spell.outcasts-curse|outcast's curse]] to their coven's spells.
creature.sweet-hag.abilities.poisoned-ca: The sweet hag casts an innate spell that can normally target 1 creature on a piece of food, typically a sweet treat. The spell is stored in the food. The first creature that eats any of the food is affected by the spell and takes a –4 circumstance penalty to their saving throw against that effect.
creature.sweet-hag.abilities.soporific-t: A creature damaged by a sweet hag's claw must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or be [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]] for 1 day. If the creature critically fails or fails this save while already enfeebled by soporific strike, it falls [[condition.unconscious|unconscious]] and dreams of eating delicious sweets; this is a [[trait.mental|mental]] [[trait.sleep|sleep]] effect. If not woken up before 1 minute passes, the creature wakes up automatically.
creature.sweet-hag.name: Sweet Hag
creature.tabellia.abilities.messengers-a: A tabellia with a message to deliver is continually protected by the effect of [[spell.sanctuary|sanctuary]] (DC 32). If the angel breaks the sanctuary, the effect returns if the angel ceases hostility for 10 minutes.

Creatures in the tabellia's aura are immune to ambient environmental damage from any plane, including severe and extreme heat and cold as well as more otherworldly dangers. The tabellia is never [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to creatures within their aura.
creature.tabellia.name: Tabellia
creature.tarn-linnorm.abilities.corrosiv:
The tarn linnorm can expel either a 120-foot line or a 60-foot cone of acid, dealing 20d6 acid damage to creatures within the area (DC 44 basic Reflex save). The linnorm can't use Corrosive Breath or Double Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

The acid creates toxic fumes. At the beginning of the linnorm's next turn, those who failed the breath weapon's Reflex save must succeed at a DC 42 Fortitude save or gain [[condition.sickened|sickened 4]] from the poisonous fumes.
creature.tarn-linnorm.abilities.curse-of: When a creature slays the tarn linnorm, it must succeed at a DC 46 Will save or it can no longer recover Hit Points via any means, such as [[trait.healing|healing]] spells, the [[skill.medicine|Medicine]] skill, or natural healing from rest. This has an unlimited duration.
creature.tarn-linnorm.abilities.double-b: The tarn linnorm Strides and then makes a jaws Strike with each of their heads, each against a different target. Both attacks count toward the tarn linnorm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the tarn linnorm makes all of these attacks.
The tarn linnorm uses Corrosive Breath twice. A creature attempts only one save and can take damage only once. The linnorm can't use Corrosive Breath or Double Breath again for 2d4 rounds.
creature.tarn-linnorm.abilities.tarn-lin: **Saving Throw** DC 44 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 10 rounds; **Stage 1** 7d6 acid damage and [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 11d6 acid damage and drained 2 (1 round)

A creature within 60 feet uses a [[trait.fortune|fortune]] or [[trait.misfortune|misfortune]] effect
creature.tengu-sneak.abilities.feather-f: The tengu waves their feather fan, summoning a small magical breeze that kicks up dust in a 5-foot burst centered on a corner of their space, which lasts for 1d4 rounds. All creatures within that area are [[condition.concealed|concealed]], and all other creatures are concealed to them.
creature.tengu-sneak.abilities.sneak-att: The tengu deals an additional 1d6 precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.tengu-sneak.abilities.surprise-: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] to the tengu.

creature.terotricus.abilities.infest-env: The terotricus is in a swamp or forested area

The terotricus drains nutrients from nearby trees and undergrowth while simultaneously infesting them with fungal growth. All non-magical plant life (though not [[trait.plant|plant]] creatures) within a 60-foot emanation withers and sprouts foul mold and slimy mushrooms, removing any cover and [[condition.concealed|concealment]] provided by trees and undergrowth. In addition, the terotricus regains 200 Hit Points (this is a [[trait.healing|healing]] [[trait.vitality|vitality]] effect).
creature.terotricus.abilities.spore-blig: [[trait.plant|Plants]] and [[trait.fungus|fungi]] are immune; **Saving Throw** DC 40 Fortitude; **Stage 1** [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 2]] (1 day); **Stage 2** enfeebled 4 and [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] (1 day); **Stage 3** [[condition.controlled|controlled]] by the terotricus (as [[spell.dominate|dominate]]; 5d8 days); **Stage 4** dead
creature.terotricus.abilities.spore-clou: 30 feet. A creature entering the aura or starting its turn there is exposed to spore blight.
creature.terotricus.abilities.sticky-spo: A creature hit by a terotricus's spores takes a –10-foot status penalty to all its Speeds for 1 minute. If the Strike was a critical hit, the creature is also [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] until it [[action.escape|Escapes]] (DC 40).

The thulgant deals 3d12+17 mental damage to the enemy. If the enemy is affected by thulgant venom, that poison gains the [[trait.virulent|virulent]] trait.
creature.thulgant.abilities.stunning-dis:
The thulgant rises up on its twitching limbs and presents its numerous tentacles and stingers in a horrifying display of awfulness. Creatures in a 30-foot emanation must attempt a DC 40 Will save, after which they are temporarily immune to further Stunning Displays for 1 minute.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.stunned|stunned 1]].

**Failure** The creature is stunned 4.

**Critical Failure** The creature is stunned 8.
creature.thulgant.abilities.thulgant-ven: **Saving Throw** Fortitude DC 40; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d6 poison damage and the victim gains one of the following at random: [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 1]], [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 1]], or [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 6d6 poison damage and the victim gains two of the following at random: clumsy 2, enfeebled 2, or stupefied 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 9d6 poison damage and the victim gains all three of the following: clumsy 3, enfeebled 3, and stupefied 3 (1 round).

creature.tiger.abilities.sneak-attack.te: The tiger deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.tiger.abilities.wrestle.name: Wrestle

creature.tomb-jelly.abilities.flesh-diss: A tomb jelly's acid damages only flesh.
creature.tomb-jelly.abilities.motion-sen: A tomb jelly can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.
creature.tomb-jelly.abilities.tomb-curse: A creature hit by a tomb jelly's pseudopod takes 1d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent void damage]]. creature.tooth-fairy-swarm.abilities.pin: Tooth fairies pinch their victims' fingers, noses, ears, or similar protruding body parts. Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save). Creatures that critically fail this save are [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] from the pain.
creature.tooth-fairy-swarm.abilities.pla: When killed, a tooth fairy bursts into sticky, foul-smelling white dust. Each creature in a 15-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (sickened 2 on a critical failure).
creature.tooth-fairy-swarm.abilities.pry:
The tooth fairies try to pry out one of their target's teeth. One enemy in the swarm's space takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC 20 basic Reflex save. On a failed save, the target takes 2 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] and loses a tooth.

If the creature loses a tooth, it takes a –1 status penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and must succeed at a DC 5 flat check to Cast a Spell unless that spell has the [[trait.subtle|subtle]] trait. These effects last for 1 day, or until the stolen tooth is returned and the target regains at least 1 Hit Point.
creature.tooth-fairy-swarm.name: Tooth Fairy Swarm
creature.tooth-fairy.abilities.plaque-bu: When killed, a tooth fairy bursts into sticky, foul-smelling white dust. Each creature in a 5-foot emanation must succeed at a DC 16 Fortitude save or become [[condition.sickened|sickened 1]] (sickened 2 on a critical failure).
creature.tooth-fairy.abilities.tooth-tug: The tooth fairy's last action was a successful pliers Strike against a creature with teeth

The tooth fairy attempts a [[skill.thievery|Thievery]] check against the creature's Fortitude DC, dealing 2 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] on any result but a critical failure. On a critical success, it also pulls out one of the target's teeth. If the creature loses a tooth, it takes a –1 status penalty to Charisma-based skill checks and must succeed at a DC 5 flat check to Cast a Spell unless that spell has the [[trait.subtle|subtle]] trait. These effects last for 1 day, or until the stolen tooth is returned and the target regains at least 1 Hit Point.

As long as a character continues to suffer this curse, its slowed condition can never be reduced below slowed 1.
creature.tor-linnorm.abilities.lava-affi: The linnorm can breathe and swim freely while submerged in lava and magma.
creature.tor-linnorm.abilities.pyroclast: The tor linnorm expels a 60-foot cone of flame and ash dealing 20d6 fire damage to creatures within the area (DC 46 basic Reflex save). The linnorm can't use Pyroclastic Breath again for 1d4 rounds. At the start of the tor linnorm's next turn, the area of the Pyroclastic Breath is covered in thick, scorching smoke that burns both the lungs and eyes, dealing an additional 10d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area (DC 46 basic Reflex save). A creature that spends an entire round in the smoke with open eyes must succeed at a DC 44 Fortitude save or be [[condition.blinded|blinded]] for 1 minute. The smoke dissipates after 1 minute; in strong winds, the smoke dissipates in 5 rounds, and in more powerful winds, it may clear even more quickly.
creature.tor-linnorm.abilities.slashing-: The tor linnorm makes four Strikes with their claws, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the tor linnorm's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the tor linnorm makes all their attacks.
creature.tor-linnorm.abilities.tor-linno: **Saving Throw** DC 44 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 10 rounds; **Stage 1** 8d6 fire damage and [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** 12d6 fire damage and drained 2 (1 round)

The triceratops intercepts the attack with its bony frill. The rider gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack.
The rider is targeted with an attack
creature.triceratops.abilities.lumbering: The triceratops Strides up to 10 feet and then makes a Strike.

The troll warleader takes electricity or fire damage
creature.troll-warleader.abilities.primo:
The troll warleader unleashes a bestial roar. Each non-troll creature in a 100-foot emanation must attempt a DC 29 Will save. The creature is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is [[condition.frightened|frightened 1]].

**Failure** The creature is frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** The creature is frightened 3.
creature.troll-warleader.abilities.shed-: The warleader cuts their armor loose from their flesh. They immediately heal 60 Hit Points in a surge of regeneration as they grow twisted limbs and malformed faces. Without their armor, the warleader's AC drops to 26 but they gain [[ability.all-around-vision|all-around vision]] from the new faces. Putting the armor back on takes 10 minutes, and this ability can't be used again until 1 hour has passed.
creature.troll-warleader.abilities.sweep: The troll warleader is wielding two battle axes

The warleader makes a battle axe Strike against each creature in their reach and the bonus from [[trait.sweep|sweep]] applies to each attack. These attacks count against their multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

The creature falls 25 feet (assuming the tyrannosaurus flings it as high as it can) and takes falling damage accordingly. If the flung creature lands on another creature, the creature it lands on takes the same amount of bludgeoning damage. The creature being landed on can attempt a DC 23 basic Reflex save.
creature.tyrannosaurus.abilities.pin-pre: The creature struck by the foot is knocked [[condition.prone|prone]] and held in place. As long as the tyrannosaurus doesn't move from its position, the pinned creature is [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]]. A tyrannosaurus gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack a creature it has pinned in this manner but can only Swallow Whole if that creature is grabbed with its jaws.
The tyrannosaurus critically hits a Large or smaller foe with its foot

creature.ugothol.abilities.blood-nourish: The ugothol uses its three-pronged tongue to drink the blood of an adjacent [[condition.restrained|restrained]] or [[condition.unconscious|unconscious]] creature. The creature gains [[condition.drained|drained 1]].
creature.ugothol.abilities.compression.t: When the ugothol successfully [[action.squeeze|Squeezes]], it moves through the tight space at full speed. Narrow confines are not difficult terrain for an ugothol.
creature.ugothol.abilities.revert-form.r: The ugothol is in an assumed form

creature.ugothol.name: Ugothol

creature.umbral-gnome-scout.name: Umbral Gnome Scout

creature.unicorn.abilities.animal-empath: The unicorn has a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows them to communicate with [[trait.animal|animals]]. They can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the [[skill.diplomacy|Diplomacy]] skill with animals.
creature.unicorn.abilities.ghost-touch.t: A unicorn's Strikes have the effects of a ghost touch property rune.
creature.unicorn.abilities.powerful-char: The unicorn Strides up to double its Speed in a straight line and then makes a horn Strike. If the unicorn moved at least 20 feet, it deals an additional 2d6 damage on a hit.

When Drinking Blood, the vampire mastermind regains 10 HP.
creature.vampire-mastermind.abilities.st: If another creature's reaction would disrupt the vampire mastermind's spellcasting action, the vampire attempts a DC 15 flat check. If the vampire succeeds, their action isn't disrupted.

creature.vampire-servitor.abilities.snea: The servitor deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures.
creature.vampire-servitor.name: Vampire Servitor
creature.vanth.abilities.infuse-weapon.t: A vanth's scythe is its symbol of office and gains a measure of its personal power. This scythe becomes a +1 scythe and is treated as if it were adamantine while the vanth wields it. A vanth whose scythe is taken or destroyed can infuse a new one with an hour of work.
creature.vanth.abilities.shepherds-touch: A vanth's Strikes have the benefit of a ghost touch property rune and deal an additional 2d6 void damage to living creatures or 2d6 vitality damage to undead.
creature.vanth.abilities.vanths-curse.te:
The vanth bestows a curse on a creature by touching it with its scythe. The creature must attempt a DC 25 Will save.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Vanth's Curse for 24 hours.

**Success** The target feels a momentary shudder of doom and is [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] for 1 minute by the distracting sensation.

**Failure** The target becomes morose and glum as it accepts its own inevitable fate. For 1 hour, the target is stupefied 2. Each time the target gains the [[condition.dying|dying]] condition, the stupefied condition value increases by 1, to a maximum value of stupefied 4.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the effect is permanent.

Fading runes cling to the venedaemon's tentacles. The venedaemon makes a tentacle Strike that has a reach of 20 feet and deals 2d4 additional force damage.
creature.venedaemon.abilities.smell-magi: A venedaemon is aware of magical items and active spells as an imprecise sense. The subtle differences in these scents reveal the tradition and traits of the magic.
creature.venedaemon.abilities.soul-spell: If a venedaemon ingest a soul gem from a [[creature.cacodaemon|cacodaemon]], they can recover an expended spell slot instead of gaining fast healing. The spell slot's rank can be no higher than half the level of the creature whose soul was consumed, rounded up.
creature.venedaemon.abilities.twisted-wh: The venedaemon whispers to a creature within 15 feet, which must succeed at a DC 22 Will save or be [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 2]] for 1 minute (or stupefied 3 on a critical failure). creature.vescavor-queen.abilities.chaoti: The vescavor queen strengthens her swarms. creature.vescavor-queen.abilities.feedin: The vescavor queen causes any number of vescavor swarms within 100 feet to immediately use their reaction to perform the Ravenous Bites action.
creature.vescavor-queen.abilities.opport: The vescavor queen pulls a creature it has [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]] or [[condition.restrained|restrained]] into a space adjacent to it and makes a jaws Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus.
creature.vescavor-queen.abilities.rage-p: If the vescavor queen's spit Strike damages a creature, it takes a –2 status penalty to all saving throws imposed by vescavor swarms for 1 minute.
creature.vescavor-queen.name: Vescavor Queen

creature.vescavor-swarm.abilities.madden:
Each [[condition.stupefied|stupefied]] creature in the swarm's space must attempt a DC 21 Will saving throw as the swarm yammers the endless chorus of the demonic wastes.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Maddening Gibbers for 1 minute.

**Success** The target is unaffected and is immune to Maddening Gibbers for 1 round.

**Failure** The target becomes [[condition.confused|confused]] for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target becomes confused for 1 round and can't target [[trait.fiend|fiends]] while confused in this way.
creature.vescavor-swarm.abilities.raveno: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 piercing damage (DC 20 basic Fortitude save). A creature that fails its save is also [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] for 1 round.
creature.vescavor-swarm.name: Vescavor Swarm

A captive takes a –4 status penalty to Escape, but can choose to attempt an [[skill.occultism|Occultism]] or [[skill.religion|Religion]] check to Escape instead of the usual options without taking this penalty.
creature.vicharamuni.abilities.spiritual: A vicharamuni can choose to negate any damage that its venom does to a creature. In addition, the naga can cast any of its divine spells on a creature that is affected by its venom, regardless of range or line of effect.
creature.vicharamuni.abilities.vicharamu: **Saving Throw** DC 29 Will; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d6 spirit (1 round); **Stage 2** 3d6 spirit and [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round)

creature.vidileth.abilities.change-shape: A vidileth takes on the appearance of a [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] of Large, Medium, or Small size or resumes its true form. While in humanoid form, the vidileth's Speed is 30 feet, and it loses its numbing lights aura and swim Speed. If the humanoid form assumed lacks the [[trait.aquatic|aquatic]] trait, the vidileth loses its own aquatic trait as well. In humanoid form, the vidileth can use weapons or make Strikes that work like its tentacle attack but use the reach of its current form. If the form has fangs or claws, the vidileth can also make such Strikes.
creature.vidileth.abilities.consume-memo: When the vidileth hits with a fangs Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 34 Will save or take 3d6 mental damage. The vidileth gains temporary Hit Points equal to the damage dealt and learns some of the creature's memories (subject to the GM's discretion).
creature.vidileth.abilities.delayed-sugg: When a vidileth successfully casts [[spell.dominate|dominate]] on a creature, a [[spell.suggestion|suggestion]] spell triggers when the dominate spell ends. This suggestion usually causes the target to return to the vidileth, so the creature can cast dominate again, but a vidileth can set the suggestion to different orders if it wishes.
creature.vidileth.abilities.numbing-ligh: 30 feet. The vidileth exudes dim light. Creatures within the light must attempt a DC 34 Will save each round, becoming [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] on a failure (or increase their stupefied value from numbing lights by 1, to a maximum of 4).
The vidileth's last action was a success with a claw Strike

The vidileth sloppily modifies the target's flesh. They must succeed at a DC 34 Fortitude save or permanently receive the veiled master's choice of [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 2]], [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled 2]], or a –10 status penalty to Speed.
creature.vidileth.abilities.tentacle-flu: The vidileth makes a tentacle Strike against each creature within its reach. Make only one attack roll, and roll damage once for all targets.
creature.vidileth.abilities.thoughtlance: A creature touched by the vidileth's tentacles must attempt a DC 34 Will save, becoming [[condition.slowed|slowed 1]] on a failure or slowed 2 on a critical failure. Each time the affected creature ends its turn, its slowed value decreases by 1.
creature.vidileth.name: Vidileth
creature.vidileth.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.vidileth.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.vidileth.strikes.tentacle.name: tentacle
creature.vilderavn.abilities.aura-of-dis: 30 feet, DC 35. As [[ability.frightful-presence|frightful presence]], plus a creature [[condition.frightened|frightened]] by the aura becomes suspicious; it doesn't count any other creature as its ally and can't [[action.aid|Aid]] or flank. On a critical failure, the creature also can't be a willing target for harmless or helpful magic.
creature.vilderavn.abilities.bloodbird.t: A creature hit by a vilderavn's melee attack becomes cursed. It takes 2d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]] that's difficult to stanch. The DC to stop the bleeding using [[action.administer-first-aid|Administer First Aid]] is 35, and healing the creature to full HP doesn't automatically end the bleeding. Removing the curse ends the bleeding.
creature.vilderavn.abilities.change-shap: The vilderavn takes on the appearance of a Small or Medium humanoid, [[creature.wolf|wolf]], [[creature.dire-wolf|dire wolf]], or hybrid with both raven and wolf parts. The vilderavn can only use their jaws attack when in a form with a wolf's head, and their talon attack in a form with raven qualities. They can instead assume their raven knight form: a Medium humanoid in black full plate carrying a greatsword. They can use their jaws or talon Strikes only in a form that has that body part, and their greatsword only in knight form.
creature.vilderavn.abilities.souleater.t: If the vilderavn kills a [[trait.humanoid|humanoid]] with a critical hit using their jaws Strike, they rip out and devour the target's heart and soul as part of the attack. While the target is dead, the vilderavn can Change Shape into the target's form, gaining a +4 status bonus to [[skill.deception|Deception]] checks to [[action.impersonate|impersonate]] the target. If magic would resurrect the creature, the caster must succeed at a DC 34 counteract check to extract the target's soul from the vilderavn; otherwise, the spell fails.
creature.vilderavn.name: Vilderavn
creature.vilderavn.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.vilderavn.strikes.talon.name: talon
creature.viper.abilities.slink.name: Slink
creature.viper.abilities.slink.text: The viper Strides, [[action.climb|Climbs]], or [[action.swim|Swims]] up to 10 feet (or up to the relevant Speed, if that Speed is less than 10 feet). It must end its movement in a location that isn't within 5 feet of a foe. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
creature.viper.abilities.slink.trigger: A creature ends its movement adjacent to the viper or within the viper's space
creature.viper.abilities.viper-venom.tex: **Saving Throw** DC 16 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 4 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d8 poison damage (1 round)
creature.viper.name: Viper
creature.viper.strikes.fangs.name: fangs
creature.voidworm.abilities.change-shape: The voidworm takes on the appearance of a Tiny [[trait.animal|animal]]. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes but might change the damage type their Strikes deal.
creature.voidworm.abilities.confounding-: A creature hit by the voidworm's tail Strike is [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] for 1 round (stupefied 2 on a critical hit). A successful DC 16 Will save negates this effect and grants temporary immunity to confounding lash for 1 minute.
creature.voidworm.abilities.entropy-sens: A voidworm can anticipate the most likely presence of a creature through a supernatural insight into chaotic probabilities and chance. This grants them the ability to sense creatures within the listed range. [[spell.veil-of-privacy|Veil of privacy]] prevents a creature from being detected via entropy sense automatically (without a counteract check).
creature.voidworm.abilities.protean-anat:
A voidworm's vital organs shift and change shape and position constantly. Immediately after the voidworm takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage, they gain the listed amount of resistance to that damage type. This lasts for 1 hour or until the next time the protean takes damage of one of the other types (in which case their resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first.

The voidworm is immune to [[trait.polymorph|polymorph]] effects unless they're a willing target. If [[condition.blinded|blinded]] or [[condition.deafened|deafened]], the voidworm automatically recovers at the end of their next turn as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.
creature.voidworm.name: Voidworm
creature.voidworm.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.voidworm.strikes.tail.name: tail
creature.vordine.abilities.burning-hoofp: The vordine Strides, trailing hoofprints in each square they exit. The hoofprints burn for 1 minute. A creature on the ground that enters a square with burning hoofprints or begins its turn in one takes 1d4 fire damage.
creature.vordine.abilities.trident-of-di: The vordine makes a trident Strike, increasing their reach to 10 feet for that Strike. If there is an [[trait.unholy|unholy]] ally between the vordine and their target, that creature's energy causes the Strike to deal an additional 1d6 spirit damage.
creature.vordine.name: Vordine
creature.vordine.strikes.hoof.name: hoof
creature.vordine.strikes.trident-2.name: trident
creature.vordine.strikes.trident.name: trident
creature.vordine.strikes.whip.name: whip
creature.vrolikai.abilities.black-flame-: The vrolikai manifests a dagger-shaped blade of what looks like crystallized black flame in each of their four hands. These weapons function as +2 [[item.striking-greater|greater striking]] [[item.dagger|daggers]] that deal an additional 2d6 void damage. They fade away into nothingness 1 minute after a vrolikai no longer carries them.
creature.vrolikai.abilities.consume-deat:
The vrolikai focuses their deathstealing gaze upon a single target they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Fortitude save against death-stealing gaze.

**Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Failure** The creature is affected by death-stealing gaze and becomes [[condition.drained|drained 1]]. If the creature was already drained 1 by the death-stealing gaze before attempting the save, a failed save increases the value of the drained condition by 1, to a maximum of drained 4. The vrolikai gains 10 temporary Hit Points, and the drained creature is temporarily immune until the start of the vrolikai's next turn.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature increases the amount of drain by 2.
creature.vrolikai.abilities.death-steali: 30 feet. When a non-[[trait.demon|demon]] ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a DC 38 Fortitude save. If it fails, it becomes [[condition.drained|drained 1]]. A creature that dies while it has drain from a vrolikai's gaze rises as a ghoul the next midnight. The GM determines what kind of ghoul.
creature.vrolikai.abilities.focused-flam:
The vrolikai attacks a single target with all of their black flame knives. The demon makes a black flame knife Strike with the following additional effects. This counts toward the vrolikai's multiple attack penalty as a number of attacks equal to the number of back flame knives the vrolikai used.

**Critical Success** The target takes an additional 2d6 void damage for each knife beyond the first (typically 6d6 extra damage) and takes 4d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent void damage]].

**Success** The target takes an additional 2d6 void damage for each knife beyond the first.

**Failure** The vrolikai deals the damage their black flame knife Strike normally deals on a hit.
The sting of a vrolikai is mind-warping. A creature struck must attempt a DC 44 Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature becomes [[condition.stupefied|stupefied 1]] for 1 minute.

**Failure** The creature becomes stupefied 1. If it's already stupefied, its stupefied value increases by 1 instead (to a maximum of stupefied 4).

**Critical Failure** As failure, plus the creature is [[condition.confused|confused]] for 1 minute.
creature.vrolikai.name: Vrolikai
creature.vrolikai.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.vrolikai.strikes.stinger.name: stinger

creature.war-horse.abilities.gallop.name: Gallop

creature.warg.abilities.avenging-bite.tr: A creature within reach of the warg's jaws attacks one of the warg's allies
creature.warg.abilities.pack-attack.name: Pack Attack
creature.warg.abilities.pack-attack.text: The warg's Strikes deal 1d4 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the warg's allies.

creature.warsworn.abilities.absorb.name: Absorb
creature.warsworn.abilities.absorb.text: The warsworn absorbs the dying creature into itself, instantly killing the creature and healing the warsworn for a number of Hit Points equal to the creature's level. As long as the warsworn still exists, absorbed creatures can't be resurrected except by wish or a similarly powerful effect.
creature.warsworn.abilities.absorb.trigg: The warsworn moves into a [[condition.dying|dying]] creature's space
creature.warsworn.abilities.animated-wea: 100 feet. The warsworn automatically controls unattended weapons in the aura, which levitate around the warsworn. The warsworn can telekinetically wield these weapons to make melee Strikes with a reach of 100 feet. These strikes deal four of the weapon's damage dice +9 and use the weapon's damage type.
creature.warsworn.abilities.energy-drain: When a warsworn hits with a corpse wave Strike or damages a creature with Trample, the target must succeed at a DC 35 Fortitude save or become [[condition.drained|drained 2]] and [[condition.doomed|doomed 1]]. On a critical success, the target becomes temporarily immune to the warsworn's energy drain for 24 hours.
creature.warsworn.abilities.plummet.name: Plummet
creature.warsworn.abilities.plummet.text: A creature hit by a warsworn's scrap ball Strike must attempt a DC 37 Reflex save. On a failure, the target falls [[condition.prone|prone]]; if the target was airborne, it falls up to 120 feet, taking damage from the fall and landing prone if the descent brings it to the ground. On a critical failure, the target is also held under a pile of scrap ([[action.escape|Escape]] DC 37).
creature.warsworn.abilities.trample.name: Trample
creature.warsworn.abilities.trample.text: Huge or smaller, corpse wave, DC 37
creature.warsworn.name: Warsworn
creature.wasp-swarm.abilities.swarming-s: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d8 piercing damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save). A creature that fails its save is also exposed to wasp venom.
creature.wasp-swarm.abilities.wasp-venom: **Saving Throw** DC 21 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d6 poison and [[condition.clumsy|clumsy]] 2 (2 rounds)
creature.wasp-swarm.name: Wasp Swarm
creature.water-scamp.abilities.acid-brea: The water scamp breathes acid in a 15-foot cone that deals 2d6 acid damage to each creature within the area (DC 17 basic Reflex save). The water scamp can't use Acid Breath again for 1d4 rounds.
creature.water-scamp.abilities.drench.te: The water scamp shakes out a seemingly endless supply of water from its fur to put out all fires in a 5-foot emanation. The scamp extinguishes all non-magical fires automatically and attempts to counteract magical fires (+7 counteract modifier).
creature.water-scamp.name: Water Scamp
creature.water-scamp.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.werebear.abilities.bear-empathy: The werebear can communicate with ursine creatures.
creature.werebear.abilities.change-shape: Medium human with fist +13 for 1d4+7 bludgeoning, or grizzly bear with Speed 35 feet.
creature.werebear.abilities.hunt-prey.te: The werebear designates a single creature they can see and hear, or one they're [[action.track|Tracking]], as their prey. The werebear gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks when they [[action.seek|Seek]] their prey and to [[skill.survival|Survival]] checks when they Track their prey. The first time the werebear hits the designated prey in a round, they deal an additional 1d8 precision damage. These effects last until the werebear uses Hunt Prey again.
creature.werebear.abilities.mauler.name: Mauler
creature.werebear.abilities.mauler.text: The werebear gains a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures it has [[condition.grabbed|grabbed]].
creature.werebear.name: Werebear
creature.werebear.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.werebear.strikes.greataxe.name: greataxe
creature.werebear.strikes.hatchet-2.name: hatchet
creature.werebear.strikes.hatchet.name: hatchet
creature.werebear.strikes.jaws.name: jaws

The wererat gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
A creature targets the wererat with an attack and the wererat can see the attacker
creature.wererat.abilities.rat-empathy.t: The wererat can communicate with rodents.
The wererat deals 1d6 extra precision damage to [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] creatures

creature.weretiger.abilities.pounce.name: Pounce
creature.weretiger.abilities.pounce.text: The weretiger Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the weretiger began this action [[condition.hidden|hidden]], they remain hidden until after this ability's Strike.
creature.weretiger.abilities.rend.name: Rend
creature.weretiger.abilities.tiger-empat: The weretiger can communicate with felines.
creature.weretiger.name: Weretiger
creature.weretiger.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.weretiger.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.werewolf.abilities.change-shape: Human with fist +11 for 1d4+8 bludgeoning, or wolf with Speed 40 feet and jaws with [[ability.knockdown|Knockdown]].
The werewolf's Strikes deal 1d6 extra damage to creatures within reach of at least two of the werewolf's allies.
creature.werewolf.abilities.wolf-empathy: The werewolf can communicate with canine creatures.
creature.werewolf.name: Werewolf
creature.werewolf.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.werewolf.strikes.jaws.name: jaws
creature.wight.abilities.corrupting-spit: The wight's [[trait.unarmed|unarmed]] attacks and bound weapons inflict a curse that makes a creature grow weak and spiteful. If a wight inflicts corrupting spite on a creature already afflicted by it, the victim attempts a new save, ignoring the result if it's better than a failure. A living humanoid that dies while under the curse rises as a wight after 1d4 rounds, [[condition.controlled|controlled]] by the wight that killed it. The wight spawn can't inflict corrupting spite and is [[condition.clumsy|clumsy 2]]. If its creator dies or after roughly a month of existence, the new wight becomes autonomous and turns into a normal wight; **Saving Throw** DC 17 Fortitude; **Stage 1** [[condition.drained|drained 1]] (1 round); **Stage 2** drained 2 and doesn't treat any creatures as allies (1 round); **Stage 3** As stage 2, except drained 3 (1 round); **Stage 4** As stage 2, except drained 4 (1 round).
creature.wight.abilities.final-spite.tex: The wight makes a Strike before being destroyed. This Strike can inflict corrupting spite, but fueled by spite doesn't apply.
creature.wight.abilities.final-spite.tri: The wight is reduced to 0 Hit Points
creature.wight.abilities.fueled-by-spite: Each time a creature loses Hit Points due to a corrupting spite curse the wight inflicted, the wight gains 3 temporary Hit Points.
creature.wight.abilities.grave-weapon.te: The wight is bound to a dagger it was buried with. Other wights can be bound to different weapons.
creature.wight.name: Wight
creature.wight.strikes.claw.name: claw
creature.wight.strikes.dagger-2.name: dagger
creature.wight.strikes.dagger.name: dagger
creature.will-o-wisp.abilities.feed-on-f: An enemy within 15 feet is under a [[trait.fear|fear]] effect or [[condition.dying|dying]]
The will-o'-wisp feeds on the creature's terror. It regains 2d4 Hit Points, and if it has Gone Dark, its glow reignites.
creature.will-o-wisp.abilities.glow.name: Glow
creature.will-o-wisp.abilities.glow.text: 20 feet. A will-o'-wisp is itself naturally [[condition.invisible|invisible]], but glows with a colored light, casting bright light in the aura and making it visible.
creature.will-o-wisp.abilities.go-dark.t: The will-o'-wisp extinguishes its glow, becoming [[condition.invisible|invisible]]. It can end this effect with another use of this action. If it uses its shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine its location, making the will-o'-wisp only [[condition.hidden|hidden]] to all observers until it moves.
creature.will-o-wisp.abilities.magic-imm: A will-o'-wisp is immune to all spells except [[spell.force-barrage|force barrage]], [[spell.quandary|quandary]], and [[spell.revealing-light|revealing light]].
creature.will-o-wisp.name: Will-O'-Wisp
creature.will-o-wisp.strikes.shock.name: shock

creature.witchwarg.abilities.buck.name: Buck
creature.witchwarg.abilities.pack-attack: The witchwarg's Strikes deal 1d6 extra damage to creatures within the reach of at least two of the witchwarg's allies.

creature.wolf.name: Wolf
