You gain the [[feat.terrain-stalker|Terrain Stalker]] feat, even if you're not trained in [[skill.stealth|Stealth]], and you must choose underbrush as your chosen terrain.
item.absolute-solvent-greater.name: Absolute Solvent (Greater)
item.absolute-solvent-greater.text:
Originally formulated as a means of dissolving everlasting adhesive, this powerful solvent can break almost any adhesive's grip. As absolute solvent is particularly effective against everlasting adhesive, it automatically dissolves everlasting adhesive. It attempts to counteract any other adhesives, such as glue bombs, with a counteract modifier depending on the type.

The solvent counteracts at 9th-rank and has a counteract modifier of +28.
item.absolute-solvent-lesser.name: Absolute Solvent (Lesser)
item.absolute-solvent-lesser.text:
Originally formulated as a means of dissolving everlasting adhesive, this powerful solvent can break almost any adhesive's grip. As absolute solvent is particularly effective against everlasting adhesive, it automatically dissolves everlasting adhesive. It attempts to counteract any other adhesives, such as glue bombs, with a counteract modifier depending on the type.

The solvent counteracts at 3rd-rank and has a counteract modifier of +9.
item.absolute-solvent-moderate.name: Absolute Solvent (Moderate)
item.absolute-solvent-moderate.text:
Originally formulated as a means of dissolving everlasting adhesive, this powerful solvent can break almost any adhesive's grip. As absolute solvent is particularly effective against everlasting adhesive, it automatically dissolves everlasting adhesive. It attempts to counteract any other adhesives, such as glue bombs, with a counteract modifier depending on the type.

The solvent counteracts at 6th-rank and has a counteract modifier of +19.
item.absolute-solvent.name: Absolute Solvent
item.absolute-solvent.text: Originally formulated as a means of dissolving everlasting adhesive, this powerful solvent can break almost any adhesive's grip. As absolute solvent is particularly effective against everlasting adhesive, it automatically dissolves everlasting adhesive. It attempts to counteract any other adhesives, such as glue bombs, with a counteract modifier depending on the type.
item.acid-flask-greater.name: Acid Flask (Greater)
item.acid-flask-greater.text:
This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, the listed [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent acid damage]], and the listed acid splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d6 persistent acid damage and 3 acid splash damage.
item.acid-flask-lesser.name: Acid Flask (Lesser)
item.acid-flask-lesser.text:
This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, the listed [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent acid damage]], and the listed acid splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

The bomb deals 1d6 persistent acid damage and 1 acid splash damage.
item.acid-flask-major.name: Acid Flask (Major)
item.acid-flask-major.text:
This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, the listed [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent acid damage]], and the listed acid splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +3 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 4d6 persistent acid damage and 4 acid splash damage.
item.acid-flask-moderate.name: Acid Flask (Moderate)
item.acid-flask-moderate.text:
This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, the listed [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent acid damage]], and the listed acid splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 2d6 persistent acid damage and 2 acid splash damage.
item.acid-flask.name: Acid Flask
item.acid-flask.text: This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, the listed [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent acid damage]], and the listed acid splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.
item.adventurers-pack.name: Adventurer's Pack
item.adventurers-pack.text:
This item is the starter kit for an adventurer, containing the essential items for exploration and survival. The Bulk value is for the entire pack together, but see the descriptions of individual items as necessary.

The pack contains the following items: a [[item.backpack|backpack]], a [[item.bedroll|bedroll]], 10 pieces of [[item.chalk|chalk]], [[item.flint-and-steel|flint and steel]], 50 feet of [[item.rope|rope]], 2 weeks' [[item.rations|rations]], [[item.soap|soap]], 5 [[item.torch|torches]], and a [[item.waterskin|waterskin]].
item.adze.name: Adze
item.adze.text: A common cutting tool, an adze resembles an axe—but the cutting edge is horizontal, rather than vertical. The adze’s shape makes it popular among woodworkers, and tripkee builders often use them to construct their treetop homes. The tool also serves as an effective weapon, due in part to the immense strength required to swing it.
item.alarm-snare.name: Alarm Snare
item.alarm-snare.text: You create an alarm snare by rigging one or more noisy objects to a trip wire or pressure plate. When you create an alarm snare, you designate a range between 100 to 500 feet at which it can be heard. When a Small or larger creature enters the square, the snare makes a noise loud enough that it can be heard by all creatures in the range you designated.
item.alchemical-bomb.name: Alchemical Bomb
item.alchemical-bomb.text: These bombs come in a variety of types and levels of power, but no matter the variety, you throw the bomb at the target and it explodes, unleashing its alchemical blast.
item.alchemist-goggles-greater.name: Alchemist Goggles (Greater)
item.alchemist-goggles-greater.text:
These brass goggles are engraved with flame patterns and have thick, heavy lenses. While worn, they give you a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to [[action.craft|Craft]] alchemical items. When making [[action.strike|Strikes]] with alchemical bombs, you ignore lesser cover . If your Strike with an alchemical bomb fails (but doesn't critically fail), you gain a +1 item bonus to the splash damage the target of the Strike takes.

The item bonus increases to +2, and the item bonus to splash damage on a miss is +2.
item.alchemist-goggles-major.name: Alchemist Goggles (Major)
item.alchemist-goggles-major.text:
These brass goggles are engraved with flame patterns and have thick, heavy lenses. While worn, they give you a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to [[action.craft|Craft]] alchemical items. When making [[action.strike|Strikes]] with alchemical bombs, you ignore lesser cover . If your Strike with an alchemical bomb fails (but doesn't critically fail), you gain a +1 item bonus to the splash damage the target of the Strike takes.

The item bonus increases to +3, and the item bonus to splash damage on a miss is +3.
item.alchemist-goggles.name: Alchemist Goggles
item.alchemist-goggles.text: These brass goggles are engraved with flame patterns and have thick, heavy lenses. While worn, they give you a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to [[action.craft|Craft]] alchemical items. When making [[action.strike|Strikes]] with alchemical bombs, you ignore lesser cover . If your Strike with an alchemical bomb fails (but doesn't critically fail), you gain a +1 item bonus to the splash damage the target of the Strike takes.
item.alchemists-fire-greater.name: Alchemist's Fire (Greater)
item.alchemists-fire-greater.text:
Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals the listed fire damage, [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent fire damage]], and splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d8 fire damage, 3 persistent fire damage, and 3 fire splash damage.
item.alchemists-fire-lesser.name: Alchemist's Fire (Lesser)
item.alchemists-fire-lesser.text:
Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals the listed fire damage, [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent fire damage]], and splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

The bomb deals 1d8 fire damage, 1 persistent fire damage, and 1 fire splash damage.
item.alchemists-fire-major.name: Alchemist's Fire (Major)
item.alchemists-fire-major.text:
Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals the listed fire damage, [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent fire damage]], and splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +3 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 4d8 fire damage, 4 persistent fire damage, and 4 fire splash damage.
item.alchemists-fire-moderate.name: Alchemist's Fire (Moderate)
item.alchemists-fire-moderate.text:
Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals the listed fire damage, [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent fire damage]], and splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 2d8 fire damage, 2 persistent fire damage, and 2 fire splash damage.
item.alchemists-fire.name: Alchemist's Fire
item.alchemists-fire.text: Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals the listed fire damage, [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent fire damage]], and splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.
item.alchemists-lab-expanded.name: Alchemist's Lab (Expanded)
item.alchemists-lab-expanded.text:
You need an alchemist's lab to [[action.craft|Craft]] alchemical items during downtime.

An expanded alchemist's lab gives a +1 item bonus to [[skill.crafting|Crafting]] checks to create alchemical items.
item.alchemists-lab.name: Alchemist's Lab
item.alchemists-lab.text: You need an alchemist's lab to [[action.craft|Craft]] alchemical items during downtime.
item.alchemists-toolkit.name: Alchemist's Toolkit
item.alchemists-toolkit.text:
This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks. If you wear your alchemist's toolkit, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them.

You can use a toolkit with 1 hand if you’re wearing it or 2 if you’re holding it. See here for details.
item.antidote-greater.name: Antidote (Greater)
item.antidote-greater.text:
An antidote protects you against toxins. Upon drinking an antidote, you gain an item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against poisons for 6 hours.

You gain a +4 item bonus.

item.antler-arrow.name: Antler Arrow
item.antler-arrow.text:
The creation of these arrows was inspired by an encounter with a horned archon scout who sought to peacefully restrain an escaping foe. When an activated antler arrow hits a target, glowing antlers extend to pin it down. The target must succeed at a DC 16 Reflex save or become stuck to the surface, taking the critical specialization effects of a bow.

If the hit with the antler arrow is a critical hit and you have access to the bow critical specialization effect, the DC of the Athletics check increases to 15.
item.arbalest.name: Arbalest
item.arbalest.text: This large and well-made crossbow requires some training to use effectively, but it's assembled with a cutting-edge firing mechanism that maximizes its speed, power, and accuracy
item.arrows.name: Arrows
item.arrows.text: These projectiles are the ammunition for bows. The shaft of an arrow is made of wood. It is stabilized in flight by fletching at one end and bears a metal head on the other.
item.arsenic.name: Arsenic
item.arsenic.text:
This toxin is a compound of arsenic and other substances. You can't reduce your [[condition.sickened|sickened]] condition while affected.

**Saving Throw** DC 18 Fortitude; **Onset** 10 minutes; **Maximum Duration** 5 minutes; **Stage 1** 1d4 poison damage and sickened 1 (1 minute); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison damage and sickened 2 (1 minute); **Stage 3** 1d8 poison damage and sickened 3 (1 minute)
item.artisans-toolkit-sterling.name: Artisan's Toolkit (Sterling)
item.artisans-toolkit-sterling.text:
You need this toolkit to create items from raw materials with the [[action.craft|Craft]] skill. Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

You can use a toolkit with 1 hand if you’re wearing it or 2 if you’re holding it. See here for details.

A sterling artisan's toolkit gives you a +1 item bonus to the check.

item.backpack.name: Backpack
item.backpack.text: A backpack holds up to 4 Bulk of items, and the first 2 Bulk of these items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the pack rather than wearing it on your back, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.
item.balisse-feather-greater.name: Balisse Feather (Greater)
item.balisse-feather-greater.text:
This long, fire-red feather smolders from the weapon it adorns. When you activate the feather, the creature you damaged burns with sacred light. The creature must succeed at a DC 29 Will save or take a –2 status penalty to AC and saving throws and reduce its resistances by 5. These effects last until the end of your next turn. This item has no effect on a creature with the [[trait.holy|holy]] trait.

The DC is 35, and the creature’s resistances are reduced by 10.

item.barding-heavy-large.name: Barding (Heavy; Large)
item.barding-heavy-large.text: You can purchase special armor for animals, called barding (shown on Table 6–18). All animals have a trained proficiency rank in light barding, and combat-trained animals are trained in heavy barding. Barding uses the same rules as armor except for the following. The Price and Bulk of barding depend on the animal’s size. Unlike for a suit of armor, barding’s Strength entry is listed as a modifier, not a score. Barding can’t be etched with magic runes, though special magical barding might be available.

item.basic-crafters-book.text: This book contains formulas for [[skill.crafting|Crafting]] the 0-level common items in this chapter.
item.bastard-sword.name: Bastard Sword
item.bastard-sword.text: This broad-bladed sword, sometimes called the hand-and-a-half sword, has a longer grip so it can be held in one hand or used with two hands to provide extra slashing power.
item.battle-axe.name: Battle Axe
item.battle-axe.text: These axes are designed explicitly as weapons, rather than tools. They typically weigh less, with a shaft reinforced with metal bands or bolts, and have a sharper blade, making them ideal for chopping limbs rather than wood.
item.bedroll.name: Bedroll
item.belladonna.name: Belladonna
item.belladonna.text:
Sometimes called “deadly nightshade,” belladonna is a widely available toxin produced from a plant similar to a tomato.

**Saving Throw** DC 19 Fortitude; **Onset** 10 minutes; **Maximum Duration** 30 minutes; **Stage 1** [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]] (10 minutes); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison damage and [[condition.sickened|sickened]] 1 (10 minutes); **Stage 3** 1d6 poison damage, [[condition.confused|confused]], and sickened 1 (1 minute)
item.berserkers-cloak-greater.name: Berserker's Cloak (Greater)
item.berserkers-cloak-greater.text:
This bearskin includes the head and bared teeth of the mighty creature from which it was taken. When worn, the cloak drapes over your head and around your shoulders, imbuing you with a bear's ferocity. If you have the [[action.rage|Rage]] action, while raging, you grow jaws that deal 1d10 piercing damage and claws that deal 1d6 slashing damage and have the [[trait.agile|agile]] trait. This transformation is a morph effect, and both the jaws and claws are unarmed attacks in the brawling weapon group. You gain the benefits of a +1 weapon potency rune and a [[item.striking|striking rune]] with these attacks (gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice by one). 
If you have an animal instinct and the bestial rage instinct ability, instead of gaining these unarmed attacks, your unarmed attacks from the bestial rage instinct ability gain the benefits of a +2 weapon potency rune and a [[item.striking-greater|greater striking rune]] (granting a +2 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice by two).

You gain the benefits of a +2 weapon potency rune and a greater striking rune, or a +3 weapon potency rune and a major striking rune if you have an animal instinct and the bestial rage instinct ability.

item.bestial-mutagen-greater.name: Bestial Mutagen (Greater)
item.bestial-mutagen-greater.text:
Your features transform into something bestial and lumbering.

**Benefit** You gain an item bonus to [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack with the agile trait and a jaws unarmed attack. Striking runes don't modify the damage caused by these attacks.

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to Reflex saves, [[skill.acrobatics|Acrobatics]] checks, and [[skill.stealth|Stealth]] checks.

You gain a +3 item bonus, your claw deals 3d8 slashing damage, your jaws deal 3d10 piercing damage, and the duration is 1 hour.

item.biting-snare.name: Biting Snare
item.biting-snare.text:
This snare closes shut on the leg of a creature. The snare deals 5d6 piercing damage to the first creature that enters its square; that creature must attempt a DC 21 Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speed until it recovers at least 1 Hit Point.
item.black-adder-venom.name: Black Adder Venom
item.black-adder-venom.text:
Adder venom is a simple but effective way to enhance a weapon.

**Saving Throw** DC 18 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 3 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d4 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 3** 1d8 poison damage (1 round)
item.black-lotus-extract.name: Black Lotus Extract
item.black-lotus-extract.text:
Black lotus extract causes severe internal bleeding.

**Saving Throw** DC 42 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 minute; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 13d6 poison damage and [[condition.drained|drained]] 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** 15d6 poison damage and drained 1 (1 round); **Stage 3** 17d6 poison damage and drained 2 (1 round)
item.blasting-stone-greater.name: Blasting Stone (Greater)
item.blasting-stone-greater.text:
When this pebble hits a creature or a hard surface, it explodes with a deafening bang. A blasting stone deals the listed sonic damage and sonic splash damage, and each creature within 10 feet of the space in which the stone exploded must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw with the listed DC or be [[condition.deafened|deafened]] until the end of its next turn. Many types of blasting stones grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d4 sonic damage and 3 sonic splash damage, and the DC is 28.

item.bleeding-spines-snare.name: Bleeding Spines Snare
item.bleeding-spines-snare.text: When a creature enters the square, thorny spines protrude out to stab it, dealing 8d8 piercing damage and [[condition.persistent-damage|2d8 persistent bleed damage]]. The creature must attempt a DC 31 basic Reflex saving throw. After the initial trigger, the spines retract and protrude again repeatedly for 1 minute, forcing any creature that enters the space or ends its turn in the space to take damage from the spines (attempting the same basic Reflex save).

item.blight-bomb-greater.text:
Blight bombs contain volatile toxic chemicals that rot flesh. A blight bomb deals the listed poison damage, [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent poison damage]], and splash damage. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d4 poison damage, 3d4 persistent poison damage, and 3 poison splash damage.

item.blightburn-resin.name: Blightburn Resin
item.blightburn-resin.text:
This tacky, hardened sap is harvested from trees infected by fungal blights and exposed to open flames.

**Saving Throw** DC 30 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 minute; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 6d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 7d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 3** 9d6 poison damage (1 round)
item.blowgun-darts.name: Blowgun Darts
item.blowgun-darts.text: These thin, light darts are typically made of hardwood and stabilized with fletching of down or fur. They are often hollow so they can be used to deliver poison.
item.blowgun.name: Blowgun
item.blowgun.text: This long, narrow tube is used for shooting blowgun darts, using only the power of a forcefully exhaled breath.
item.bo-staff.name: Bo Staff
item.bo-staff.text: This strong but slender staff is tapered at the ends and well balanced. It's designed to be an offensive and defensive weapon.
item.bola.name: Bola
item.bola.text: This throwing weapon consists of weights tied to the end of long cords, which can be used to bludgeon foes or entangle their legs.
item.bolts.name: Bolts
item.bolts.text: Shorter than traditional arrows but similar in construction, bolts are the ammunition used by crossbows.
item.bomb-snare.name: Bomb Snare
item.bomb-snare.text:
You create a snare that causes three 3rd-level moderate alchemical bombs of the same type to explode when a creature triggers the snare. The target and all creatures in adjacent squares must attempt a DC 24 Reflex save, as the snare deals damage equal to three times the direct hit damage from one of the component bombs (for example, 6d6 electricity damage from three moderate bottled lightnings) with no splash damage or other effects.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and no other effects.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage. It also takes all other effects of a direct hit from one of the component bombs (such as [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] from bottled lightning [[condition.persistent-damage|or persistent damage]] from an acid flask).

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage, plus all other effects of a direct hit (as failure).

**Craft Requirements** Supply three of the same damaging 3rd-level moderate alchemical bomb.
item.bombers-eye-elixir-greater.name: Bomber's Eye Elixir (Greater)
item.bombers-eye-elixir-greater.text:
This tincture lets you pinpoint your foes. For the next 5 minutes, your alchemical bomb [[action.strike|Strikes]] reduce the circumstance bonus to AC your targets gain from cover.

Reduce your targets’ circumstance bonus by 2.

item.bottled-catharsis-minor.text:
This drink unlocks a flood of emotions that helps reset your mental state. When you drink this elixir, the elixir attempts to counteract each effect on you that has the [[trait.emotion|emotion]] trait or is inflicting the [[condition.stupefied|stupefied]] condition on you, using the listed counteract rank and modifier.

The elixir counteracts at 1st-rank and has a +6 counteract modifier.

item.bottled-lightning-greater.name: Bottled Lightning (Greater)
item.bottled-lightning-greater.text:
Bottled lightning is packed with volatile reagents that create a blast of electricity when they're exposed to air. Bottled lightning deals the listed electricity damage and [[condition.persistent-damage|electricity splash damage]]. On a hit, the target becomes [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] until the start of your next turn. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d6 electricity damage and 3 electricity splash damage.

item.brass-ear.name: Brass Ear
item.brass-ear.text: A brass ear is a short, flared tube with one end narrow enough to comfortably fit against the ear canal. When using it to listen through a door, window, thin wall, or similar barrier, if the barrier would normally increase the DC of your Perception check to hear sounds on the other side, the DC increases by only half as much as normal. It's not suitable for improving your hearing in general, a role better served by a [[item.hearing-aid|hearing aids]].
item.bravos-brew-greater.name: Bravo's Brew (Greater)
item.bravos-brew-greater.text:
This flask of foaming beer grants courage. For the next hour after drinking this elixir, you gain an item bonus to Will saves, which is greater when attempting Will saves against [[trait.fear|fear]].

The bonus on Will saves is +3, or +4 against fear. If you roll a success on a save against fear, you get a critical success instead.
item.bravos-brew-lesser.name: Bravo's Brew (Lesser)
item.bravos-brew-lesser.text:
This flask of foaming beer grants courage. For the next hour after drinking this elixir, you gain an item bonus to Will saves, which is greater when attempting Will saves against [[trait.fear|fear]].

The bonus on Will saves is +1, or +2 against fear.
item.bravos-brew-moderate.name: Bravo's Brew (Moderate)
item.bravos-brew-moderate.text:
This flask of foaming beer grants courage. For the next hour after drinking this elixir, you gain an item bonus to Will saves, which is greater when attempting Will saves against [[trait.fear|fear]].

The bonus on Will saves is +2, or +3 against fear.

item.breaching-pike.name: Breaching Pike
item.breaching-pike.text: Forged with a heavy metal wedge effective at damaging enemy shields, breaching pikes are often used by hobgoblin infantry alongside a [[item.tower-shield|tower shield]].
item.breastplate.name: Breastplate
item.breastplate.text: Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or half-plate armor (see below) that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.
item.brimstone-fumes.name: Brimstone Fumes
item.brimstone-fumes.text:
Fumes from infernal forges drain health and strength alike.

**Saving Throw** DC 36 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 round; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds**; Stage 1** 7d8 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled]] 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** 8d8 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 10d8 poison damage and enfeebled 3 (1 round)
item.buckler.name: Buckler
item.buckler.text: This very small shield is a favorite of duelists and quick, lightly armored warriors. It's typically made of steel and strapped to your forearm. You can [[action.raise-a-shield|Raise a Shield]] with your buckler as long as you have that hand free or are holding a light object that's not a weapon in that hand.
item.caltrop-snare.name: Caltrop Snare
item.caltrop-snare.text:
This snare consists of a hidden canister of [[item.caltrops|caltrops]] attached to a trip wire. When the snare is triggered, it flings the caltrops into either the snare's square or a square adjacent to the snare. You choose which square when you set up the snare. 
If the caltrops scatter into the same square as a creature, that creature must attempt the [[skill.acrobatics|Acrobatics]] check immediately.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a container of [[item.caltrops|caltrops]].
item.caltrops.name: Caltrops
item.caltrops.text: These four-pronged metal spikes can damage a creature's feet. You can scatter caltrops in an empty square adjacent to you with an Interact action. The first creature that moves into that square must succeed at a DC 14 [[skill.acrobatics|Acrobatics]] check or take 1d4 piercing damage and 1 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent bleed damage]]. A creature taking persistent bleed damage from caltrops takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speed. Spending an Interact action to pluck the caltrops free reduces the DC to stop the bleeding. Once a creature takes damage from caltrops, enough are ruined that other creatures moving into the square are safe. Deployed caltrops can be salvaged and reused if no creatures took damage from them. Otherwise, enough are ruined that they can't be salvaged.
item.candle-of-revealing.name: Candle of Revealing
item.candle-of-revealing.text: When lit, this black candle's eerie blue flame reveals the presence of invisible creatures. Within a 10-foot radius of the lit candle, creatures don't benefit from the [[condition.invisible|invisible]] condition. Their bodies are outlined, not fully visible, so they're [[condition.concealed|concealed]]. Once lit, the candle burns for 1 minute, after which the effect ends. If extinguished, it can't be relit.
item.candle.name: Candle
item.candle.text: A lit candle sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius for 8 hours.
item.cane.name: Cane
item.cane.text: A cane is a straight length of wood with a curved handle, shaped like the tip of a hook. Its simple design helps with balance and only slightly assists with taking weight off the affected opposite leg. The cane is typically 2 to 3 feet long but can be lengthened or shortened as needed.
item.capturing-spetum.name: Capturing Spetum
item.capturing-spetum.text: Hobgoblins use these polearms both as standard issue for aggressive military units and on an individual basis for hunting fugitives.
item.cats-eye-elixir.name: Cat's Eye Elixir
item.cats-eye-elixir.text: After you consume this elixir, your vision sharpens, and you become sensitive to even the most minute movements. For the next minute, you reduce the flat check to target [[condition.hidden|hidden]] creatures to 5, and you don't need to attempt a flat check to target [[condition.concealed|concealed]] creatures. These benefits apply only against creatures within 30 feet of you.
item.cave-worm-venom.name: Cave Worm Venom
item.cave-worm-venom.text:
Venom from enormous cave worms leaves a victim weakened.

**Saving Throw** DC 32 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 5d6 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled]] 2 (1 round); **Stage 2** 6d6 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 8d6 poison and enfeebled 2 (1 round)
item.cerulean-scourge.name: Cerulean Scourge
item.cerulean-scourge.text:
This poison is infamous for making the victim's blood vessels glow with a bright blue light before painfully bursting.

**Saving Throw** DC 37 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 10d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 12d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 3** 14d6 poison damage (1 round)
item.chain-mail.name: Chain Mail
item.chain-mail.text: A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.
item.chain-shirt.name: Chain Shirt
item.chain-shirt.text: Sometimes called a hauberk, this is a long shirt constructed of the same metal rings as chainmail. However, it is much lighter than chainmail and protects only the torso, upper arms, and upper legs of its wearer.
item.chain.name: Chain
item.chalice-of-justice.activations.0.te: The pommel of the weapon transmutes into the shape of a miniature chalice. You drink deep from the chalice and regain HP equal to the chalice's level. If you're holy, you regain double the HP, and for 1 minute, whenever you critically hit an unholy creature with the chalice of justice, the creature takes 2d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent spirit damage]], and it's slowed 1 for 1 round. The persistent spirit damage has the [[trait.holy|holy]] trait.
item.chalice-of-justice.name: Chalice of Justice
item.chalice-of-justice.text:
This gleaming golden sword is a +2 [[item.striking-greater|greater striking]] holy cold iron [[item.longsword|longsword]] given only to the worthiest heroes of a holy faith. It's made of a sacred, secret alloy that makes the blade both cold iron and silver. If you're [[trait.unholy|unholy]], you're [[condition.drained|drained]] 2 while holding a chalice of justice. You can't recover from this condition while holding the weapon.

**Activate—Sip of Justice** {1a} ([[trait.manipulate|manipulate]]) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The pommel of the weapon transmutes into the shape of a miniature chalice. You drink deep from the chalice and regain HP equal to the chalice's level. If you're holy, you regain double the HP, and for 1 minute, whenever you critically hit an unholy creature with the chalice of justice, the creature takes 2d6 [[condition.persistent-damage|persistent spirit damage]], and it's slowed 1 for 1 round. The persistent spirit damage has the [[trait.holy|holy]] trait.

**Craft Requirements** You're holy.
item.chalk.name: Chalk
item.cheetahs-elixir-greater.name: Cheetah's Elixir (Greater)
item.cheetahs-elixir-greater.text:
Enzymatic compounds in this elixir strengthen and excite the muscles in your legs. You gain a status bonus to your Speed for the listed duration.

The bonus is +10 feet, and the duration is 1 hour.

item.cheetahs-elixir-lesser.text:

The bonus is +5 feet, and the duration is 1 minute.

item.chest.name: Chest
item.chest.text: A wooden chest can hold up to 8 Bulk of items.
item.clan-dagger.name: Clan Dagger
item.clan-dagger.text: This broad dagger is carried by [[ancestry.dwarf|dwarves]] as a weapon, tool, and designation of clan. Losing or having to surrender a clan dagger is considered a mark of embarrassment to most dwarves.
item.claw-blade.name: Claw Blade
item.claw-blade.text: This handheld weapon’s three parallel blades extend between the fingers to resemble the natural claws of the amurruns who created them, providing a way for those catfolk without suitable natural claws to share the fighting customs of their kin.
item.climbing-kit-extreme.name: Climbing Kit (Extreme)
item.climbing-kit-extreme.text:
This satchel includes 50 feet of [[item.rope|rope]], pulleys, a dozen [[item.piton|pitons]], a hammer, a [[item.grappling-hook|grappling hook]], and one set of crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're [[action.climb|Climbing]], moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a DC 5 flat check whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit. If you wear your climbing kit, you can access it as part of a Climb action.

You gain a +1 item bonus to [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] checks to Climb while using an extreme climbing kit.
item.climbing-kit.name: Climbing Kit
item.climbing-kit.text: This satchel includes 50 feet of [[item.rope|rope]], pulleys, a dozen [[item.piton|pitons]], a hammer, a [[item.grappling-hook|grappling hook]], and one set of crampons. Climbing kits allow you to attach yourself to the wall you're [[action.climb|Climbing]], moving half as quickly as usual (minimum 5 feet) but letting you attempt a DC 5 flat check whenever you critically fail to prevent a fall. A single kit has only enough materials for one climber; each climber needs their own kit. If you wear your climbing kit, you can access it as part of a Climb action.
You cover a magic item with the cloth or wave the cloth near a magic effect and attempt to counteract the effect or item. The cloth's counteract check modifier is +32, and its counteract rank is 10. Regardless of the result, the cloth of nullification can't be activated again for 2d6 hours. On a success, the effect or item is deactivated for the same amount of time, and its duration, if any, continues to expire during that time. With a successful counteract check, you can instead choose to completely absorb the magic from the effect or item into the cloth of nullification. If you do, both become completely non-magical and their magic can't be recovered, even by the [[spell.remake|_remake_]] spell.
 The cloth of nullification automatically fails to counteract most artifacts and similarly powerful items.
item.cloth-of-nullification.name: Cloth of Nullification
item.cloth-of-nullification.text:
This small piece of embroidered cloth is inimical to all magic.

With a successful counteract check, you can instead choose to completely absorb the magic from the effect or item into the cloth of nullification. If you do, both become completely non-magical and their magic can't be recovered, even by the [[spell.remake|_remake_]] spell.

item.clothing-cold-weather.name: Clothing (Cold-Weather)
item.clothing-cold-weather.text:
Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

More expensive finery or clothes for specific climes cost more.
item.clothing-explorers.name: Clothing (Explorer's)
item.clothing-explorers.text:
Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

More expensive finery or clothes for specific climes cost more.

Explorer’s clothing is sturdy enough that it can be reinforced to protect you, even though it isn’t a suit of armor. It comes in many forms, though the most common sorts look like clerical vestments, monk’s garments, or wizard’s robes, as members of all three classes are likely to avoid wearing armor. For more information on explorer’s clothing, see [[item.explorers-clothing|its entry in the armor category]].
item.clothing-fine.name: Clothing (Fine)
item.clothing-fine.text:
Ordinary clothing is functional with basic tailoring, such as peasant garb, monk's robes, or work clothes.

More expensive finery or clothes for specific climes cost more.

item.club.name: Club
item.club.text: This is a piece of stout wood shaped or repurposed to bludgeon an enemy. Clubs can be intricately carved pieces of martial art or as simple as a tree branch or piece of wood.
item.cognitive-mutagen-greater.name: Cognitive Mutagen (Greater)
item.cognitive-mutagen-greater.text:
Your mind becomes clear, but physical matters seem ephemeral.

**Benefit** You gain an item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to Recall Knowledge. Your critical failures on [[action.recall-knowledge|Recall Knowledge]] checks become failures instead.

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] checks, and [[skill.acrobatics|Acrobatics]] checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming [[condition.encumbered|encumbered]], and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

The bonus is +3, and the duration is 1 hour. You become trained in one Intelligence-based skill, chosen at creation.

item.compass-lensatic.name: Compass (Lensatic)
item.compass-lensatic.text:
A compass helps you [[action.sense-direction|Sense Direction]] or navigate, provided you're in a location with uniform magnetic fields. Without a compass, you take a –2 item penalty to these checks (similar to using a shoddy item).

A lensatic compass gives you a +1 item bonus to these checks.
item.compass.name: Compass
item.compass.text: A compass helps you [[action.sense-direction|Sense Direction]] or navigate, provided you're in a location with uniform magnetic fields. Without a compass, you take a –2 item penalty to these checks (similar to using a shoddy item).
item.composite-longbow.name: Composite Longbow
item.composite-longbow.text: This projectile weapon is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Like all longbows, its great size also increases the bow's range and power. You must use two hands to fire it, and it cannot be used while mounted. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a longbow, it also applies to composite longbows unless otherwise stated.
item.composite-shortbow.name: Composite Shortbow
item.composite-shortbow.text: This shortbow is made from horn, wood, and sinew laminated together to increase the power of its pull and the force of its projectile. Its compact size and power make it a favorite of mounted archers. Any time an ability is specifically restricted to a shortbow, it also applies to composite shortbows unless otherwise stated.
item.comprehension-elixir-greater.name: Comprehension Elixir (Greater)
item.comprehension-elixir-greater.text:
This bitter draft opens your mind to the potential of the written word. For the listed duration after drinking this elixir, you can understand any words you read, as long as they're written in a common language. This elixir doesn't automatically allow you to understand codes or extremely esoteric passages—you still need to attempt a skill check to [[action.decipher-writing|Decipher Writing]].

The duration is 10 minutes.
item.comprehension-elixir-lesser.name: Comprehension Elixir (Lesser)
item.comprehension-elixir-lesser.text:
This bitter draft opens your mind to the potential of the written word. For the listed duration after drinking this elixir, you can understand any words you read, as long as they're written in a common language. This elixir doesn't automatically allow you to understand codes or extremely esoteric passages—you still need to attempt a skill check to [[action.decipher-writing|Decipher Writing]].

The duration is 1 minute.

item.concealed-sheath.name: Concealed Sheath
item.concealed-sheath.text: This leather sheath is large enough to hold an item of up to light Bulk and is typically used for daggers, wands, thieves' toolkits, and similar objects. You can affix it to the inside of a boot, under a bracer or sleeve, or in other inconspicuous locations to gain a +1 item bonus to [[skill.stealth|Stealth]] checks and DCs to hide or conceal the item within.
item.cookware.name: Cookware
item.cooling-elixir-greater.name: Cooling Elixir (Greater)
item.cooling-elixir-greater.text:
This elixir is made to help you withstand extreme environments. For 24 hours, you're protected from the effects of severe heat.

You’re also protected from extreme and incredible heat.
item.cooling-elixir-lesser.name: Cooling Elixir (Lesser)
item.cooling-elixir-lesser.text: This elixir is made to help you withstand extreme environments. For 24 hours, you're protected from the effects of severe heat.

item.cooling-elixir-moderate.text:
This elixir is made to help you withstand extreme environments. For 24 hours, you're protected from the effects of severe heat.

You’re also protected from extreme heat.

item.corrective-lenses.name: Corrective Lenses
item.corrective-lenses.text: A set of corrective lenses might take the form of eyeglasses or specialized goggles worn over the eyes. You can don or remove your corrective lenses as an Interact action.
item.corrosive-ammunition.name: Corrosive Ammunition
item.corrosive-ammunition.text:
This peculiar ammunition is coated in yellow dust that leaves a stain on anything it touches. When activated corrosive ammunition hits a target, it dissolves across the target's armor. The armor takes [[condition.persistent-damage|1d8 persistent acid damage]] that ignores the armor's Hardness; if the target isn't wearing armor, it takes the acid damage instead. This damage occurs at the end of the target's turns.
The creature can end this effect by spending an Interact action to wipe off the corrosive dust. Otherwise, the effect ends once the armor becomes [[condition.broken|broken]].
item.crossbow.name: Crossbow
item.crossbow.text: This ranged weapon has a bow-like assembly mounted on a handled frame called a tiller. The tiller has a mechanism to lock the bowstring in place, attached to a trigger mechanism that releases the tension and launches a bolt.
item.crowbar-levered.name: Crowbar (Levered)
item.crowbar-levered.text:
When [[action.force-open|Forcing Open]] an object that doesn't have an easy grip, a crowbar makes it easier to gain the necessary leverage. Without a crowbar, prying something open takes a –2 item penalty to the [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] check to Force Open.

A levered crowbar grants you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Force Open anything that can be pried open.

item.crutch.name: Crutch
item.crutch.text: Crutches come as singles or as a pair depending on how much support you need while walking. A crutch fits under your armpit, and you use your hand and the swing of your arm to move with them.
item.cruuk.name: Cruuk
item.cruuk.text: This specialized club is designed for throwing and useful in both combat and hunting. Tripkees use them to take down creatures that hide high in treetops.
item.crystal-shards-greater.name: Crystal Shards (Greater)
item.crystal-shards-greater.text:
This flask holds a pressurized red-brown gas flecked with bits of sublimated crystal. You gain the listed item bonus to attack rolls. When the bomb explodes, it deals the listed piercing damage and piercing splash damage as the mixture suddenly turns into solid crystals flying at high speeds. On a hit, the target takes [[condition.persistent-damage|1 persistent bleed damage]] from the crystals embedded in its flesh. As long as the bleed damage persists, the target also takes a –5-foot penalty to its speed. The target can spend an Interact action to remove the crystals, reducing the DC to stop the bleeding.

The item bonus is +2. The bomb deals 3d4 piercing damage and 5 piercing splash damage.

item.dagger.name: Dagger
item.dagger.text: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.
item.daikyu.name: Daikyu
item.daikyu.text: This asymmetrical bow, made of laminated bamboo, wood, and leather, stands 6 feet or more in height. It’s most often used while mounted.
item.darkvision-elixir-greater.name: Darkvision Elixir (Greater)
item.darkvision-elixir-greater.text:
After you drink this elixir, your sight becomes sharper in darkness. You gain darkvision for the listed duration.

The duration is 24 hours.
item.darkvision-elixir-lesser.name: Darkvision Elixir (Lesser)
item.darkvision-elixir-lesser.text:
After you drink this elixir, your sight becomes sharper in darkness. You gain darkvision for the listed duration.

item.dart.name: Dart
item.dart.text: This thrown weapon is larger than an arrow but shorter than a javelin. It typically has a short shaft of wood ending in a metal tip and is sometimes stabilized by feathers or fur.
item.deadweight-snare.name: Deadweight Snare
item.deadweight-snare.text:
This snare is made of magnetized weights and heavy ropes rigged to a trip wire or pressure plate. When a creature enters the square, the magnets and ropes deploy, weighing down the creature's weapons and limbs. The creature must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes a -1 status penalty to attack rolls for 1 round or until it [[action.escape|Escapes]] (DC 18).

**Failure** The creature takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls for 1 minute or until it Escapes (DC 18).

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature drops any metallic items it's holding.
item.deathcap-powder.name: Deathcap Powder
item.deathcap-powder.text:
The toxic deathcap mushroom can be dried, ground, and treated to form a flavorless powder with accelerated effects.

**Saving Throw** DC 33 Fortitude; **Onset** 10 minutes; **Maximum Duration** 6 minutes; **Stage 1** 7d8 poison damage (1 minute); **Stage 2** 9d6 poison damage and [[condition.sickened|sickened]] 2 (1 minute); **Stage 3** 8d10 poison damage and sickened 3 (1 minute)
item.detectives-kit.name: Detective's Kit
item.detectives-kit.text: This leather satchel contains empty vials, a pair of tweezers, a supply of small linen cloths, a set of brass calipers and a knotted string for measuring distances, several pieces of chalk, a pen, and a blank notebook for keeping notes. Every component of a detective's kit is of exceeding quality, and thus a detective's kit adds a +1 item bonus to checks to investigate a crime scene, a clue, or similar details. Like other tool kits, a detective's kit uses one hand if wearing the kit and two hands otherwise.
item.disguise-kit-elite-cosmetics.name: Disguise Kit (Elite Cosmetics)
item.disguise-kit-elite-cosmetics.text: This small wooden box contains cosmetics, false facial hair, spirit gum, and a few simple wigs. You usually need a disguise kit to set up a disguise in order to [[action.impersonate|Impersonate]] someone using the [[skill.deception|Deception]] skill. If you've crafted a large number of disguises, you can replenish your cosmetics supply with replacement cosmetics suitable for the type of your disguise kit. You can draw and replace a worn disguise kit as part of the action that uses it.
item.disguise-kit-elite.name: Disguise Kit (Elite)
item.disguise-kit-elite.text:

item.disintegration-bolt.name: Disintegration Bolt
item.disintegration-bolt.text:
The shaft of this bolt is scorched and blackened, and handling it coats your fingers with a fine black powder. When an activated disintegration bolt hits a target, it's subject to a [[spell.disintegrate|_disintegrate_]] spell requiring a DC 34 Fortitude save. As with the spell, a critical hit on the attack roll causes the target's saving throw outcome to be one degree worse.

**Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of [[spell.disintegrate|_disintegrate_]].
item.dogslicer.name: Dogslicer
item.dogslicer.text: This short, curved, and crude makeshift blade often has holes drilled into it to reduce its weight. It's a favored weapon of [[ancestry.goblin|goblins]].
item.dragonhide-armor-high-grade.name: Dragonhide Armor (High-Grade)
item.dragonhide-armor-high-grade.text:
Dragonhide armor is immune to one damage type based on the type of dragon it's made from. Wearing armor made from dragonhide also grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC and saving throws against attacks and spells that deal the corresponding damage type.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include dragonhide worth at least 16,000 gp + 1,600 per Bulk
item.dragonhide-armor-standard-grade.tex:

item.dragonhide-buckler-high-grade.name: Dragonhide Buckler (High-Grade)
item.dragonhide-buckler-high-grade.text:
Dragonhide shields are each immune to one damage type based on the tradition associated with the dragon.

**Craft Requirements** dragonhide worth at least 4,000 gp
item.dragonhide-buckler-standard-grade.t:

**Craft Requirements** dragonhide worth at least 50 gp
item.dragonhide-object-high-grade.name: Dragonhide Object (High-Grade)
item.dragonhide-object-high-grade.text:
The hide and scales of a dragon can be used to [[action.craft|Craft]] any item normally made of ordinary leather or hide. Dragonhide varies in color and texture, depending on the dragon it came from. Due to dragonhide's resiliency, it can also be used to Craft armor usually made out of metal plates (such as a [[item.breastplate|breastplate]], [[item.half-plate|half plate]], and [[item.full-plate|full plate]]), allowing such armor to be made without metal. Dragonhide objects are immune to one damage type, depending on the tradition associated with the dragon.

**Material Uses**

[[item.dragonhide-armor|Dragonhide Armor]]

[[item.dragonhide-shield|Dragonhide Shield]]

item.dragonplate.name: Dragonplate
item.dragonplate.text:
This suit of +2 [[item.resilient-greater|greater resilient]] [[item.dragonhide-armor|dragonhide]] [[item.full-plate|full plate]] makes you look like a fearsome dragon. The armor comes in many different varieties depending on the type of dragon from which it's made, though they usually conform to the four magical traditions.

**Activate—Dragon Breath** {2a} ([[trait.manipulate|manipulate]]) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You unleash a 15-foot cone of energy with a damage type and saving throw corresponding to the tradition of the dragon used to make the armor (shown on the table below). item.drakeheart-mutagen-greater.activati: You Stride twice. The drakeheart mutagen's duration ends.
item.drakeheart-mutagen-greater.name: Drakeheart Mutagen (Greater)
item.drakeheart-mutagen-greater.text:
Your skin grows scales like a drake, and your eyesight become sharp and your pupils slitted, but your mind and reflexes slow.

**Benefit** You gain the listed bonus to AC, a Dexterity cap of +2 (as usual, use your lowest Dexterity cap if you have more than one), and an item bonus to Perception checks. If you're wearing armor, you still calculate your proficiency bonus to AC based on your proficiency in the armor you're wearing, even if the drakeheart mutagen has a higher item bonus. You also gain the Final Surge action.

**Activate—Final Surge** {1a} ; **Effect** You Stride twice. The drakeheart mutagen's duration ends.

**Drawback** You take a –1 penalty to Will saves, Reflex saves, and all skill checks to [[action.recall-knowledge|Recall Knowledge]].

The item bonus to AC is +6, the item bonus to Perception is +3, and the duration is 1 hour or until you use Final Surge, whichever comes first.

item.dueling-cape.name: Dueling Cape
item.dueling-cape.text: You can pull a dueling cape you're wearing from your shoulder and wrap it around your arm with an Interact action. While wielding the dueling cape this way, the cape uses that arm and hand, and you can't hold anything else in that hand. While you do so, you can spend an action to hold it in a protective position, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to [[skill.deception|Deception]] checks to [[action.feint|Feint]] until the start of your next turn.
item.dust-of-corpse-animation-greater.te:
This black pouch contains what appears to be fine bone dust. Pouring the dust in a special pattern over a corpse turns it into an undead creature. The type of undead created depends on the condition of the corpse, resulting in either a skeleton or a zombie. If the undead's level would be greater than 3, the dust fails to animate it. The body must be of an appropriate size and type for the undead you wish to create—for example, you must sprinkle the dust on a horse's skeleton to animate a skeletal horse. If more than one undead in the level range is appropriate, such as [[creature.skeleton-guard|skeletal guard]] or [[creature.skeletal-champion|skeletal champion]] for a Medium humanoid skeleton, you choose. 
The animated undead has the [[trait.minion|minion]] trait, meaning it can use 2 actions when you Command it. You can issue a Command for the current turn as part of the activation. The undead creature remains animated for 1 minute before collapsing back into its corpse form. You can have a maximum of four minions under your control.

You can animate an undead with a level of 11 or lower.

item.earthsight-box.activations.0.name: Replicate Earth
item.earthsight-box.activations.0.text: You hold the box closed and, while envisioning the terrain, turn the box clockwise three times. When you open the box, the sand reveals, in miniature, the stone terrain surrounding you, to a range of 60 feet. This shows details of paths, hills, embankments, boulders, and even artificial structures like walls and ditches, as long as they're made of stone and earth. If you're underground, it reveals tunnels and voids in the earth within 60 feet at your current depth. The sand maintains its shape until you close the box.
item.earthsight-box.name: Earthsight Box
item.earthsight-box.text:
This fine wooden box is inlaid with Dwarven runes, with hinges and a clasp of iron. The box contains handfuls of fine sand.

**Activate—Replicate Earth** 1 minute ([[trait.concentrate|concentrate]], [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]]) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You hold the box closed and, while envisioning the terrain, turn the box clockwise three times. When you open the box, the sand reveals, in miniature, the stone terrain surrounding you, to a range of 60 feet. This shows details of paths, hills, embankments, boulders, and even artificial structures like walls and ditches, as long as they're made of stone and earth. If you're underground, it reveals tunnels and voids in the earth within 60 feet at your current depth. The sand maintains its shape until you close the box.
item.elixir-of-gender-transformation-gre:
This clear, bitter liquid can be ingested to change certain secondary sex characteristics. Different formulations create different changes—for example, one variety might cause the voice to deepen and promote body and facial hair growth, while another might cause fat redistribution around the hips and the growth of breasts. These changes tend to be accompanied by shifting of the fat in the face, sometimes dramatically or sometimes more subtly changing the user's appearance. Changes from this elixir take place gradually over the course of months or years, depending on the type.

The elixir must be taken once, and changes occur over the course of 6 months.

item.elixir-of-life-greater.name: Elixir of Life (Greater)
item.elixir-of-life-greater.text:
Elixirs of life accelerate a living creature's natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain the listed number of Hit Points and gain an item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

The elixir restores 7d6+18 Hit Points, and the bonus is +2.
item.elixir-of-life-lesser.name: Elixir of Life (Lesser)
item.elixir-of-life-lesser.text:
Elixirs of life accelerate a living creature's natural healing processes and immune system. Upon drinking this elixir, you regain the listed number of Hit Points and gain an item bonus to saving throws against diseases and poisons for 10 minutes.

The elixir restores 3d6+6 Hit Points, and the bonus is +1.

The elixir restores 8d6+21 Hit Points, and the bonus is +3.

item.elixir-of-life-minor.text:

The elixir restores 1d6 Hit Points, and the bonus is +1.
item.elixir-of-life-moderate.name: Elixir of Life (Moderate)

item.elixir-of-life-true.name: Elixir of Life (True)

item.elixir-of-life.name: Elixir of Life

item.elixir-of-rejuvenation.name: Elixir of Rejuvenation
item.elixir-of-rejuvenation.text:
The elixir of rejuvenation restores a creature to full health and eradicates toxins affecting it. When you drink this elixir, you’re restored to your maximum Hit Points, and all afflictions of 20th level or lower affecting you are removed.

You can instead administer this elixir to a creature that has been dead for a week or less. When you do, that creature is instantly brought back to life with 1 Hit Point and no spell slots, Focus Points, or other daily resources.

**Craft Requirements** [[item.philosophers-stone|philosopher's stone]], true [[item.elixir-of-life|elixir of life]]
item.elven-curve-blade.name: Elven Curve Blade
item.elven-curve-blade.text: Essentially a longer version of the scimitar, this traditional [[ancestry.elf|elven]] weapon has a thinner blade than its cousin.
item.enervating-powder.name: Enervating Powder
item.enervating-powder.text:
This carefully concocted mixture of fungal spores and ground bones has paralytic properties that make it a valuable poison.

**Saving Throw** DC 28 Fortitude; **Onset** 10 minutes; **Maximum Duration** 6 minutes; **Stage 1** [[condition.fatigued|fatigued]] (1 minute); Stage 2 5d6 poison damage and fatigued (1 minute); Stage 3 6d6 poison damage, fatigued, and [[condition.paralyzed|paralyzed]] (1 minute)
item.engulfing-snare.name: Engulfing Snare
item.engulfing-snare.text:
You arrange a spiky cage of bones, particularly tough vegetation, or other material to spring up when disturbed. The snare deals 10d8 piercing damage to the first creature to enter this square; that creature must attempt a DC 34 Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is knocked aside by the snare's deployment, takes half damage, and is [[condition.off-guard|off-guard]] until the end of its next turn.

**Failure** The creature is captured by the cage, taking full damage and falling [[condition.prone|prone]]. It's [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] while it remains within the cage. It can get free by [[action.escape|Escaping]] (DC 34) or by destroying the cage (AC 30, Fort +18, Ref +24, Hardness 5, HP 30, object immunities).

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the creature takes double damage.
item.everlasting-adhesive.name: Everlasting Adhesive
item.everlasting-adhesive.text:
This peculiar amber adhesive bonds two surfaces together almost inseparably. A single flask covers an area up to 1 square foot and must be used all at once to form a single bond between two surfaces. If the activation is interrupted, the bond fails, and the adhesive is wasted. 
Once two surfaces are joined with everlasting adhesive, a creature can separate them only with a successful DC 50 Athletics check. The adhered objects tend to break before the adhesive does unless they're particularly durable, though a creature determined to separate the objects can break off the parts connected by the everlasting adhesive and later [[action.repair|Repair]] the objects. 
The adhesive can affect creatures only if they're willing, and its bond can be broken by exfoliating the outermost layer of skin.
item.exploding-shield.activations.0.name: Splintering Boom
item.exploding-shield.activations.0.text: The shield explodes outward, dealing 4d6 piercing damage to each creature in a 15-foot cone (DC 19 basic Reflex save).
item.exploding-shield.name: Exploding Shield
item.exploding-shield.text:
The magic within this [[item.wooden-shield|wooden shield]] (Hardness 3, HP 12, BT 6) lashes out at your foes as the shield is destroyed.

**Activate—Splintering Boom** {f} ([[trait.manipulate|manipulate]]) **Trigger** The exploding shield is destroyed; **Effect** The shield explodes outward, dealing 4d6 piercing damage to each creature in a 15-foot cone (DC 19 basic Reflex save).
item.explorers-clothing.name: Explorer's Clothing
item.explorers-clothing.text: Adventurers who don't wear armor travel in durable clothing. Though it's not armor and uses your unarmored defense proficiency, it still has a Dex Cap and can grant an item bonus to AC if etched with armor potency runes.
item.falchion.name: Falchion
item.falchion.text: This weapon is a heavier, two-handed version of the curved-bladed scimitar. It is weighted toward the blade's end, making it a powerful slashing weapon.
item.fangwire.name: Fangwire
item.fangwire.text: This kobold wire is thin and hard to see, making it perfect for an ambush. The wielder flicks one handle around a vulnerable spot so that it serves as a catch for the wire, then yanks the other handle back, pulling the wire tight and inflicting painful lacerations. The function and name come from a wire-based trap called a “slow fang.”
item.fearflower-nectar.name: Fearflower Nectar
item.fearflower-nectar.text:
The nectar of a night-blooming desert flower attacks a victim's central nervous system and causes feelings of panic.

**Saving Throw** DC 21 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d6 poison damage and [[condition.frightened|frightened]] 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d6 poison damage and frightened 2 (1 round); **Stage 3** 1d6 poison damage and frightened 3 (1 round)
item.filchers-fork.name: Filcher's Fork
item.filchers-fork.text: This [[ancestry.halfling|halfling]] weapon looks like a long, two-pronged fork and is used as both a weapon and a cooking implement.
item.fire-jump-ring.activations.0.name: Fire Jump
item.fire-jump-ring.activations.0.text: You Stride (or Burrow or Fly, if you have the corresponding Speed) into any fire large enough to contain you, including magical fires. You vanish into the fire and take no damage from it. You can sense all sufficiently large fires within 100 feet of where you vanish, and you reemerge from any of those fires, either within the fire or adjacent to it. If you end your movement in the fire, it affects you as normal.
item.fire-jump-ring.name: Fire-Jump Ring
item.fire-jump-ring.text:
This black, metal ring is inset with rubies that occasionally give off wisps of smoke. It grants you a +2 item bonus to [[skill.athletics|Athletics]] checks.

**Activate—Fire Jump** {2a} ([[trait.concentrate|concentrate]], manipulate, [[trait.teleportation|teleportation]]) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You Stride (or Burrow or Fly, if you have the corresponding Speed) into any fire large enough to contain you, including magical fires. You vanish into the fire and take no damage from it. You can sense all sufficiently large fires within 100 feet of where you vanish, and you reemerge from any of those fires, either within the fire or adjacent to it. If you end your movement in the fire, it affects you as normal.
item.fishing-tackle-professional.name: Fishing Tackle (Professional)
item.fishing-tackle-professional.text:
This kit include a collapsible fishing pole, fishhooks, line, lures, and a fishing net.

Professional fishing tackle grants a +1 item bonus to checks to fish.
item.fishing-tackle.name: Fishing Tackle
item.fishing-tackle.text: This kit include a collapsible fishing pole, fishhooks, line, lures, and a fishing net.
item.fist.name: Fist
item.flail.name: Flail
item.flail.text: This weapon consists of a wooden handle attached to a spiked ball or cylinder by a chain, rope, or strap of leather.
item.flame-navette.name: Flame Navette
item.flame-navette.text:
This piece of bronzite is shaped like an oval with points at both ends. It has a carved flame at its center and is traditionally worn over the heart. You can activate only one flame navette per day. When you activate the navette, you gain the benefit of the fighter's [[feat.determination|Determination]] class feat, with a counteract rank of 8 and a counteract modifier of +22. 
If you have the Determination feat, you can use your own modifier if it's better.
item.flare-snare.name: Flare Snare
item.flare-snare.text: Using bioluminescent matter or alchemical reagents, you rig a short-lived flare to a trip wire or pressure plate. When a Small or larger creature enters the square, this flare shoots into the sky. To creatures with a clear view of the sky, this flare is visible from up to 2 miles away on a clear day or up to 5 miles away on a clear night.
item.flint-and-steel.name: Flint and Steel
item.flint-and-steel.text: Flint and steel are useful in creating a fire if you have the time to catch a spark, though using them is typically too time-consuming to be practical during an encounter. Even in ideal conditions, using flint and steel to light a flame requires using at least 3 actions, and often significantly longer.
item.flying-blade-wheel-snare.name: Flying Blade Wheel Snare
item.flying-blade-wheel-snare.text: When a creature enters the square, a deadly flying wheel of spinning blades launches at it, making a [[action.strike|Strike]] with an attack modifier of +35 that deals 8d8 slashing damage on a hit. Once on each of your turns, you can use an Interact action within 120 feet of the wheel to cause it to [[action.fly|Fly]] up to 60 feet toward the creature it's chasing and make another Strike if it's within 5 feet of its target after it moves. After 1 minute, the spinning ceases, and the wheel falls to the ground. Creatures can destroy the wheel to stop it (AC 37, Fort +29, Ref +20, Hardness 10, HP 200, object immunities).
item.flying-talon.name: Flying Talon
item.flying-talon.text: This weapon consists of a three-pronged barbed hook attached to a length of chain. It can be used in melee to stab foes or hurled at a range. Some kobolds are particularly fond of using flying talons, especially as a sort of badge of office above those who serve them.
item.forensic-dye.name: Forensic Dye
item.forensic-dye.text:
Activating this vial of colorless liquid requires inserting a small amount of another chemical or material, such as blood or mud. The vial reacts rapidly, transforming into a murky, reddish-brown substance for a brief moment before turning clear once more. 
Once activated, the dye remains potent for up to 10 minutes, during which time you can spend 1 minute to brush it onto a single object of up to 1 Bulk or across the ground in a single 5-foot square. Where the dye comes in contact with an exact match for the activating chemical, it takes on a bright blue hue while staying transparent in areas with no activating component present.
item.formula-book-blank.name: Formula Book (Blank)
item.formula-book-blank.text: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; characters of the [[class.alchemist|alchemist]] class typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.
item.four-ways-dogslicer.activations.0.t: You twist the gem along the blade corresponding with the desired weapon property rune: red for flaming, blue for frost, or yellow for shock. You take 1d6 damage of the type the chosen rune deals. You can instead twist the black gem to disable the active property rune, taking no damage.
item.four-ways-dogslicer.name: Four-Ways Dogslicer
item.four-ways-dogslicer.text:
This +2 [[item.striking|striking]] [[item.dogslicer|dogslicer]] is obviously the work of a brilliant but scrappy artisan who valued versatility over safety. Four toothy gems line the blade's cutting edge, three of which glow—one with fiery red light, one with a chill blue, and one that gives off sparks—while the last is a glistening black. Each of these gems embodies a weapon property rune, but only one rune can be active at a time.

**Activate—Gem Twist** {1a} ([[trait.manipulate|manipulate]]) **Effect** You twist the gem along the blade corresponding with the desired weapon property rune: red for flaming, blue for frost, or yellow for shock. You take 1d6 damage of the type the chosen rune deals. You can instead twist the black gem to disable the active property rune, taking no damage.
item.freezing-ammunition.name: Freezing Ammunition
item.freezing-ammunition.text: This chilly ammunition is dark blue and cold to the touch. When activated freezing ammunition hits a target, the target must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save or be [[condition.slowed|slowed]] 1 for 1 round by the intense cold (slowed 1 for 1 minute on a critical failure).
item.frost-vial-greater.name: Frost Vial (Greater)
item.frost-vial-greater.text:
The bright blue liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed cold damage and cold [[trait.splash|splash]] damage. On a hit, the target takes a status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d6 cold damage and 3 cold splash damage, and the target takes a –10-foot penalty.
item.frost-vial-lesser.name: Frost Vial (Lesser)
item.frost-vial-lesser.text:

The bomb deals 1d6 cold damage and 1 cold splash damage, and the target takes a –5-foot penalty.

item.frost-vial.name: Frost Vial
item.frost-vial.text: The bright blue liquid reagents in this vial rapidly absorb heat when exposed to air. A frost vial deals the listed cold damage and cold [[trait.splash|splash]] damage. On a hit, the target takes a status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn. Many types of frost vial also grant an item bonus to attack rolls.
item.full-plate.name: Full Plate
item.full-plate.text: Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of [[item.padded-armor|padded armor]] and a pair of [[item.gauntlet|gauntlets]].
item.gaff.name: Gaff
item.gaff.text: Many marsh giants fight with an oversized gaff—a length of wood with a metal hook affixed to the tip.
item.gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
item.gauntlet.text: A pair of these metal gloves comes with [[item.full-plate|full plate]], [[item.half-plate|half plate]], and [[item.splint-mail|splint armor]]; they can also be purchased separately and worn with other types of armor. They not only protect your hands but also transform your hands into lethal weapons.
item.ghost-charge-greater.name: Ghost Charge (Greater)
item.ghost-charge-greater.text:
These spring-loaded metal canisters contain a mixture of chemicals and salts that drain and disintegrate nearby undead creatures. A ghost charge deals the listed vitality damage and splash damage, though as usual for [[trait.vitality|vitality]] damage, this damage harms only undead and creatures with [[ability.void-healing|void healing]]. Ghost charges are designed to explode even on contact with a spiritual substance, making them ideal for damaging [[trait.incorporeal|incorporeal]] undead. A primary target that takes damage from a ghost charge becomes [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled]] until the start of your next turn. Many types grant an item bonus to attack rolls.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The bomb deals 3d8 vitality damage and 3 vitality splash damage, and the target is enfeebled 2 until the start of your next turn.

item.ghost-ink.name: Ghost Ink
item.ghost-ink.text:
This pale-blue ink dries rapidly, becoming fully transparent 1 minute after application. The ink glows red when exposed to heat, such as that from a torch or other open flame. This glow lasts only as long as the ink is exposed to heat, after which the ink becomes invisible again. The crafter of the ghost ink can alter the formula slightly to instead make the ink sensitive to sunlight, starlight, magical light, or heatless light created by an alchemical effect, such as a glow rod.
 While the text isn't glowing, a creature closely examining a surface marked with ghost ink can detect the presence of the ink with a successful DC 25 Perception check. On a critical success, they can make out the ink well enough to use Society to [[action.decipher-writing|Decipher Writing]]. One vial of ghost ink is sufficient to write a page worth of text.
item.ghoul-hide.name: Ghoul Hide
item.ghoul-hide.text: Stitched together from pieces of [[creature.ghoul-stalker|ghoul]] skin, this suit of +1 [[item.hide-armor|hide armor]] grants you a +1 item bonus to saving throws against [[trait.curse|curses]] and makes you immune to the stench of ghouls. Ghoul hide with a [[item.resilient|resilient rune]] increases the resilient rune's item bonus to saving throws against curses by 1 (maximum +4).
item.giant-centipede-venom.name: Giant Centipede Venom
item.giant-centipede-venom.text:
Giant centipede venom causes severe muscle stiffness and general fatigue.

**Saving Throw** DC 17 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 1d4 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 1d4 poison damage and [[condition.fatigued|fatigued]] (1 round); **Stage 3** 1d4 poison damage, clumsy 1, and fatigued (1 round)
item.giant-scorpion-venom.name: Giant Scorpion Venom
item.giant-scorpion-venom.text:
The venom of a giant scorpion is excruciating and its effects are somewhat debilitating.

**Saving Throw** DC 22 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 2d6 poison damage and [[condition.enfeebled|enfeebled]] 1 (1 round); **Stage 2** 2d8 poison damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round); **Stage 3** 2d10 poison damage and enfeebled 2 (1 round)
item.glaive.name: Glaive
item.glaive.text: This polearm consists of a long, single-edged blade on the end of a 7-foot pole. It is extremely effective at delivering lethal cuts at a distance.
item.glamorous-buckler.activations.0.req: You have the glamorous buckler raised
item.glamorous-buckler.activations.0.tex: As you Feint, the glamorous buckler sparkles mightily. On a successful Feint, the target is [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]] for 1 round.
item.glamorous-buckler.name: Glamorous Buckler
item.glamorous-buckler.text:
A glamorous [[item.buckler|buckler]] (Hardness 3, HP 6, BT 3) is lavishly decorated with gilding and inset gemstones that glitter in the light. While you have it raised, the glamorous buckler grants you a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to [[action.feint|Feint]].

**Activate—Dazzling Feint** {f} ([[trait.concentrate|concentrate]]) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You [[action.feint|Feint]]; **Requirements** You have the glamorous buckler raised; **Effect** As you Feint, the glamorous buckler sparkles mightily. On a successful Feint, the target is [[condition.dazzled|dazzled]] for 1 round.
item.glow-rod.name: Glow Rod
item.glow-rod.text: This 1-foot-long, gold-tipped rod glows after it's struck on a hard surface. For the next 6 hours, it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet).
item.glue-bomb-greater.name: Glue Bomb (Greater)
item.glue-bomb-greater.text:
A glue bomb is a harmless explosive mechanism bursting with sticky substances. When you hit a creature with a glue bomb, that creature takes a status penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute. Many types of glue bomb also grant an item bonus to attack rolls. 
On a critical hit, a creature in contact with a solid surface becomes stuck to the surface and [[condition.immobilized|immobilized]] for 1 round, and a creature flying via wings has its wings tangled, causing it to fall safely to the ground and become unable to [[action.fly|Fly]] again for 1 round. Glue bombs aren't effective when used on a creature that's in water. 
The target can end any effects by [[action.escape|Escaping]] or spending a total of 3 [[trait.manipulate|manipulate]] actions to carefully remove the sticky substances. These manipulate actions don't have to be consecutive, and other creatures can provide the actions as well.

You gain a +2 item bonus to attack rolls. The target takes a –15-foot penalty, and the Escape DC is 28.
